states.description:
Kintaro loves embroidered handkerchiefs, ribbons, lace accessories, fluffy stuffed animals, floral pouches...
After finishing a good day's work, there's nothing she enjoys more than hugging her cherished items closely and gushing "Awwww, soooo cute!"

states.name: Kintaro
states.title: Sugar, Spice, and Brute Force
states.description:
"Why does everyone seem to be so...afraid...of me?" Kintaro would often lament.
She believed it was because of her outfit was too intimidating.
But in truth, the real reason is the feral, unhinged roars she unleashes in the midst of her work and combat.

states.name: Ludmilla
states.title: Red Dragon Dancer
states.description:
Long ago, when she had witnessed a ballet performance as a child, she saw it as something purely beautiful—something from a world far removed from her own.
But as she began living and training alongside the troupe, sharing meals with them and sweating in the same rehearsal hall, she realized she had been wrong.
Even within graceful movements and quiet steps, there lay the same resolve and discipline as when she practiced her sword.

states.name: Ludmilla
states.title: Red Dragon Dancer
states.description:
Even on an unfamiliar stage, Clarice danced with a skill far beyond her own. And yet, not a trace of jealousy stirred in Ludmilla's heart.
What she felt instead was pure joy—that her dear friend had been recognized and found new bonds.
Determined to catch up in her own way, Ludmilla once again commits to her training with maximum gusto.

states.name: Ludmilla
states.title: Red Dragon Dancer
states.description:
Clarice watched it all unfold—others derided Ludmilla as someone with no talent for dance.
But even without any talent, she would not stop—stumbling, falling, sweating, and still rising again with a smile.
The sight stole Clarice's heart again and again.
Even if her movements were far from graceful, to Clarice, Ludmilla's dance was more noble—and more beautiful—than anyone else's.

states.name: Clarice
states.description:
Clarice watched it all unfold—others derided Ludmilla as someone with no talent for dance.
But even without any talent, she would not stop—stumbling, falling, sweating, and still rising again with a smile.
The sight stole Clarice's heart again and again.
Even if her movements were far from graceful, to Clarice, Ludmilla's dance was more noble—and more beautiful—than anyone else's.

states.name: Clarice
states.description:
Clarice watched it all unfold—others derided Ludmilla as someone with no talent for dance.
But even without any talent, she would not stop—stumbling, falling, sweating, and still rising again with a smile.
The sight stole Clarice's heart again and again.
Even if her movements were far from graceful, to Clarice, Ludmilla's dance was more noble—and more beautiful—than anyone else's.

states.name: Clarice
states.description:
Clarice watched it all unfold—others derided Ludmilla as someone with no talent for dance.
But even without any talent, she would not stop—stumbling, falling, sweating, and still rising again with a smile.
The sight stole Clarice's heart again and again.
Even if her movements were far from graceful, to Clarice, Ludmilla's dance was more noble—and more beautiful—than anyone else's.

states.name: Victoria
states.title: The Crowned Étoile
states.description:
Victoria was born as the eldest daughter of the long-standing Royal House of Wellmund.
Raised from childhood to one day succeed her father, the king, she received a thorough royal education. Combined with her exceptional talent, she has mastered horsemanship, etiquette, diplomacy, and politics.

states.name: Victoria
states.title: The Crowned Étoile
states.description:
She also joined the Royal Ballet Troupe, one of Wellmund's proudest cultural institutions. There, she quickly blossomed as a skilled dancer and rose to the prestigious position of étoile—the very face of the entire troupe.
But when her father, the king, fell gravely ill and could no longer carry out his duties, Victoria had to inherit the throne. From that day on, she found herself consumed by the endless demands of being a queen.

states.name: Victoria
states.title: The Crowned Étoile
states.description: Before long, her ballet training had to fall by the wayside. A perfectionist to her core, Victoria could not tolerate performing at anything less than her best, and resolved to leave behind the ballet she loved rather than drag down the rest of the troupe. But through the events of the recent incident, she came to understand the strength it takes to rely on others. And with the help of this strength, she hopes that once she has truly grown into her role as queen...she might one day return to the stage again.

states.name: Lupin
states.title: Moonlight Phantom Thief
states.description:
Lupin is master thief whose exploits span the entire world.
With a deep love for works of art and national treasures, she steals any target she sets her sights on—no matter how impenetrable its security may be.
She is also known as a master of disguise, and no one knows her true face...except for one.

states.name: Lupin
states.title: Moonlight Phantom Thief
states.description:
Three years ago, she infiltrated the Kingdom of Wellmund in pursuit of the national treasure known as the "Swan Crown". Unable to break the final seal, she was just preparing to withdraw in defeat when Victoria, still a princess at the time, offered her assistance. With her aid, the theft was successful.
From that day on, Lupin began referring to the future queen as her one and only "accomplice".

states.name: Lupin
states.title: Moonlight Phantom Thief
states.description: Lupin had always loved ballet, and one day she happened to attend a performance by the Royal Ballet Troupe. The moment she saw her on stage, Lupin was utterly captivated. Movements as light as a feather, such graceful steps, and with a fleetingly delicate expression—she was the shining star at the center of the stage. From that day on, Lupin became an ardent fan, never once missing a regular performance by her "accomplice".

JeanneFusion.name: Jeanne
JeanneFusion.title: The Saint of a Lost Kingdom

states.name: Jeanne
states.title: The Saint of a Lost Kingdom
states.description: And just like that, the voice of her sister—who had always been by her side—could no longer reach her. No matter how many times she called or prayed to her, she was answered only with silence. For the first time since her sister's death long ago, Jeanne once again felt what it was like to be truly alone.

states.name: Jeanne
states.title: The Saint of a Lost Kingdom
states.description: When she was little, Jeanne would run around within the remains of an old tower with her sister and their childhood friend. Whenever they played hide-and-seek, her sister would always be the first to do the seeking, smiling and laughing as she looked for Jeanne and the friend. But now, no matter where Jeanne hides, she will never again hear those cheerful footsteps or that joyful voice calling out her name. "Mikaela...please find me," Jeanne whispers.

states.name: Jeanne
states.title: The Saint of a Lost Kingdom
states.description: In response to the silence that gave her no answer, Jeanne gently placed a hand over her chest. Her sister's voice could no longer reach her. Even so, she was certain her sister was still with her, somewhere within her heart. "This time, I'll be the one to find you, Mikaela." To bring this new game of hide-and-seek to an end, Jeanne draws her holy sword. And so begins her lone crusade—to reclaim the other half of her soul that was taken from her.

states.name: Basilisk
states.title: Master of Wraiths
states.description:
Born in a neighboring kingdom, Basilisk was abandoned soon after birth and taken in by an orphanage. She could never fit in with the other children, and she spent her days all alone.
Her loneliness was only broken when she came across a snake, which she named "Jajamaru". He became her one and only family, irreplaceable and precious above all else.

states.name: Basilisk
states.title: Master of Wraiths
states.description: Even after the kingdom fell and the orphanage was lost, Basilisk continued living together with Jajamaru in a cabin within a forest, surviving by hunting and foraging. But before too long, Jajamaru lost his life to illness. Overcome with grief, Basilisk chose to use her own body as a vessel to store Jajamaru's soul, allowing him to remain in this world as a wraith.

states.name: Basilisk
states.title: Master of Wraiths
states.description:
From then on, she lived quietly with Jajamaru in a forgotten ruin. Putting on a brave face, she called herself the "Master of Wraiths," but in the darkness of the caves, she spent most of her time terrified of intruders.

"Eek! I j-j-just felt a chill up my spine... Was that...a ghost?!"

Jajamaru: "It's just me, brat."

states.name: Manchester
states.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
states.description:
At a young age, her talents were recognized by the Western Exorcist Church, and she became a knight devoted to hunting wraiths.
Despite her slender appearance, she possesses the strength to swing a massive blade with ease, and her reliable work has earned her the deep trust of the Church.

states.name: Manchester
states.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
states.description:
She was the eldest daughter of her family. With her parents gone, she had to care for her many younger brothers.
To make sure they could all eat their fill, she prioritized efficiency above all else in her work, heading directly home as soon as she completed an exorcism.
Because of this, more than a few people have assumed her to be an aloof and uncaring knight.

states.name: Manchester
states.title: Exorcist Knight of the West
states.description:
However, the most important battlefield for her is not the struggle against wraiths, but the bargain sale at the local grocery store.

"Sorry, those potatoes are mine!"

The sight of her snatching up her prey in the blink of an eye have left other customers struck with fear and awe, and the locals have nicknamed her the "Paladin of the Sale Rack."

states.name: Lü Bu
states.title: Revenant of a Wrathful Demon
states.description: She should have had no lingering regrets. And yet, when her eyes opened once more through the power of the Talisman of Revival, a single wish began to bloom within Lü Bu's heart— She wanted to see her again. Guided by that one simple, humble wish, she returned to the battlefield once more.

states.name: Lü Bu
states.title: Revenant of a Wrathful Demon
states.description:
Even after seeing how Musashi had been corrupted into an oni, Lü Bu's feelings did not waver. No matter how completely Musashi had changed in personality or appearance, she could not abandon her dear friend who was now truly alone.

And so, rather than choosing what was right, she chose to stand by Musashi's side.

states.name: Lü Bu
states.title: Revenant of a Wrathful Demon
states.description: Though Lü Bu was feared as the "Demon of Wrath", her heart was filled with deep affection and calm resignation. If neither of them could go back to the way they were before, then at the very least, they would walk together until the very end. She will no longer hesitate...even if that path led only to ruin.

states.name: Mizuchi
states.title: Black-Hearted White Snake
states.description: Akame Mizuchi was ranked the second strongest among the Four Masters of the Onmyo Bureau. As a result, her shoulders were constantly weighed down with many responsibilities. She had to protect everyone from the oni, had to serve as a model for the onmyoji of her bureau, and had to obey the orders of the Inner Palace...

states.name: Mizuchi
states.title: Black-Hearted White Snake
states.description:
She loved the people, and she loved the disciples of her bureau. Her desire to protect them was completely sincere. But at the same time, before she even realized it, there was a voice that had begun whispering to her.

"Why are you always the only one who has to keep trying so hard?"

Mizuchi desperately tried to silence that voice.

states.name: Mizuchi
states.title: Black-Hearted White Snake
states.description:
Freed from her conscience by the oni-transformation drug, now no enemy could stand before her. Her reserves of mana, which she had unconsciously held back, were now inexhaustible. In terms of pure magic prowess, she had even surpassed Rin Inugami, the foremost of the Four Masters.

"Nothing can stand in my way anymore."

And yet, there was something sorrowful in her smile.

states.name: Xiao Li
states.title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
states.description: Xiao Li, a skilled practitioner of the martial arts of the distant Middle Kingdom, was spending her days traveling from place to place in search of mighty opponents. After defeating countless renowned warriors, the latest one she sought was Lü Bu, feared throughout the Middle Kingdom as a "Demon of Wrath". A legendary figure, Lü Bu was idolized by Xiao Li as she pursued the title of the strongest warrior to ever live.

states.name: Xiao Li
states.title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
states.description: Then Xiao Li heard a rumor that Lü Bu had died in the Land of Peace. Unable to believe it, she set out to discover the truth—and astonishingly, swam across the sea to reach the Land of Peace. She then traveled from place to place asking after Lü Bu's whereabouts, until at last she found her grave.

states.name: Xiao Li
states.title: Indomitable Martial Warrior
states.description:
"No! You can't be dead before I've fought you!"

Standing before the remains of the figure she had so long admired, Xiao Li cried those words in her heart. Then she placed the Talisman of Revival, a resurrection charm that she had brought from the Middle Kingdom, upon Lü Bu's remains.
She would defeat the strongest warrior she had admired with her own hands, and prove that she herself was the strongest of all.

states.name: Dracula
states.title: The King of Vampires
states.description:
Six months ago, a lone noble took up residence in the old castle on the hill. Calling herself a count, she was lighting up the castle each night to host lavish evening balls. All who gathered there would find themselves intoxicated by her elegance and beauty.

But—No one knows how many of the invited guests would live to see the dawn.

states.name: Dracula
states.title: The King of Vampires
states.description:
These evening parties are not gatherings for social exchange, but hunting grounds where humans are sorted and selected.
Most are gradually drained of blood to provide sustenance for her and her kin. A chosen few are given some of Dracula's own blood and transformed into her servants.

Despite being an immortal ruler of the night, she fears her weakness to sunlight. And so she has been moving from one lair to the next before her secrets could get exposed.

states.name: Dracula
states.title: The King of Vampires
states.description:
She has been captive to the memory of one woman for many years, even now.
The woman she had once believed loved her in return. The only woman in the world she had ever loved from the depths of her heart.

But that woman betrayed her, and sought to take Dracula's life.

Even now, there is an old wound in her chest, left there by a stake driven through her heart. It has been years since that fateful day, and the wound is no longer visible from the outside.
And yet, deep within, it still lingers there unhealed.

states.name: Helsing
states.title: Twilight Avenger
states.description: As a dreamy young girl, Helsing loved the meat pies her mother made. Whenever she would cry, her mother would bake one for her and make the tears stop. The two of them had always lived together in poverty, just mother and daughter. Even so, looking back, those were the happiest years of her life.

states.name: Helsing
states.title: Twilight Avenger
states.description:
Helsing admired the castle that stood atop the hill overlooking the town where she lived with her mother.
Each night, whenever the bells rang, she imagined herself taking the hand of a prince she had yet to meet, dancing with him in a splendid hall.

She never knew that every night within that mansion, a dance of death was being performed by monsters thirsting for blood.

states.name: Helsing
states.title: Twilight Avenger
states.description:
Her mother, Ekaterina, taught her young daughter the name of a certain flower. A flower with a sweet fragrance and delicate beauty, yet hiding a deadly poison within.

"Whether something becomes poison or medicine depends on the heart of the one who uses it."

Ten years later, the daughter would turn the lesson her mother had given her into a weapon of revenge, and quietly close in on the throat of the monster who had stolen her mother away.

states.name: Holmes
states.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
states.description:
Holmes is a private detective based in the fog-shrouded city of Londinium. At the mere mention of a case, she rushes straight to the scene, utterly unfazed by the grim looks given to her by the city guards.

She is a master detective who appears without warning, and unravels even the most baffling mysteries before the sun rises.

states.name: Holmes
states.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
states.description:
Believing that information is the key to solving any case, her room is buried beneath newspaper clippings, case files she has gathered on her own, and towering stacks of reference materials.
Although she claims to be a neat freak, her landlord begs to differ, having recently given her a stern warning. Despite being an individual with impressively thick skin, the complaint left her rather dejected for a while.

states.name: Holmes
states.title: Ubiquitous Master Detective
states.description:
The chief of Londinium's city guard finds the detective utterly insufferable, as she would barge into crime scenes uninvited and steal the glory of solving them for herself.
Among his subordinates, however, her brilliant mind and beauty had captivated more than a few admirers, and eventually, some of them formed a fan club.

Unfortunately for anyone smitten by this detective, she herself is interested in nothing but mysteries.

states.name: Alice
states.title: The Dream's Origin
states.description: She is the "original" Alice, who had become imprisoned in a warped, endlessly repeating Wonderland since its creation. She adores stories, and she never forgets her curiosity or smile in any circumstance. Even after solitude of unimaginable length, she loves nothing more than to chat with another person.

states.name: Alice
states.title: The Dream's Origin
states.description: She has always loved making up stories. Whenever something interesting happens, she immediately turns it into a tale in her head. Her favorite is the story of a girl who follows a white rabbit with a watch into Wonderland. But each time she tells it, the ending changes—little by little, towards a bad end.

states.name: Alice
states.title: The Dream's Origin
states.description: There was a white feather charm that she treasured, a gift from a precious friend she met in this world. This friend insisted that "it's just a silly little good-luck charm," but when the friend nearly lost it once,  she was uncharacteristically close to tears.

states.name: The Queen of Hearts
states.title: Crimson Arbiter
states.description:
She is the beautiful yet terrifying queen who reigns over her dream world from the Castle of Hearts.
Reason and morality has no place in her court. Guilt, punishment, and even the law itself are decided by her word alone. None dare defy her as she delivers her absurd decrees with an elegant smile.

states.name: The Queen of Hearts
states.title: Crimson Arbiter
states.description:
The Queen of Hearts is rather particular when it comes to preparing for a tea party.
Everything must be just right—the temperature of the tea, the arrangement of the candies, the aroma of pomegranate pastries. She claims it is all to guarantee the delight of her guests, yet at times, her gaze makes it seem as though she is waiting for someone who is no longer there.

states.name: The Queen of Hearts
states.title: Crimson Arbiter
states.description:
"A gentle lie is better than a cruel reality."

For the longest time, that was the one thing the Queen believed in. No matter how many times she rewound the world or stained her hands with crimson, she believed that her wish to protect would never falter. But in the end, she learned that love means not only holding someone close, but also knowing when to let them go.

states.name: Cupid
states.title: Sorceress of True Love
states.description: Whenever she senses love in the air, Cupid comes flying, forgetting all about time and place. Declarations of love, gushing about a lover, and lovers' quarrels—they all carry the sweetest scent of romance. Even now, whenever she hears someone's heart begin to race, Cupid will appear with the soft flutter of her wings.

states.name: Cupid
states.title: Sorceress of True Love
states.description: During her days at the Temple of Time, she was far more interested in her romantic fantasies than in dull lectures. Everyone saw her as an unserious student on the verge of dropping out—but in truth, she has greater potential in time magic than anyone else. The margins of her class notes are filled with unfinished love stories.

states.name: Cupid
states.title: Sorceress of True Love
states.description:
Cupid's goal was to discover the clearest example of "true love", absorb its power, and become the new Primordial of Love. And deep within an ancient dream, she found an incredibly potent love that had been lying dormant for ages.
She will stop at nothing to achieve her goal—even if it means exploiting the wishes, the pain, and the tragic fates of others.

states.name: Super Shiromori
states.description:
A guardian spirit with the power of Light.
Enjoys basking in the sun.

states.name: Snow White
states.title: Snow Maiden of Black & White
states.description: Light and shadow — Snow White and Snow Black. The soul of the shadow had begun to sense her own existence gradually fading away. This was because of emotions that had unexpectedly taken root within her, born from her interactions with the hero and Snow White.

states.name: Snow White
states.title: Snow Maiden of Black & White
states.description: As though exploiting the opening left in her heart, the "other shadow" that was supposed to have been sealed away returns to life once more. She is the black witch, steeped in malice and hatred — the one who was vanquished by Snow Black after attempting to steal her body.

states.name: Snow White
states.title: Snow Maiden of Black & White
states.description:
In the depths of darkness, Snow White and Snow Black joined hands. It was but a fleeting alliance — light and shadow were never meant to intertwine, for darkness is fated to be erased by the light. And yet, Snow Black did not disappear.
Without realizing it, she had already crossed the boundary into the light.

states.name: Aigis
states.description:
Aigis had no family either. As an infant, she was abandoned in the forest near a town. Though taken in by a local family who found her, she was treated as little more than labor—and in the end, she was cast aside once again.
Because of her distinct appearance and her timid nature, she remained alone for as long as she could remember.

Until she met Belle.

Because of her distinct appearance and her timid nature, she remained alone for as long as she could remember.

Until she met Belle.

Because of her distinct appearance and her timid nature, she remained alone for as long as she could remember.

Until she met Belle.

states.name: Belle
states.description:
Belle was born in a small town. She was raised by her parents, but financial ruin tore the family apart—and Belle was left behind.
With nowhere else to go, she found herself among a group of urchins in the backstreets. Thanks to her natural dexterity and street smarts, it wasn't long before she had made a name for herself among the backstreet's shady residents.

Because of her distinct appearance and her timid nature, she remained alone for as long as she could remember.

Until she met Belle.

states.name: Beauty & Beast
states.title: Pair of Morphean Flowers
states.description:
The fragile world the two lived in was unlike other dream worlds—it was unstable, doomed to collapse within a single day without fuel to keep it going.
That was why sacrificial victims were necessary.
But even if it meant offering up every single soul in existence, as long as the two of them could remain together for another day longer...that was all that mattered.

states.name: Diabolos
states.title: Dragon Lord of Shadow
states.description: His name is Crescent, and he's a very happy dragon. Or at least, he used to be. He doesn't remember all that much. One day, there was nothing but the dark. The next day, there were Luna, and Solas, and the girl with the fluffy white hair. And grapes! He had no reason not to be happy in a world with grapes and good friends. But one day, that stopped being enough. Something inside him, like a shadow on a moonless night, started following him. Whispering to him. There's more than this. More than this. Remember. Crescent doesn't know if he wants to. He thinks, if he does, he might never be happy again.

states.name: Diabolos
states.title: Dragon Lord of Shadow
states.description: Diabolos... The voice in Crescent's mind haunts him with that name. Diabolos. Not Crescent. Diabolos. You are Diabolos. He doesn't want that awful name. It sounds ancient, larger than he is, cursed with history he can't remember. Suddenly, his days with Luna and Solas seem so small, a speck of happiness against a shadow that threatens to consume him. He wants to protect his friends. He wants to stand by their side forever. But if he is Diabolos, and if the shadow inside him one day shows him its secrets... Will they even want to be near him?

states.name: Diabolos
states.title: Dragon Lord of Shadow
states.description:
The Dragon Lord of Shadow, known as Diabolos, never considered himself an ally of humanity. Only an enemy of the Pandemonium.

For centuries, not a soul set foot in the mountains where he made his home. The dragon would unleash his breath of void on any who came too close, plunging his victims in a realm of perfect darkness. Many thought him utterly invincible.

Except the Dragon Lord of Light, who slew him when he marched with the Bergarian Army as the Emperor's mount.

No one saw the fearsome Diabolos after that. Most thought the world rid of him forever, including the other Lords.

But perhaps it wasn't death he found in that ancient final fight. Perhaps it was a second chance.

RoseElf02.description:
Under his new master's tutelage, Trevyn quickly became adept at using his hearing to compensate for his sight. Soon he could hear a single flower petal fluttering on the wind, and then slice it cleanly into half.

But his teacher's old age soon caught up with her. On her deathbed, she confided in Trevyn that she feared her life was meaningless, as whatever she had accomplished, a swordmaster with sight could have easily done better. It was only natural that eventually, they would draw the attention of one of the higher powers of their world. FrogSorceror01.description:
When the bikki came to Westland, they left behind much of their traditional magic in Eastland. Ambitious bikki spellcasters would attempt to make the journey back to their ancestor's homelands, in hopes of learning their forgotten secrets. The passage was long and filled with peril, and many of these pilgrims were never heard from again.

When the aspiring mage Jin decided to make the trip, his friends and family were deeply concerned. Jin's sense of direction was so terrible, it was not uncommon for him to get lost on the way to his own house. Nevertheless, Jin was too stubborn to be persuaded otherwise, and he departed for Eastland.

FoxMutant01.description: After bearing the wanton destruction wrought by the forces of the Eternal for several cycles, the soils of Erden stirred. Determined to rid themselves of the disease known as the Pandemonium, they created Vesh. Born from the earth itself, Vesh was brought forth in the height of an endless trial. It knows nothing of itself, and even the planet that bore it knows not its future.

FoxMutant02.name: Vesh
FoxMutant02.title: Will of the Soil
FoxMutant02.description: From the moment it was created, Vesh has continued an endless quest to define itself. Through encounters both friendly and hostile it developed a personality, and arrived at a personal philosophy of sorts. It began its journey without words, but through interaction with the inhabitants of Erden, it taught itself to speak. Though it makes no effort to explain its actions, many have been saved by the swiftness of its spear.

DemonElfBoy01.name: Vonn
DemonElfBoy01.title: Bearer of the Demon Maul
DemonElfBoy01.description:
Vonn was a child of a noble elven family who was entrusted with defending their region during a prior Pandemonium.

One day, in a sealed vault deep within his father's castle, Vonn found a giant maul that had become a prison for a powerful demon lord named Drakkus. The demon promised great power to any that would wield this maul in battle, and eager to aid his father against the forces of the Pandemonium, Vonn foolishly carried the weapon out of the vault.

Just as the demon had promised, Vonn became nearly invincible in battle. Despite his father's grave concerns about the weapon, the elven forces soon came to rely on the young hero in the struggle against the Pandemonium.

DemonElfBoy02.name: Vonn
DemonElfBoy02.title: Bearer of the Demon Maul
DemonElfBoy02.description:
But Vonn's heroics soon came to an end. One stormy night, the forces of the Pandemonium laid siege to Vonn's home itself. Vonn eagerly joined the fray against them with his maul, and it didn't take long for him to crush all of the attacking forces.

At that moment, the demon in the maul intentionally loosened his grip on the boy's mind, so that he could see what had really transpired. There was no siege, there were no Aeon Knights... Only his beloved family, who now lay dead and broken throughout the castle.

As the truth dawned on Vonn, his mind shattered, allowing the demon to fully claim his soul.

Kirin01.name: Kirin
Kirin01.title: Mythweaver
Kirin01.description:
The illusive Kirin are common characters in Erden mythology, but their significance greatly differs from culture to culture. The Zuo people of Eastland believe that the appearance of a Kirin is a sign that a god is near, whilst the legends of the Akashi people depict the Kirin as a symbol of great happiness.

Few have ever met a Kirin, and reports of their nature vary from gentle and majestic to divinely terrifying.

Kirin02.name: Kirin
Kirin02.title: Mythweaver
Kirin02.description: An ancient folktale found among various cultural groups in Westland tells the story of a child abandoned at birth and raised by a Kirin. The child, in some tales called Enkidu and by others Eabani, grew up in the spirit world compassionate and gentle. When she turned 16, the Kirin took her back to the material realm, where she was greatly saddened by the division between its peoples. She begged her foster parent to do something, and moved by his ward's conviction, the Kirin led a procession of his breathren to thunder across the night sky.

BlueSeaSerpent01.name: Kaidaros
BlueSeaSerpent01.title: Riptide Guardian
BlueSeaSerpent01.description:
When the first Dragon of Water was slain by the Eternal, he gifted Kaidaros his power, and she used it well. It was not she who brought warfare and corruption to the sea. It was the humans, and their greed.

Their crafts started plain, barely anything more than hollow logs on the water. But as they grew ever more prideful and sailed ever further, they slew one another on her waters, hunted her ocean's bounty until entire species died. She could allow it no longer.

Her waves ripped mast from hull and dragged the villainous men to her depths. For generations, she pushed them back to their shores, until no one dared venture forth into the sea.

No one, that is, but the people who looked at her waters with awe, not avarice.

BlueSeaSerpent02.name: Kaidaros
BlueSeaSerpent02.title: Riptide Guardian
BlueSeaSerpent02.description:
On Erden's widest sea, there was an island laden with wild fruit, fresh water, and good soil. Kaidaros often surfaced there when she tired of the ocean's depths, and she cared for it deeply. When she saw a ship full of humans sailing toward its shores one day, she lashed out with all her fury, desperate to keep it safe from their bloodstained hands.

But these men were not like the others. As the waves rose around them, they offered up a song of reverence to her and her domain. She had no reason to trust them. Men had begged her for their lives before...but never with such sincerity. It shook her to her core.

She could not destroy any creature that came to her in peace.

Mysha01.name: Mysha
Mysha01.title: Mysha
Mysha01.description:
A girl from Urg Roa who lives with her grandfather, Gilgan. Bright and cheerful, and never seen without a smile. Mysha grew up admiring her grandfather and uncle, both renowned swordmasters, and idolizes Druke especially. From a young age, Mysha has trained with a sword alongside her childhood friend Ga'Luga.
Since she's not kud, Mysha grew up training alongside people much bigger and stronger than her. Still, her innate speed and agility, and her unflagging hard work, are the source of her strength.

RizetteCrestbearer01.name: Rizette
RizetteCrestbearer01.title: The Cerulean Crestbearer
RizetteCrestbearer01.description:
"Are you sure that's not too heavy for you, Theo?"

"I'm fine, Riz. I can carry this much."

"It feels like only yesterday you were smaller than that bag."

"You're treating me like a kid again... You're not that much older than me, you know."

"That doesn't matter. You're my responsibility since Mom and Dad aren't here anymore."

"Riz... Look at the village!"

"!?"

"Those are flames!"

RizetteCrestbearer02.name: Rizette
RizetteCrestbearer02.title: The Cerulean Crestbearer
RizetteCrestbearer02.description:
"Riz? Are you sure you're okay?"

"What do you mean?"

"With this Cerulean Crest thing... Everything happened so suddenly. How do you feel about all of it?"

"Theo... You're sweet. But I'm okay, really. I wanted the power to fight, and now I have it. And besides..."

"Besides?"

"Now Finn doesn't have to bear everything alone. He put his life on the line to help us when he didn't even know us, and he ended up with the responsibility of the Crimson Crest. If there's something I can do to lessen his burden, I'll do it."

"Riz..."

FinnCrestbearer01.description:
"Man, Finn sure is excited about this whole Lightling thing..."

"You guys're headed out again today?"

"Yep... Can't fight what's in your blood, I s'pose."

"Me missus' been saying he's looking more like his Pa every day."

"C'mon Elran, let's go!"

"Speak of the devil. I don't know how you keep up."

"I better get moving before he explodes. Keep this place safe while we're gone, boys!"

FinnCrestbearer02.name: Finn
FinnCrestbearer02.title: The Crimson Crestbearer
FinnCrestbearer02.description:
"Hey, Callen? Just in case I don't make it through this—"

"That's not even in the realm of possibility."

"If I... If I become something that's not me anymore—"

"That's not going to happen!"

"But if it does, could you give this letter to Rizette for me?"

"I won't. I refuse to deliver another letter like that."

"Another one? Callen, were you the one who—"

"Fine, I'll keep this letter for you. But when we emerge victorious, you're going to be so embarrassed, Finn!"

"...Thank you, Callen. I'm sorry."

"Honestly! You and that idiot father of yours are two peas in a pod."

BattleCleric01.title: Lady Luck's Toy
BattleCleric01.description:
Good Luck Baltruk.
His village razed by an iron dragon, 
the hamlet he hid in destroyed by monsters, 
the merchants who rescued him prey for tiger hornets, 
the port town where he washed ashore raided by orcs
and the village that sheltered him crushed by the Aeon Legion. 

That, is good luck Baltruk! 
This most fortunate of men entered the trials of the knighthood, 
and why did he triumph? 
Because he is good luck Baltruk, plaything of lady luck!
-From a master minstrel's song

MoonGoddess01.name: Artimeia
MoonGoddess01.title: Lady of the White Moon
MoonGoddess01.description:
Many old legends speak of the Lady of the White Moon, an ancient being who slumbers in a vast palace on one of Erden's moons.

It is said that if one were to visit her there, she would rise from her sleep and offer the visitor a prophecy of their future. Most of Erden's mythical heroes are said to have received advice from her, aiding them in fulfilling their grand destinies.

However, these legends offer no hints as to how to get to her palace in the first place. Various plans have been devised, such as building some kind of flying machine or creating a powerful teleportation spell, but only a handful of eccentrics have actually attempted them. Most become discouraged by recurring dreams of their plans failing, often in an extremely spectacular fashion.

MoonGoddess02.description:
When Artimeia sleeps, she dreams of the future. But because the future is a tangled web of various possibilities, choices, and fates, Artimeia must sleep for ages at a time to properly understand how her actions might change outcomes. 

Thus, she tries to minimize her role as much as possible in the events that unfold in Erden, taking action only if it's absolutely necessary to ensure the world's survival. This usually amounts to only granting grains of advice to the right people at the right time. However, she understands that dire times call for more dire measures, and she will occasionally join a potential hero to help them fulfill their destiny.

"I heard that she fought by my father's side in the last Pandemonium."

DeathKnight01.name: Merdain
DeathKnight01.title: Knight of Vengeance
DeathKnight01.description:
A former knight of Hymelia, and member of the lowest rank of nobility. His father Artorias began his career as a common footsoldier, but his skills saw him promoted to General and earned him land and a noble title. Having the greatest admiration for his father, Merdain followed in his footsteps, and he quickly became a very promising knight, despite the derision he endured for his low rank and common origins.
However, the nobles of the Senate conspired against Artorias, and he fell on the battlefield, leaving Merdain torn between his loyalty and vengeance.

WhiteKnight01.title: Fighter Against Fate
WhiteKnight01.description:
A knight of Hymelia. Unlike his childhood friend Merdain, he comes from a high-ranking, long-standing noble house. He was sickly and weak as a child, but he forced himself to keep up with his friends Merdain and Maxima, overcame his weakness, and is now an outstanding knight.
Lucius strongly respected Merdain's father Artorias, who rose from the rank of footsoldier to the rank of General, and then to nobility. He sees Artorias as proof that anything is possible if you work hard, and believes he can overcome his illness too if he only works hard enough.

DevilLady01.title: Bearer of Corpses
DevilLady01.description:
One of the Oracles, the nine spirits who protect and oversee Avalon. Her main job is to retrieve the corpses of those who return to Avalon, and unlike her elder sister Le Fay, she doesn't often interact with living humans.
She cares the most about keeping the peace on the island, and if outside invaders ever arrive on Avalon, she's the first one to engage them in battle. Despite her slender build, she is monstrously strong. Generally speaking, the other eight Oracles never even have a chance to fight before the battle is over.

"He says he is building a raft. It is amusing, watching him struggle with the trees and vines."

WaterPriestess02.name: Esma
WaterPriestess02.title: Bride of the Sea
WaterPriestess02.description:
Though a demure and gentle ruler now, Esma used to be quite a tomboy, sneaking out of the palace to go down to the docks, listen to the pirates' tales of their exploits, and dream of the world on the other side of the ocean.
\Over the course of her visits, she fell in love with a dashing young pirate; but he refused her feelings. Heartbroken, in a moment of weakness, she prayed to Nautica for revenge... and upon hearing that his ship had been lost to the sea, she realized that she had done something unforgivable. The regret still torments her, but the harsh lesson helped shape her into the responsible monarch she is today.

SwimsuitLudmilla02.description:
Laomis: the glimmering pearl of the South Seas. Every Riglander dreams of visiting this tropical paradise at least once, and the Red Dragon Knights' hard-headed Marshal is no exception. However, with all of her responsibilities, it seemed like a faraway dream within a dream. She had halfway given up when Queen Esma's invitation descended like a gift from on high.
"I cannot afford to fail on this mission. I must enjoy myself to the fullest...!"

WaterLancerGirl01.title: Blue Hurricane
WaterLancerGirl01.description:
Despite her young age, Adena is the first mate and right hand of Dargarossa, the fearsome Bane of the Ashiran Sea. While on her way to be sold as a slave in a far-off land, her ship was raided by Dargarossa and she was freed; with nowhere else to go, she decided to stick around, and became a pirate. Though free-spirited, she respects Dargarossa deeply.
When the call to board is sounded and the battle is joined, she's the first one across the gap, leaping to the deck of the other ship and laying waste around her with her spear. Despite her young age, the crew respects her second only to the Captain himself, and they call her "Sis".

AngelFighter01.name: Maxima
AngelFighter01.title: Fiery Princess
AngelFighter01.description:
The eldest daughter of the Hymelian royal family. Though a princess, she is strong-willed and a highly skilled warrior, so she often fights on the front lines. The pride of the Hymelian Knights, Merdain, can just about hold his own with her. Their other childhood friend, Lucius, has practically never beaten her in any contest.
The nobility and conservative voices in government disapprove of her un-princesslike behavior, at least behind closed doors, but soldiers and the common people adore her.
In every generation, at least one member of the Hymelian royal family has a contract with the primeval fire spirit Volcana. Currently, that responsibility falls to Maxima. Volcana has a particular soft spot for the gallant and brave Maxima, and Maxima views the flame spirit less as an object of worship, and more as a sometimes harsh, but loving mother.

AngelFighter02.description:
Maxima was quite a tomboy in her youth, and she would sneak out of the palace to play with her friends Merdain and Lucius. She was repeatedly told not to associate with Merdain because of his low standing, but rather than obey, she wondered why people had to be so cruel to one of her best friends.
Spending time outside the palace, Maxima had many chances to interact with common-born soldiers and smallfolk, and she began to question the nobility's focus on bloodline. Why should the house someone is born into dictate their worth in life? Eventually, she realized that she wanted to change her country.

ElminaRegular01.name: Elmina
ElminaRegular01.title: Void Renegade
ElminaRegular01.description:
Every thief comes with her own sad story, but Elmina's is especially heinous. Living as a street urchin in Hymelia, the sweet words of a Gru Grimm preacher drew her in. He promised he could numb her pain, erase her history, and give her the power to do as she pleased, as long as she would swear her life to his mysterious god. She did -- and soon came to find that in doing so, she swore away her very free will.

Nowadays, she'd sooner swallow coals than follow orders. Sure, not everyone in authority is as evil as the cult that stole her youth, but she isn't taking any more chances. She is more than happy to help her friends -- but she will never spill blood again for what she doesn't believe is right.

"Aww, kiddo. You didn't have to, I was going to take care of that tonight myself."

"I know. But you've been so busy with your new friends. I thought you'd want to spend some more time with them instead of doing chores at home."

IceWitch01.name: Yuki
IceWitch01.title: Born of Winter
IceWitch01.description:
Born at the height of a historic snow storm, Yuki has always had coldness flowing through her veins. As a baby, she would summon snow flurries to rock her own cradle. As a child, she would freeze a nearby lake to go ice skating at the height of summer. Her friends and family marveled at her powers...for a time. But the human heart is a fearful and jealous one, unable to abide what it can't understand. On the eve of her eighteenth birthday, the village elders exiled her, swearing to her a swift sword to the neck should she return.

Their mistake was in thinking that she'd ever want to.

IceWitch02.name: Yuki
IceWitch02.title: Born of Winter
IceWitch02.description:
Yuki made work for herself as a wandering mage for several years. She flitted from noble to noble who wanted the services of the famed Winter Witch, either for entertainment or for war. The spectacle of animating ice sculptures and burying opposing armies under snow was amusing, but without fail, she would grow bored with her master's mundane tasks and set off to find another. Erden, it seemed, held little of interest to a living force of nature. That is, until the Pandemonium began.

Rody and his friends approached her with neither fear nor gold, only a request that she use her immense power to help slay the Eternal. The prospect intrigued Yuki enough for her to comply.

If she'd known how their quest would end, she'd never have dared.

LegendFireDragon01.name: Fornaxos
LegendFireDragon01.title: Flame Incarnate
LegendFireDragon01.description:
Long ago, in the time of the first Pandemonium, Fornaxos inherited the power of flame and became one of the six Legendary Dragons that embody the elements of Erden. Tasked with defeating the Eternal, he knew that untempered fire would destroy more than it would save. In his humility, he retreated to a lone mountain to hone his power and train for the battle to come.

Settlers who ventured too far up that mountain would return bearing tales of a shining creature who split the night sky with pillars of flame. Thus, the villagers came to call their home Mount Fornax, in honor of the dragon who shared it with them. Most have now forgotten why the rocky peak bears that name...but just enough of the story survives to inspire travelers to make the climb, in the hope that they'll see a legend in the flesh.

Fornaxos spent centuries alone, preparing himself to one day face the godlike Eternal. Now that the threat is vanquished, he finds himself a bit perplexed at his existence. If his purpose was to end the Pandemonium, and a group of mortals completed that purpose for him, what right does he have to call himself a legendary guardian of Erden?

After some thought, he has decided to leave the lonely summit of Mount Fornax to explore the world beyond. His brethren, the five other Legendary Dragons, must be facing the same conundrum that he is, now that the world is free. Perhaps with them by his side, he can forge a new legend to fulfill.

FireGirlWarrior01.description:
During the third Pandemonium, the legendary Fire Dragon Fornaxos saved a human man from certain death. To show his eternal gratitude, the man swore that his bloodline would stand guard over and sanctify Fornaxos's mountain until the end of days. Thus, Antares' ancestor decided her fate centuries before she was born.

She doesn't begrudge him this, of course. Antares has always been happy to have a purpose, even if it was one she never chose herself. Still, some days she finds her eyes wandering to the village at the foot of the mountain, far from the sacred ground she cares for all alone.

Just who are these people that Fornaxos works so hard to protect?

BabyDarkDragon01.name: Crescent
BabyDarkDragon01.title: Fledgling Shadow
BabyDarkDragon01.description:
"Bad boy, Crescent! Bad! Bad!"

"Kyuu..."

"What'd the dragon do this time?"

"I hope you didn't want dinner tonight, Solas, because our eggs have vanished."

"What do you mean? Did they roll out of your basket again?"

"Of course not! I was just putting the pepper on my omelette when Crescent sneezed on it, or something. This black stuff came out of his mouth instead of fire --"

"Black stuff? Like tar?"

"No, like a shadow. Or a bit of night. I don't know. Anyway, it hit the eggs and made them disappear, so Crescent's not getting any more grapes for a week. Hmph."

"Kyuu..."

BabyDarkDragon02.name: Crescent
BabyDarkDragon02.title: Fledgling Shadow
BabyDarkDragon02.description:
"Hey, Luna. Can I talk to you about Crescent?"

"Okay...but why? I thought I finally got him housebroken."

"You really haven't, but that's not why I'm worried. You know that shadow stuff he can breathe when he's surprised or angry?"

"Yeah?"

"I just found a book about dragons at the library. I tried to look up Crescent's species, but there wasn't a single mention of dragons who could breathe shadow. Not anywhere."

"Really? That's unbelievable..."

"I know. Given where we found him, we have to consider that Crescent might not be a normal --"

"Why would a library keep such an incomplete tome of monsters on its shelves?! Such unprofessionalism! I'm going to lodge a complaint."

"Luna..."

LudmillaRegular01.name: Ludmilla
LudmillaRegular01.title: Crimson Valkyrie
LudmillaRegular01.description:
Among the noble houses of Rigland, House Aldyne boasts one of the longest and proudest pedigrees, and some of the fiercest warriors ever to face the Pandemonium.
Ludmilla, the family's only daughter, was raised to be demure, retiring, and modest; but her family's blood burned strong in her.
A noble soul from birth, she stood up against injustice, even to adults, and protected the weak when they could not protect themselves, despite her parents' protests.
Somehow, it still came as a surprise to her family when she ran away from her sheltered life, joined the Red Dragon Knights, and stepped into the history books as a champion.

LudmillaRegular02.name: Ludmilla
LudmillaRegular02.title: Crimson Valkyrie
LudmillaRegular02.description:
"Hey, Boss! We got trouble! The Red Dragon Knights were spotted in a village nearby!"
"Calm down. We just need to make ourselves scarce before—"
"Too late! Throw down your weapons, bandit scum!"
"What?! The Crimson Valkyrie?!"
"But how?! That village is hours from here!"
"Unfortunately for you, we run this far before breakfast every morning. In armor. Isn't that right?"
"R-right, Captain..."
"Damn...we'll have to fight! They'll be tired from the march! Kill 'em!"
"How considerate! We won't have to chase you down. Red Dragon Knights, draw arms!"

NorzaRegular02.name: Norza
NorzaRegular02.title: Blade of the Aeons
NorzaRegular02.description:
The young man traveled the land, seeking the strongest warriors he could find.
As he was already a peerless swordsman, most duels ended quickly. On the rare occasions he was at a disadvantage, he would retreat and return again the next day, until he won.

Those he defeated, he slew without mercy. True power can only be found beyond the boundary of life and death.
Standing over the bodies of his opponents filled him with a rush of power.

Still not enough. I can get stronger still. I must get stronger still. I must defeat stronger foes.
The avarice in his heart drew him ever onward, fleeing from the powerlessness he felt that day.

Arga01.name: Druke
Arga01.title: Apex Blademaster
Arga01.description:
Druke's father was a skilled blacksmith, his name known across South Rigland.
Warriors would come from all over, crossing the brutal Habsu Desert just to buy his wares.
However, his son possessed no skill for the forge at all.
Though he worried for his son, the blacksmith took a local boy, Gilgan, as his apprentice and successor, and Druke lived his teenage years shiftless and ill-content.
However...one night, a bandit snuck into the forge while the boys' parents were out.
Gilgan advised caution, but Druke seized one of his father's blades from the wall and struck the thief down.
It was as if Druke had cut the haze from his thoughts with the same blow.
Though his parents scolded him, Druke felt certain. Forging weapons was not the only way to live by the sword.

RibbonStudent01.name: Greta
RibbonStudent01.title: Storm-Inspired Inventor
RibbonStudent01.description:
Greta is going to change the world someday. Everyone in her village told her so when she was a child, so it must be true. She has everything a visionary needs: a whip-smart mind, a tireless work ethic, and perhaps most importantly, a total lack of common sense. She dreams of one day capturing lightning in a bottle, so that the people of Erden can have as much light as they want, whenever they want.

A traveling Winvy merchant -- who has gone by many names, but who she knows as Mr. Beauregard Chancy -- saw the potential of her idea when she chased him down at the market fair one day. He agreed to put her through sorcery school in exchange for the exclusive right to sell her invention once she has a working model.

It's been three years. It must be coming any day now.

RibbonStudent02.name: Greta
RibbonStudent02.title: Storm-Inspired Inventor
RibbonStudent02.description:
There's nothing Greta loves more than a good thunderstorm. She goes out in them to take notes whenever she can; she'll drag herself out in her pajamas, if she has to. You must first understand something to tame it, and after three years, Greta understands lightning as much as anyone can. Still, the pouring rain and rolling thunder relax her, so she continues studying anyway.

Storms have always been her friend. Once, when she was very young, she fell asleep reading by candlelight. The wax dripped onto her straw bed, and in minutes, her home went up in flames. Only a passing thundercloud saved her family's lives. She'll never forget how bright the lightning was that split the sky that night.

She's chased it ever since.

DeathLich01.title: Champion of the Black Flames
DeathLich01.description:
The servants of Orcanix know no death. Should they be reduced to dust, their master will summon them to her Pyre and create their bodies anew. Even so, nothing can be destroyed again and again without consequence.

The Paladins have no flesh, no blood. Some have lost even their bones, existing more as ghostly wraiths than moving corpses. They would wear their twisted husks with pride, if they could feel such things. But rebirth demands a price far beyond the physical, and they have paid in full.

Nothing remains inside them but bloodlust and blind obedience.

The armies of Orcanix revere their Paladins almost as much as they revere the goddess herself. Some have existed for centuries, before the war with the mortal kingdoms. Some have shed the blood of kings, some have slaughtered dragons. All leave legends in their wake.

NovaBlastDragon01.name: Altaireon
NovaBlastDragon01.title: Soul of the Storm
NovaBlastDragon01.description:
When the Primordial Dragon of Storm fell in the first battle with the Eternal, he died too quickly to choose his successor. Desperately, he let a portion of his power fly into the world, to choose and grow within whatever it might find. It was reckless. It could spell disaster if the power of the heavens landed in the wrong hands. But he had no other choice.

As it happened, a hatchling crawled out of his cave to hunt for scraps. He had been cast away from his brethren, too small and skittish to call himself a dragon. Had he hid a moment longer, he might have died a runt, forgotten and inconsequential. But that was not to be his fate.

Altaireon stepped beneath the open sky, and the power of the storm struck him like a bolt of lightning.

NovaBlastDragon02.name: Altaireon
NovaBlastDragon02.title: Soul of the Storm
NovaBlastDragon02.description:
For many years, he resented and feared his new powers. He could barely control the thunder in his veins, and worse, he had done nothing to earn it. But after a century of fleeing the storms that dogged his steps, Altaireon decided he could run no more. Erden cried out for a savior to break the brutal cycle of the Pandemonium. He was not worthy to be that savior -- not yet. But he could become worthy. He owed it to the heavens that had gifted him their fury.

The young Legendary Dragon sharpened his claws and got to work.

Success did not come quickly. A storm resists taming by its very nature; if he isn't worthy, even a dragon will find himself at the mercy of the winds. After months of fruitless effort, Altaireon found a group of mortal monks living secluded in the mountains. Though they had no power of their own, and no assurance of immortality, they sought whatever perfection they could achieve in their lives. Some wrote poetry, others performed martial arts. Some only meditated from dusk until dawn, pondering the reason for existence. These were not the cowardly mortals Altaireon had seen rise since the fall of the dragons. These were a cut above the rest. In some ways, they were even more than him.

He humbly submitted himself to their teaching, and though he lived to see the youngest of them wither and die, he could not have mastered the tumult of the storm without them.

DarkRizette01.description:
She doesn't know how many times she has died. They all blur together, a haze of pain, darkness, and brutal rebirth. There's no point in remembering them all, not when she'll live until the end of time.

But there was one death that mattered. Her first death. The one that should have been her last. She would give anything to forget, but it burns like a torch in her mind, as eternal as her master's black fire.

If Finn shares her tormented memory, he has never shown it. Beneath his twisted shell, he might have no memory at all.

DarkRizette02.title: Angel of Ruin
DarkRizette02.description:
None of them knew it would go so wrong.

The odds were always stacked against them. But Rei had gifted them her magic. Callen had forged their hero a holy sword. The people of Erden cheered for their victory, sending them off to the Endless Pyre with celebrations and songs.

For a time, they thought they had a chance.

They were fools to ever think so.

Gods are gods and men are men. Even with a legendary blade, Finn was doomed to fall. Looking back, Rizette wonders if she should have stood her ground. She wonders what might have happened if she hadn't given her life for his.

Would he still have betrayed them all?

ChristmasElmina01.title: Yuletide Rogue
ChristmasElmina01.description:
"Hey! Watch where you're going, you nearly made me drop my stuff!"

"What are you rushing around for, anyway? All the good stuff in this market's already been snatched up. Don't tell me you're one of those people who put their shopping off to the last minute."

"...sigh. Of course you are. I should have guessed."

"Well, don't just stand there. Follow me. I know a couple places that can help you out, but you better not do this again, you hear? The people in your life must really care about you. What's the point of Christmas if you don't give them something special?"

ChristmasElmina02.name: Elmina
ChristmasElmina02.title: Yuletide Rogue
ChristmasElmina02.description:
"Merry Christ -- what? You again? How'd you find out where I live?! If you followed me home, I swear..."

"One of the kids let you know, huh? I keep telling them not to bother with strangers, but they never seem to listen."

"Hey, you weren't a stranger, you were -- a charity case! You were wandering around so lost, it would have been bad karma to leave you on your own! Anyway, why did you even come here?"

"...to give me a thank you present. Yeah, right. There isn't a thing in the city left to buy."

"Huh? You made it yourself?"

"..."

"Guess it'd be even more bad karma to turn you away now. Fine, fine, come in. But watch where you're going. I didn't buy all these gifts just to have 'em stepped on."

NewYearRolotia01.name: Rolotia
NewYearRolotia01.title: Timeless Beauty
NewYearRolotia01.description:
As the avatar of Chronos, Rolotia dutifully watches over the year as it passes away. She feels the weariness of the land, strewn with bare forests and blanketed under snow. She sleeps by the side of hibernating animals, holed up in their dens. She knows, as the world does, that the end will soon arrive.

Quiet as a whisper, the world will begin anew. She will see this year from its winter birth to the heights of its summer, and though it too will die someday, she greets its first day with a smile.

NewYearRolotia02.title: Timeless Beauty
NewYearRolotia02.description:
Many people start the new year with self-reflection. With resolute hearts, they set out to be new people, free of the vices that have held them back. Rolotia observes these resolutions with glee, even knowing most of them will be broken. The first days of a year have a purity to them, a power that makes any dream appear within reach. If a single person sees their promises through, none of their failed resolutions were wasted.

She's no stranger to wanting a second chance.

ChristmasCatEar01.title: Snowkissed Maid
ChristmasCatEar01.description:
When she set out on her mercenary journey, Shanna thought she would only learn the ways of combat. As it happens, she's discovered Christmas too.

The human holiday mystifies her a bit. The saru are a generous people, but they are also practical. They exchange gifts all year long with little fanfare. So why do humans tie them up with bows and leave them under a tree? Why do they build cookie houses without eating them? Why do people gather to sing songs in the snow? Aren't they cold?

There's much she still needs to learn, but she thinks she likes this strange celebration of theirs.

ChristmasCatEar02.description:
"Oh, you made it! Welcome!"

"Do you want some eggnog? A candy cane? How about a gingerbread man?"

"The market didn't have any more turkies, so I caught one myself! Did I make it right? It's over there, next to the pancakes. Go sit by the fire, I'll bring you some!"

"Huh? Why did I make all of this for you? It's Christmas, isn't it?"

"...n-not for two more days?"

"..."

"Just think of it like a Christmas ambush, okay?"

ChineseRizette01.description:
Rizette has never spent a New Year in the capital.

She's heard the stories, of course. Dancers puppeting magnificent dragons weave up and down the streets; revelers light the moonless sky with fireworks and lantern light. Families will travel from across the kingdom to spend one night at home, and everyone's made so much food, not a soul goes hungry.

To a country girl like her, it sounds too exciting to be real. But she does have a question.

What is she to wear on a night as grand as that?

ChineseRizette02.description:
Rizette's hometown welcomed the New Year warmly, but with little fanfare. She remembers the fragrant bread and soup her mother would make, how she and Theo would run around the house, banishing evil spirits with brooms and feather dusters. After dinner, with bellies full and fire crackling, her father would lean back in his chair and read from their book of fairy tales. Theo always fell asleep before he finished.

Compared to the lanterns and fireworks of the capital, the New Year of her home is nothing. But she misses it all the same.

EarthKaiju01.description:
Long, long ago, a destitute kingdom fell under siege. Fearing his people's poverty would mean their downfall, the king commissioned a group of alchemists to craft him an endless source of gold.

After some months, the alchemists presented him with a tiny beast. In front of him, they fed it scrap metal, spoiled food, all manner of the kingdom's waste -- and he watched as horns of solid gold grew on its body.

The king wept for joy, for with this monster, he'd saved his kingdom.

Or so he thought.

Months passed. The relentless war continued, and even with the gold from the beast's severed horns, the kingdom could not push the enemy back. Desperate, the king begged the alchemists to push the creature further. To feed it more and more. To curse it with hunger so great, it could never stop eating.

There was a world before the wall.

A world before black rain, and dragonfire, and rations that never last. A world before the undead, where the sky shone bright and the spring brought flowers.

She has never seen such things herself. The monstrous goddess started her war before she was ever born, leaving her with nothing but legends and tales of days gone by. Most these days don't have even that, so beaten down by the undead siege that every hope has fled them.

But not her. Never her.

Even knowing they will die, the sakuras bloom. And so will she.

Though her village was little more than a farming settlement by the time it fell, it guarded an ancient samurai fortress. The last lord to reside in that fortress met his death at the hands of the undead. Now, like everything else, it sits abandoned.

Shiori has never set foot inside it herself. As bodyguards of the samurai, her family was not permitted within its walls without their master's blessing.

DancingAssassin01.title: Silk-Veiled Siren
DancingAssassin01.description:
―― Beginning mission report.

I've just departed Hymelian territory. Duke Valenne welcomed me to his feast most warmly, and his son even more so. I fortuitously happened by his bedroom in the morning -- just in time to be caught. Your wisdom proved invaluable yet again, master. The flustered lover truly is my most convincing mask.

The rumor mill has already started churning. As you requested, the boy is unharmed, though I can't say the same for his reputation. I expect his betrothed's house to call things off within the month, which is a problem solved for us.

I remain your faithful servant. For the glory of Bergaria.

DancingAssassin02.description:
―― Beginning mission report.

I thank you for this assignment, master. Every day I am away from Bergaria, I long to return. To work the Emperor's will in his own domain is my highest honor.

The upstart senator was bold to throw a ball while so publicly defying his regent. I've seen to his punishment. The toxin I slipped into his wine shrivels the body from the inside out. Make no mistake: everyone will know he was poisoned, and everyone will know why.

I remain your faithful servant. For the glory of Bergaria.

BatWingWarrior01.description:
In a war on life itself, every death is a victory. Whether claimed in glory or claimed in the dark, it matters not; only that another soul has been brought into the fold. Few have shepherded more souls to the Goddess than the dreaded Endless Phantoms.

Some say the shadowy assassins armor themselves in the bones of their victims. Whether that's true, none can say. They move through the night indistinguishable as shadow, and all who come close enough to see the make of their armor are already good as dead.

BatWingWarrior02.description:
Every so often, a new undead convert catches the goddess's eye. An honored knight, a well-respected mage, a particularly clever thief; when these souls succumb to her black flame, she molds their bodies for a special purpose.

The Endless Phantoms bear no trace of their previous lives. They possess no will of their own and rarely speak. No one living knows why they were chosen for their grim task. Some believe they emerged, whole and monstrous, from the Endless Pyre itself. But they are wrong.

Orcanix's assassins were as monstrous in life as they are in undeath.

WindDragon01.description:
"Day 26, on the road to elven lands:

I have slept in my saddle now for three days straight. Our caravan leader insists he will not stop until he spies a baby Aethrodon -- the blasted things appear only in total safety, he says. Camping anywhere else would doom us all, he says.

Confound these elves. Pandemonium or not, we're armed to the teeth. I think we can take our chances, tiny lizard's blessing be damned."

-- From The Travels of Caerwyn

"Day 31, in the heart of the elven forests:

I'd seen nothing like it in all my days. Bedecked in bronze armor, brilliant as a shard of the summer sky -- this, I asked, is what comes of those skittish creatures we glimpsed on the road?

'Why else would we wait to see one before we camp?' the chieftain answered me. 'Wherever a young Aethrodon wanders, its mother guards its path. No enemy would dare approach.'"

-- From The Travels of Caerwyn

DarkLudmilla01.description:
No one has arrived late to an inspection in six months. No one would dare. Not with the Queen of Valkyries heading the Vanguard.

As a city under constant siege, Last Bastion can't afford imperfection in its soldiers, as she so frequently reminds them. A single mistake could cost lives. Either her men rise to her standards, or they forfeit their place in her service. Time is a precious resource, and Ludmilla will waste none of it on mercy.

The goddess certainly won't.

DarkLudmilla02.title: Savior of the Living City
DarkLudmilla02.description:
She knows they call her a tyrant. In the shadows of the city she fights so hard to protect, she knows her people curse her name.

They have their reasons: hunger, cold, exhaustion. She was but a child when the invasion began, but the living complained of the very same in the world before. Perhaps some things never change. Or perhaps, no matter their circumstances, people find a way to be discontent.

It doesn't matter. Let them mutter and curse as much as they please. As long as they survive their wretched nights, she has done her duty.

DarkAstrid01.name: Endless Astrid
DarkAstrid01.title: Voice of Defiance
DarkAstrid01.description:
There is no rebellion in Last Bastion. There is no rebellion in Last Bastion. There is no rebellion in Last Bastion.

The Vanguard like to think it will become true if they say it enough, but they know they are kidding themselves. A year ago, the missing supplies, the vandalism, even the accidents could be waved away as the work of disorganized malcontents. Today, they are too frequent, too directed against the city's tyrannical leader. A reckoning, long overdue, will soon arrive.

She will not be silenced now. She has waited far too long.

DarkAstrid02.description:
Stories of the rebel leader pervade Last Bastion's populace, whispered so as not to attract a passing patrol's attention. Spreading rumors of subversion is tantamount to treason in a city that depends so heavily on its unity, but even so, the lure of the forbidden keeps Astrid's infamy alive.

The stories say she can take on six soldiers at once, that she can move without a sound, that no one has ever seen her sleep. But for every believer who marvels at her deeds, another skeptic scoffs.

Surely if she possessed such power, she would have already won.

Cyrus01.description:
The Devil. Fifteenth Arcana of the Tarot. The card of duplicity, corruption, and inescapable fate.

Cyrus learned to read the cards as a boy, the poor bastard of a lord. Even as a child, he was no fool; his use to his father would end the moment his wife bore him a true heir. Rather than wait to be unceremoniously murdered, he ran away and joined an underground ring of thieves masquerading as soothsayers and fortune tellers. His skill with a deck served him well, but unlike his comrades, Cyrus told no lies.

The misfortunes he predicted had a way of coming true.

Cyrus02.description:
The Tower. Sixteenth Arcana of the Tarot. The card of suffering, disaster, and unforeseen consequences.

It was a simple enough job. A mercenary named Rody hired him to investigate a collapsing mine. Nothing more than a tidy purse of gold should have come of it. But somehow, Cyrus found himself embroiled in a fight to save the world.

The others at Rody's side were good, honest. Not like him. They played their parts in the grand pantomime well, but he could see the Pandemonium for what it was. A scheme.

Somewhere, someone was pulling their strings, and when everything finally went wrong, he vowed to find out who.

RizetteNew01.description:
They came in numbers Rigland couldn't hope to match. They armed themselves with technology the world had never seen. And when the time came to stand against them, the Red Dragon Knights crumbled from the inside. Not even at the height of the Pandemonium had the future seemed so bleak.

But Rizette had no choice but to move forward.

With her brother at her side, she fled the fallen capital and returned to her hometown: the ruined Westcarte, where her adventure began. Once more, in a place of desolation, hope would rise anew.

Though her kingdom is conquered, its people aren't yet crushed. No matter what indignities the Bergarian soldiers force upon them, no matter the oppression they face, they know that somewhere out there, someone is fighting for their freedom. And they want to aid her however they can.

At the very whisper of Rizette's presence, crates of food and weapons appear at her door. Recruits band together, crude weapons in hand, untrained but ready to fight.

Her rebellion may be young, as fragile as a fawn finding its legs, but as long as Rigland's spirit burns bright, she knows she has nothing to fear.

Gloria01.title: Gilded Heiress
Gloria01.description:
Gloria Valen, daughter of Maximilius Valen, was born under a lucky star. Her mother told her so every day of her childhood. Gloria believed it until the day she died, leaving her in the sole care of her cruel and miserly father. Somehow, her stars never seemed so lucky after that.

She never wanted for material comfort. Her father's profound wealth bought her the finest cuisine, the most elegant fashion, and invitations to every noble estate in Bergaria. For many it would have been enough, but like any true heiress, she dreamed of more.

She dreamed of a life worth more than her family name.

Gloria02.name: Gloria
Gloria02.title: Gilded Heiress
Gloria02.description:
Unlike most Bergarian nobility, Gloria's father gathered his fortune not through inheritance, but through business. His eye for rich alchemical ore made him a talented magical merchant, selling enchanted weapons to the highest bidder regardless of allegiance or creed. Unsurprisingly, this earned him many enemies; Gloria grew up dodging kidnappers and assassins alike.

Lord Valen always believed his daughter's greatest worth to him would be her eventual marriage. He never saw the way she tinkered with his cast-off gems. He never saw the way she found beauty and power in what he rejected.

But one day -- maybe thanks to that lucky star of hers -- someone else did.

SpearGirlWarrior01.title: Spritely Spearmaster
SpearGirlWarrior01.description:
Lillian Rosalinde von Dreyer was born with a certain problem. Since its founding, her bloodline has been known for two things: indefatigable spirit and truly enormous size. The story goes that, after giving birth to five strapping boys, her mother swore that her sixth would be the strongest warrior of them all. So, naturally, Lillian arrived not only small for her family, but small for any Hymelian.

Only the foolish dare bring up this little legend around her, however. She tends to challenge anyone who does to a duel, to prove that her mother's prediction was in no way false.

SpearGirlWarrior02.name: Lillian
SpearGirlWarrior02.title: Spritely Spearmaster
SpearGirlWarrior02.description:
Lillian's father worried that having five elder brothers might overwhelm a dainty little girl. However, his worry soon proved to be quite unfounded. More often than not, Lillian was the one who sent her brothers running, beating them back from her dolls with a tree branch spear. When they heard of the Hymelian princess's penchant for combat, Lillian's parents sent her to be her handmaiden -- or perhaps, more accurately, her apprentice.

 Though Maxima fights with a sword instead of a spear, Lillian has taken her aggressive philosophy quite to heart. In battle, she ensures her opponents never gain an inch on her allies, no matter what she has to do.

Crescent01.name: Diabolos
Crescent01.title: Dragon Lord of Shadow
Crescent01.description: His name is Crescent, and he's a very happy dragon. Or at least, he used to be. He doesn't remember all that much. One day, there was nothing but the dark. The next day, there were Luna, and Solas, and the girl with the fluffy white hair. And grapes! He had no reason not to be happy in a world with grapes and good friends. But one day, that stopped being enough. Something inside him, like a shadow on a moonless night, started following him. Whispering to him. There's more than this. More than this. Remember. Crescent doesn't know if he wants to. He thinks, if he does, he might never be happy again.

Crescent02.description: Diabolos... The voice in Crescent's mind haunts him with that name. Diabolos. Not Crescent. Diabolos. You are Diabolos. He doesn't want that awful name. It sounds ancient, larger than he is, cursed with history he can't remember. Suddenly, his days with Luna and Solas seem so small, a speck of happiness against a shadow that threatens to consume him. He wants to protect his friends. He wants to stand by their side forever. But if he is Diabolos, and if the shadow inside him one day shows him its secrets... Will they even want to be near him?

Kisara01.name: Kisara
Kisara01.title: Blade of the Summer Sun
Kisara01.description:
The villagers called little Kisara the terror of their town.

No corner of their farming hamlet was spared her whirlwind mischief. The young girl practically vibrated with energy -- energy her traditional, rule-abiding parents couldn't handle. The more they forced her into chores and quiet reading, the more she rebelled, mouthing off to anyone who'd listen and breaking valuable tools in the name of playing 'samurai.' 

At their wits' end, her mother and father attempted to betroth her to a wealthy merchant in the city, but a wandering swordsman instead asked for the chance to take Kisara on as his apprentice. He alone saw the burning heart her misbehavior masked.

Kisara02.name: Kisara
Kisara02.title: Blade of the Summer Sun
Kisara02.description:
At first, Kisara rebelled against her master's strictness. She had an undeniable talent for the sword. He'd even told her so. Why did he insist on repetitive drills, boring meals, and hours upon hours of meditation?

He replied that meditation nourished her mind, rice nourished her body, and drills nourished her blade. Should any one of these things go dull, all the talent in the world couldn't keep her alive.

Eventually, she saw the wisdom of his words, and channeled her boundless energy into a signature fighting style. Long before she left her master, tales of her unrelenting speed and strength made her enemies tremble.
