RolotiaRegular01.name: Rolotia
RolotiaRegular01.title: Sorceress of Dawn
RolotiaRegular01.description:
In ancient times, Bergaria was not a vast, imposing empire, but a scattered collection of tribes. The harsh mountains left little room to farm, so famines came both fierce and frequent. If they hoped to survive, peasants would have to swear their service to a warlord, turning their eyes away from the cruelty they inflicted.

The priestesses of Chronos, hidden in a northern temple, were spared their land's turmoil. In exchange for keeping watch over time's flow, the Primordial granted them both safety and power. In all of Erden, only they could manipulate time. 

Rolotia, gifted with the most prodigious time magic seen in generations, always felt that fate was more a curse than a blessing.

RolotiaRegular02.title: Sorceress of Dawn
RolotiaRegular02.description:
As a child, Rolotia drove the other priestesses to no end of frustration. Though she was never malicious, never drunk on her own power, she proved too spirited to abide by the order's rules of isolation. Her eyes forever strayed to the horizon. Had she not been such a prodigy, perhaps the elders might have let her go. But doing so would have been too great a risk.

Before long, their indecision became their undoing. One morning, when the priestesses went to wake Rolotia for prayer, they found her staff gone and her bedroom empty. She had frozen time and escaped into the world so long forbidden to her.

TimeWitch01.name: Gemina
TimeWitch01.title: Devoted Timekeeper
TimeWitch01.description:
Deep within the northernmost mountains of Bergaria, an order of secretive priestesses makes their home. Few know of their existence, and even fewer could locate them if pressed. Long ago, Chronos herself gifted their ancestors with power over time, a gift she bestowed only on them. If time magic were to spread among the peoples of Erden, history itself could dissolve into a meaningless paradox.

And so it is the priestesses' duty to watch the flow of time, ever neutral, ever detached from the world. It is a peaceful life, free of worry. Few acolytes find reason to complain.

But Gemina's curiosity was much too great to let her remain an observer.

TimeWitch02.description:
Gemina heard legends as she was growing up. Cautionary tales of a priestesses who ran from the temple and caused untold disaster. Her elders used their tragic fates to scare the acolytes into compliance. Gemina, however, would not be swayed.

She understood the importance of her order's neutrality. Those trusted to oversee time itself had a great responsibility, greater than most in Erden would ever have to face. But how could the guardians of history perform their duty if the world was nothing to them but a collection of sad stories?

That is why she ran away. Gemina escaped the priestesses' temple not to defile her duty, but to embrace its truest purpose.

Jeanne01.title: Maiden of Radiance
Jeanne01.description:
Jeanne and Mikaela d'Arc were born a strange set of twins. Mikaela arrived first, a few minutes before the last midnight of winter, while Jeanne came in the first hours of spring. The town priestess insisted the birth was an omen from His Radiance, though she never said what it foretold.

Though technically the same age, it seemed only natural to call Mikaela the older sister. She was, after all, the more outgoing one, the braver one. The town cooed over her, the little warrior, so devoted to seeing Jeanne safe and happy.

And Jeanne loved Mikaela more than anyone in the world.

Jeanne02.name: Jeanne d'Arc
Jeanne02.title: Maiden of Radiance
Jeanne02.description:
Though Jeanne often stayed in the shadow of her sister, the village noticed her piety. She obeyed the church's teachings, prayed often, and helped who she could in her own shy way. Many suspected she would become the priestess's acolyte when she came of age, just as they said Mikaela would join the holy army.

Sadly, neither would come to pass.

When the war took a turn for the worse, their village found itself alone in the dark, without defense. Jeanne and Mikaela ran for the church together, hoping that if they reached its sacred ground, they'd be safe.

They were right: the demons couldn't breach the church. But only Jeanne made it there alive.

AxeAngel01.name: Eveline
AxeAngel01.title: Pious Acolyte
AxeAngel01.description:
It is a terrible thing to grow up in war. But while Eveline was young, the demons seemed so far away. The type of thing only soldiers worried about. The power of His Radiance and the Holy Maiden kept the rest of them safe.

Mikaela, Eveline's longtime friend, always boasted that she would join the army when she grew up. Eveline wished she could share her courage. She longed to serve her god and her kingdom, but her strength was never in swordsmanship. It was in her piety, which was rivaled only by little Jeanne, and in her wit, which was rivaled by none.

AxeAngel02.description:
When the demons finally swept through their village, she tried to help Jeanne through her loss. Mikaela had given strength to them both, but as important as she'd been to Eveline, to Jeanne, she was irreplaceable. And now she was gone.

In the end, the grief turned too much to bear. Eveline pledged herself as an acolyte to the church and gradually lost touch with her old friend. But she never forgot about her, and she never lost faith that someday, light would return to her life.

That faith would be rewarded a thousand times over in the years to come.

RolotiaSwimsuit01.name: Rolotia
RolotiaSwimsuit01.title: Lady of Eternal Summer
RolotiaSwimsuit01.description:
Growing up in the mountains of Bergaria, Rolotia knew only chilly springs, frost-kissed autumns, and winters so bitter they killed all memory of warmth.

Now that she's made it to the beach for the first time, she's as thrilled as she is overwhelmed. The sun shines so strongly she can feel its rays brush her skin. The sea stretches from her feet to the horizon, free and untamed, nothing like the icy peaks that shadowed her childhood.

If this is summer, she never wants it to end.

RolotiaSwimsuit02.name: Rolotia
RolotiaSwimsuit02.title: Lady of Eternal Summer
RolotiaSwimsuit02.description:
Rolotia loves the beach. She'd much rather race across golden sand than harsh, glinting snow. Unfortunately, sunshine and her pale northern skin don't get along well.

After that first day, which saw her going to bed a painful shade of crimson, Rolotia has come prepared. She persuaded Rizette to part with some sun-cloaking cream in exchange for a few magically extended moments with Finn. She made herself an oasis of shade with her umbrella. But what is she to do when she wants to join her friends in the water?

Perhaps a hat can keep the sun away.

ElminaSwimsuit01.name: Elmina
ElminaSwimsuit01.title: Sunkissed Mirage
ElminaSwimsuit01.description:
People stare at Elmina no matter where she goes.

In human kingdoms, they stare because she's an elf. In the fair-skinned north, her tan draws curious attention. And when she's on the beach...well. She could do without the open-mouthed stares, but she likes bikinis best, so that's what she'll wear.

To tell the truth, being noticed takes some getting used to for a former street kid. That's why she learned to be stealthy. Keeping invisible saved her hide too many times to count, but it's no way to live. Not anymore.

She can slip into shadow whenever she wants. Why not enjoy a day in the sun?

ElminaSwimsuit02.name: Elmina
ElminaSwimsuit02.title: Sunkissed Mirage
ElminaSwimsuit02.description:
Elmina didn't grow up with tropical heat, but she thinks it suits her. Humidity works wonders for her complexion, and the sun brings out the natural highlights in her hair. She doesn't have to worry about burns much either, though Callen still lectures her until she puts on proper protection.

Still, when the sun grows too bright even for her, she enjoys a cool retreat into the forest. Walking through the shade at the hottest time of day is a rare pleasure for one used to shivering in the cold.

And stumbling upon an unexpected waterfall? That's the kind of memory that begs to be shared with another.

DancingAssassinSwimsuit01.title: Sweet Beach Temptation
DancingAssassinSwimsuit01.description: "My sweet angel, I'm heeeeere! We made it to the island at last. At last. I thought that horrible boat trip would never end. All those storms, all those people packed so close together. It's a miracle I didn't lose any of my things! (Don't worry, I checked my bags as soon as we docked. All my swimsuits are safe and sound∼) Wish you were with me, cuddlebug!" Shortly after landing at their island resort, a Hymelian noble was horrified to find her jewelry box had vanished. Alira stole it for the war effort, of course. But surely the emperor will let her keep a piece or two for herself.

DancingAssassinSwimsuit02.description:
"My most handsome darling,

Ugh. How gloomy everyone on this island is! Whenever I start to relax, someone has to bring up the invasion—or worse, the rebels. As soon as I get back, you owe me a kiss for each time I had to hear 'Blue Dragon Knights.' I'm warning you, it's a lot! ♡

Wish you were with me, pumpkin!"

In the middle of the night, resort guards arrested a wealthy merchant for treason. Supposedly, his secret correspondence with the Rigland resistance had been pinned to his door with knives. Alira usually prefers a more subtle approach, but this vacation put her in a more theatrical mood than usual.

AntaresSwimsuit01.title: Fiery Island Flower

She's conquered the art of monster raising, learned fire magic, and even made a friend or two along the way. But now, Antares faces her most daunting challenge yet. Before the summer ends, she must learn to relax! Luna told her so the last time they met. Of course, she meant it as a joke, but never let it be said that Antares disappoints her idols. She stayed up all night researching the ideal vacation, and by the next morning, she was off to Laomis, a freshly sewn swimsuit in her bag.

Sitting by the pool with flowers in her hair and a picnic basket at her side, Antares may seem like a natural at this 'vacation' thing. But don't be fooled. Relaxing is harder than it looks.

Laomis has lived up to its reputation as a paradise. Everywhere she looks, there's another view to appreciate, another meal to try, another kind local to meet...she can barely keep up with it all! How will she ever experience the whole island before the season ends?

Oh. That's right: summer will come again soon. Maybe, bit by bit, year by year, she can become a vacation master after all.

EyepatchGuard01.description:
The witches of Lumains know what it is to be feared, but that doesn't stop them from fearing. Even among outcasts, those witches who have taken on the features of a dragon are shunned. Olive understands why: witches only grow their horns when they've pushed their magic to the brink, losing themselves to the siren song of its power. A dragon witch has shown they're not to be trusted.

She's never told anyone how she got her horns and her lone wing. She's never told anyone how she lost her eye. It wouldn't matter anyway. The truth rarely changes anyone's mind.

EyepatchGuard02.description:
Olive doesn't remember many things fondly, but she'll always treasure her mother's laugh. How she made the most delicious pastries. How she studied her spellbooks night and day, desperate to end the Holy Maiden's witch hunts.

It was that desperation that consumed her. Twisted into a dragon, more beast than woman, she attacked her own daughter, the very person she wanted most to save. In that struggle to protect herself, Olive grew her horns. If she hadn't, she doubts she would have survived.

Let the witches whisper that she's just like her mother, a disaster waiting to happen. She knows better than anyone the price of dark magic -- and knows too that sometimes, that price must be paid.

GothGirl01.title: Petite Primordial
GothGirl01.description:
Aria, like all other Primordials, was born at the foundation of her world. Gifted with power over death, her duty was to judge mortal souls as they passed to the afterlife. With a touch, she could live each person's greatest triumphs and vilest sins, and with a swing of her scythe, she could snuff out any mortal life she pleased.

Aria could never understand why the living feared her. Unlike other Primordials, she wandered their world as she pleased, desperate to understand those she would one day judge. But all who saw her ran and cursed her name, beseeching their gods to protect them from the specter of death.

Eventually, a Goddess answered their prayers.

GothGirl02.description:
Aria doesn't remember much of her world's first True God. She's lived a long, long time, and shared too many memories to keep them all straight. But she does remember the day Orcanix first arrived. It was the day she realized she, too, might someday die.

The Undead Goddess commanded her hordes to hunt down and destroy the Primordial of Death, the one power capable of opposing her. Aria begged the mortals for shelter, but all turned her away, too terrified of Orcanix's assassins to risk her ire.

Only one man proved brave enough to protect her. A noble lord from the petty kingdom of Sanga, who foresaw the destruction to come.

IkemenSamurai01.title: Warrior of the Nameless Beast
IkemenSamurai01.description:
Those who carry the royal blood of Sanga inherit two vows: a vow to protect their homeland, and a vow to guard the shrine of the Death Primordial.

Since birth, Ryouma has borne these vows, not that anyone knows. As a bastard, his blood is as much a secret as the stone door beneath the shogun's palace, the gateway between the world of the living and the dead. His mother raised him to live as a shadow, silently slipping along behind those in the light.

Perhaps, if he had inherited his father's wisdom instead of his pride, he could have obeyed her. But Ryouma was born a warrior through and through, and thus he sought one day to hunt the dragon with no name.

IkemenSamurai02.name: Ryouma

IkemenSamurai02.description:
The ancient dragons of Erden bore grand names: Fornaxos, Kaidaros, Altaireon, Diabolos. All were silenced when the Goddess came, never to be spoken again. Only the dragon who slithered between the stars survived to see the new world.

Ryouma located this beast in his mountain lair, determined to prove his blade could best a dragon. He gave the beast a good fight, but in the end, could not overcome his nimble grace and speed. Satisfied with his effort, he submitted himself to a warrior's death, certain no one he left behind would miss him.

The dragon, having glimpsed the young warrior's true potential, refused to kill him, and instead made him his apprentice.

Ossia01.title: The Hollow Heart
Ossia01.description:
"Specimen name: O55-1A
Status: Stable

Specimen took her first non-assisted steps this morning. Her language capability far outpaces her physical development: she repeatedly asked for aid walking around the laboratory, and stumbled more than once. Still, this represents significant progress on her part. The faster she achieves full maturity, the better.

I've gotten word from associates on the mainland that the Aeon Lords have been sighted once again. No news on whether it has officially begun, but I fear I am running out of time. I have only just produced a living homunculus. How will she take to her powers when she finally discovers them?

I can only pray for good fortune. A thing I must do far too often, for a scientist."

Ossia02.description:
"Specimen Name: O55-1A
Status: Critical

Another blackout today. The specimen asked, as she often does, for a chance to venture outside the laboratory. I denied her and gave the usual reasons when asked why, but upon hearing them, her mana levels spiked. She broke a quarter of the equipment in her room before her power finally overcame her. I have dosed her with a memory poultice again. Let us pray that it continues to work.

I am starting to regret this iteration of the experiment. The specimen possesses immense strength, but cannot control her emotions. Integrating her into the Pandemonic system is crucial, but doing so in this state might spell doom for us all."

BlueWingDragon01.title: Tidewing Raptor
BlueWingDragon01.description:
In the native Tuathan tongue, Kau Lana translates to 'born of the wind and waves.' One can easily see how these dragons earned such a name. Equally agile in the sky and the sea, the Kau Lana struck fear into the ancient Tuathan islanders, who rarely ventured out to sea despite their reliance on it for food.

Fortunately, not all Tuathans cowered before the dragons. According to legend, a chieftain by the name of Kaleiha ascended Tuatha's volcano and battled the largest Kau Lana until, at last, it bent to his will. Since then, the two races have lived in peace, working together as dragonriding pairs to nurture and protect their home.

BlueWingDragon02.description:
Unfortunately, Tuatha's prosperity could not last forever. Eighteen years ago, its central volcano erupted after centuries of dormancy, burning the village to the ground. As a gesture of goodwill, Luther invited all the surviving villagers to join him in Rigland's capital. Naturally, he adopted the Kau Lana into the ranks of the Red Dragon Knights as well.

But the children of the wind and waves couldn't thrive so far from the sea. Year after year, their population dwindled, as the dragons rejected their new training and fled to the ruins of their island.

Some say those who sail near Tuatha these days can hear their echoing cries, mourning the home they lost.

Some men go to war for glory. Others for love of battle. Timia joined the war to follow in her father's footsteps, to see his dream of a united Erden fulfilled.

When she was but a child, he showered her with tales of the Bergarian royalty. The early tribal kings who shepherded their people through the mountains. The first true emperor, born of the Primordial of Light. They fought with true nobility, liberating the land from the tyrants who would divide it.

Their legends planted the seeds of courage in her heart. And when her father fell in battle, those seeds burst into bloom.

RedElfOfficer02.description:
Despite her youthful idealism, Timia is no fool. She knows all too well the cost of war. In her military training, her superiors made her memorize the casualties of past battles. They led her unit to rebel villages, forcibly crushed to keep their people under Imperial rule. In every eye, she saw the pain of her father's death, and she came to a resolution.

She could not allow this to continue.

As long as divisions among the people exist, there will be war. As long as there is war, innocent blood will flow. For the sake of lasting peace, the other lands of Erden must fall. And until their people understand that, Timia will do what she must.

YandereMaid01.name: Clarice
YandereMaid01.title: Venomous Rose
YandereMaid01.description:
Once upon a time, a little girl named Clarice lived with her mother on the streets of a very cold, very cruel city.

Clarice loved her mother dearly, but love could not fill their hungry bellies. Day after day, her mother would lead her around, asking for coin, for shelter, for anything.

No one could give her what she asked, because no one had anything to spare.

Finally, on a night when the wind cut like knives, she abandoned her daughter and never once looked back. What a bad little girl she must have been, for her own mother to leave her to die.

YandereMaid02.name: Clarice
YandereMaid02.title: Venomous Rose
YandereMaid02.description:
Clarice found her way to the mansion of a lord. For a long, long time, the lord kept her as his servant, but she was so clumsy he sold her away, to a noble couple who needed a handmaiden for their daughter Ludmilla.

Even though she was a terrible maid, Ludmilla showed Clarice great kindness. She let her borrow her books and do her hair, and over time, they became the best of friends.

Until she grew up and didn't want her anymore. Until she tried to run away.

Why would she do that? Weren't they friends? Was she a bad girl again?

Why... why... why why why whywhywhywhywh—

SchoolGirlWarrior01.title: Solitary Star
SchoolGirlWarrior01.description:
The Goddess works in mysterious ways. Even with her lifelong apathy toward religion, Saya knows this to be true. Why else would they need the Requiem every hundred years? Not even the Church can explain just how the blood of ninety-nine innocent girls revives the world, but somehow it does, every century since the dawn of history. 

Truthfully, Saya only cared about the Requiem because some old composer chose to turn it into a ballet. Her teacher cast her as the Goddess's Grace, the lead, hoping to make her a star. 

In a way, she did. Soon after the performance, the whole world knew her name. But not for the reasons Saya had hoped.

SchoolGirlWarrior02.name: Saya
SchoolGirlWarrior02.title: Solitary Star
SchoolGirlWarrior02.description:
It happened so fast. Her car dove off the bridge and crashed into the water below, submerging her, drowning her. It should have been her end, a rising star snuffed out by tragedy. For better or for worse, it wasn't. 

Deep beneath the river, Saya escaped the wreckage and rose light as air, buoyed by the burning power inside her. Something would not allow her to die. Not yet. Not before she'd served her purpose. 

As she soon learned, the Vessels of the Goddess cannot die before the Requiem. The shard of divinity inside her, the Goddess's Grace she'd shown through her dance, had protected her from death. 

But at what cost?

OniSchoolGirl01.description:
The Church keeps records of the order they find the Vessels for the Requiem. In truth, it doesn't matter all that much. Some Vessels found early have always been weak, while a few Vessels found late have proven themselves to be contenders. 

Still, everyone knows Hibiki Himeno was the very first Vessel found. Even worse, no one knows her Gift. 

Speculation floats around, of course. The Goddess's Bloodthirst would explain her ferocity in battle. Wit would explain her ability to ace tests without studying. Some have suggested she's the Goddess's Luck, because who else could get away with half of what she does? 

But some say they saw her shadow shortly before they themselves awoke as Vessels. And no one can explain that.

OniSchoolGirl02.description:
In the past, Vessels have never managed to turn eighteen. As soon as the hundredth one is found, the Requiem begins soon after, and the world enjoys another century of peace. This has always happened within eighteen years, but so far it's been almost twenty, posing the school a unique problem: graduates who were never meant to graduate. 

Some, like Nanami and Reina, proved skilled enough to become staff at the school. Others remain in a small village nearby, working odd jobs and pretending they've escaped their death sentence. 

Hibiki, on the other hand? She's only a second year, despite being eighteen, and she likes it just fine. It's not like she has to worry about the future, after all.

BunnySamurai01.description:
Lightning Hare Nanami, Shinano Academy graduate and interim professor of combat. Vessel of the Goddess's Speed. 

That's how the other students know her, at least. To tell the truth, it weirds her out to think of herself as a professor. She'd always been a wild kid, right from the day they brought her to the school, and she can't say teaching high school girls how to beat each other up was her lifelong dream. But it hasn't been working out too badly...so far, at least. 

Everyone in the school knows her gift. With sword strikes so swift they're barely visible, there was never any hiding it. Some would say that puts her at a disadvantage. Nanami says anyone who wants to take her on is more than welcome to try.

BunnySamurai02.description: Most of Nanami's students think her ears gave her away as a Vessel. And they're not totally wrong: a little girl with bunny ears will naturally draw more Church attention than her normal classmates. But even non-Vessels can gain an animal's ears or tail, if the Goddess chooses to bless them with it. No. Five-year-old Nanami saw a car hurtling towards a puppy in the road and dove out to save it. In a matter of seconds, she had not only reached the puppy and picked it up; she'd shot across the street, clear into the next neighborhood, too panicked to stop running. They found her downtown a day later, still holding the puppy. That was when the Church knew she was truly special.

DarkRizetteChristmas01.title: Maid of Midwinter
DarkRizetteChristmas01.description:
Rizette always enjoyed helping out around the house. As trivial as that memory seems now, she holds it close to her heart. There was a time she couldn't remember anything of herself. Not her past, not her friends, nothing beyond Orcanix's latest orders. Sometimes, she's afraid she'll slip back into that horrific void.

So she remembers how it felt to tidy up her family's meager home. How her heart raced as she nursed Finn back to health. Perhaps she wasn't heroic before her fall, but she refuses to think those little acts of kindness meant nothing.

Keeping her loved ones safe and happy was the only life she ever wanted.

DarkRizetteChristmas02.name: Endless Rizette
DarkRizetteChristmas02.title: Maid of Midwinter
DarkRizetteChristmas02.description:
She didn't love Finn as soon as she saw him. That would be too much like a fairy tale. When he arrived beaten and broken from the attack on his village, Rizette nursed him the same way she would any new refugee. They called her the Angel of the Outer City precisely because she never turned anyone away.

Still, she couldn't deny the kinship between them, both teenagers ripped from their families by the undead. When he had no place to go, it was only natural she invite him to live with her and her brother. How could she have known where it would lead?

How could she have known their growing love would lead to ruin?

DarkAstridNewYear01.name: Endless Astrid
DarkAstridNewYear01.title: Twilight Bride
DarkAstridNewYear01.description:
Come one, come all, to toast the dying year.

Astrid has prepared a feast for all of winter's wanderers. Her hearth burns warm and her table seats hundreds. As soon as night falls, she opens her gates and welcomes monster and innocent alike. She has been both. She knows that life flies by, no matter who you are, no matter what you've done. It is what separates the mortals from the gods.

Few view death as a celebration. But then, few can see it through Astrid's eyes.

Mortality, the chance to grow and change, is the greatest gift a soul can be given.

DarkAstridNewYear02.description:
There was a time she couldn't conceive of joy. Even now, the feeling seems a stranger to her, a guest she invited without truly knowing. Orcanix once convinced her revenge would be her joy, but even deep in the Goddess's thrall, she knew that was a lie.

Astrid never delighted in destruction. Looking back, she wonders how she managed to build the Rebellion when her heart was so black with misery. She didn't want to hurt Ludmilla. She didn't hate Last Bastion, or its Vanguard soldiers. She just wanted to know why.

What had she done to make her friend hate her so much?

CatIdolGirl01.title: Sparkling Idol
CatIdolGirl01.description:
Even as the world crumbles, nothing draws a crowd quite as big as Mirai's.  

It only makes sense that people line up in droves to see a Vessel in person. Never mind the ugly business of the Requiem. Mirai's voice is that of the Goddess, and it's said that all who hear it are blessed.  

Indeed, reports of civil disturbance plummet in the wake of her concerts. Everyone seems just a little happier. Nothing actually changes for the people, of course. A happy song can't end a famine or turn back a flood. But it can make them forget for a time. 

It's her duty to make them forget.

CatIdolGirl02.description:
It's not that Mirai doesn't like being an idol. In fact, singing is the greatest joy she has in life. She sang long before she was put on stage. She thought, in her early days at the academy, that if she worked hard enough, they would let her leave and travel the world. 

She thought correctly. At ten years old, the Church began training her for the demanding lifestyle of an idol. She didn't mind the rigor, nor the invasion of her privacy. After all, her life was never really hers anyway. 

Sometimes she wishes she could sing as herself, without using the Goddess's voice. Just once, to see if the people still love her. 

She likes to think they would.

DarkCatFighter01.title: Elysian Shadow
DarkCatFighter01.description:
Kana Narukami and her little sister Mirai were born with cat ears and a tail, in a world that was mostly human. 

Their parents took this as a sign of good fortune. Only those especially close to the Goddess took on the traits of an animal. Both sisters shared a cat's grace, its speed, as well as its knack for survival. Every time their poor family pulled through misfortune, their mother credited it to her daughters' blessings from the Goddess. 

One day, that blessing revealed itself as the curse it truly was. 

If she'd known Mirai's voice was that of the Goddess herself, Kana would never let her sing at all.

DarkCatFighter02.name: Kana
DarkCatFighter02.title: Elysian Shadow
DarkCatFighter02.description:
Men in black suits snatched Mirai off the street one morning as she sang for pennies from strangers. They told Kana they were from the Church, and thanked her for keeping a Vessel safe for so long. When Kana sank her teeth into the men taking her sister away, they knocked her out and left her there for Fate to do what it would. 

After a few hours, she woke up and did what any cat would do. She sought out food and shelter. She stayed in the shadows. She wore a mask to hide her horrid pain. 

She adapted. She survived, because she knew it was the only way she would ever get her sister back. 

And at long last, she thinks she's found a way.

AntaresModern01.name: Antares
AntaresModern01.title: Thunderhearted Heroine
AntaresModern01.description:
Antares has always been your average girl. 

Her grades are good enough not to disappoint, but she's far from the top of the class. She's pretty in a cute kind of way, but she doesn't turn heads. She's well-liked among her classmates, but not truly popular. 

She blends in so well that at times, she's afraid she'll disappear. 

But jealousy doesn't come naturally to her, and she can never stay mopey for longer than a day or two. Whenever she starts to feel down, she just looks around for what she loves. 

Even in a dying world, she finds things that make her smile. And even if she doesn't realize it, that is a remarkable gift.

AntaresModern02.name: Antares
AntaresModern02.title: Thunderhearted Heroine
AntaresModern02.description:
The thing about discovering your destiny is that you're never truly ready. Everyone's life is average until the moment it isn't -- and none have learned this better than Antares. 

She doesn't know if the Goddess influences fate itself, or if she's just very talented at stringing together coincidences, but as it would happen, her path crossed Mirai Narukami's totally by accident. By meeting her, she discovered the sinister plot of a foreign god looking to brainwash the world. 

And by discovering that plot, she found the power that slept inside her all along. The Goddess's Hope. 

As timid and unsure as she is, only she can save the world.

MechaSister01.name: Anya
MechaSister01.title: The Lost Von Draclow
MechaSister01.description:
In another world, Luther von Draclow inherited the Red Dragon Knights from a long line of ancestors. But in this world, the world of the Requiem, he founded the military order himself.

A brilliant man, he married an equally brilliant woman to carry on his legacy. His first daughter, Astrid, lived up to his every expectation, and he believed her future siblings could one day surpass her.

But his vision was not to be. His wife passed away giving birth to his second daughter, who he would later name Anastasia.

In every other world, she perished with her mother. Only the technology of Pandora's world gave her the means to fight her Fate. To live.

MechaSister02.name: Anya
MechaSister02.title: The Lost Von Draclow
MechaSister02.description:
Luther created the Ex Machina weapon alongside the Red Dragon Institute. Using a cloud of invisible nanomachines, an Ex Machina wielder could gain powers rivaling even those of the Goddess's Vessels. But this wasn't enough to satisfy him.

Little Anya's brain, kept in a coma while her body underwent medical treatment, proved to be more malleable than any other Luther had ever seen. He risked her life to mold it into a living quantum computer, capable of recording and even manipulating the forces of Fate.

Anya never knew exactly what her father was doing to her with all the surgeries she underwent. She only knew that if she kept surviving, she would meet her beloved sister Astrid.

DeadlyNurse01.name: Reina
DeadlyNurse01.title: Deadly Nurse
DeadlyNurse01.description:
Reina Fujiwara, third child of the Akise Fujiwara family, was never meant to amount to much. Her two older brothers were heir and spare to the Fujiwara real estate empire. Her parents believed she would stand quietly in their family photos, enjoy the luxury of their wealth, and one day marry some celebrity or prince to secure them political power.

They never once thought, not until the day the Church took her away, that they had given birth to a piece of the Goddess herself.

Reina became the Tenth Vessel of Pandora at age seven, bearing the Gift of the Goddess's Wisdom. And she is happier at Shinano Academy than she ever was at home.

DeadlyNurse02.name: Reina
DeadlyNurse02.title: Deadly Nurse
DeadlyNurse02.description:
Knowing her Gift, no one was surprised when Reina quickly surpassed her classmates in every academic subject. They promoted her from second grade to sixth within three months at the Academy, then sent her directly into high school a year after that. Nothing seemed to challenge the sharp little girl, who burned through every exam with masterful finesse.

Soon, Reina found herself studying on her own, taken out of the other girls' classes entirely. This was in part to spare them the pain of being so thoroughly bested, but that was not the only reason.

The teachers had noticed that tears, fights, and chaos followed wherever Reina went. For everyone's sake, it was better to keep her alone.

When Rizette awakens, the sweet smell of pear pie fills the room. Half-asleep, she goes to the table, where her grandmother greets her with a smile. Theo arrives, still yawning, and the three of them start their day.
"Mm, so good!"
"Aah, hot!"
"Haha. Slow down, dear!"
"You're gonna burn your tongue again, Sis!"
She thought those days would last forever.

Tonight, as the moon brushes stray clouds away, its light falls on the beautiful cherry blossoms that mark the end of winter—ah, no, no. Touch repaid with destruction, smile—with fear, trust—with betrayal. There are only those who have power and those who don't. Those with horns and those without them. And in both cases, a world in which the latter outnumber the former was one too weak for the Oni Queen's liking, too small. She isn't kind about it—she'll be out tonight as well, destroying, devouring, amusing herself, as the mysterious Shuten-Douji should.
Makes you wonder what came first—the stones being thrown at the mere sight of horns, or the oni girl wishing for freedom.

ReiBride01.title: Sakura Bride
ReiBride01.description: After countless centuries spent in a gloomy magical realm, Rei finds herself dazzled. The bright light filling the church, the sparkling raindrops scattered over cherry blossoms, the perfectly clear blue sky—it's almost too much. But it is all meant to celebrate her, and before she knows it, she has stopped in the middle of the aisle, overwhelmed with emotion.

ReiBride02.name: Rei
ReiBride02.title: Sakura Bride
ReiBride02.description:
There are unexpected, familiar faces among the guests, and Rei's eyes go wide in surprise. The bikki from Kisenkyo have come, and they are calling out to her from the distance, not a hint of strain in their smiles.

SnowWhiteSwimsuit01.name: Snow White
SnowWhiteSwimsuit01.title: A Midsummer Snow's Dream
SnowWhiteSwimsuit01.description: Snow White has never seen the sea before. Raised in a dark forest on the outskirts of a small kingdom, she's only ever heard of things like the summer sun and the azure sea in bedtime stories. "S-Sorry I made you wait," she says, nervousness mixed with excitement in her voice. When your eyes meet, she makes a peace sign with both hands to hide her embarrassment. IbarahimeRegular01.name: Sleeping Beauty
IbarahimeRegular01.title: Princess of Thorns
IbarahimeRegular01.description:
Once upon a time, in the northernmost part of Erden, there was a kingdom called Fresalia. Small as it was, it had significant influence over its neighbors, thanks to its formidable royal couple.
And Talia—Sleeping Beauty—was their only child.

When an ally with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that ally's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Usable if there are no Sleep Thorns on allies and the user is not burning.

Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

Usable if an ally has Sleep Thorns or if the user has no allies on the battlefield.

IbarahimeRegular02.title: Princess of Thorns

Her childhood was marked by strict discipline and thorough schooling—in addition to regular education, she had to master etiquette, the art of socializing, and all the other skills that make a proper princess. She was never allowed to play with her peers, and didn't have a single friend. She saw herself as something akin to a doll rather than a human, and in an act of self-torment she made dolls in her free time. However, they were all taken from her too.
She was alway all alone—that is, until a certain girl came into her life.

DarkRizetteSwimsuit01.name: Endless Rizette
DarkRizetteSwimsuit01.title: Angel of the Sleepless City
DarkRizetteSwimsuit01.description: A city where the lights seem to never go out, with countless buildings crammed together, and a sea of people as far as the eye can see. A place she doesn't know, customs she doesn't understand. Illuminated by flashing neon lights in every color imaginable, she felt more afraid than in the depths of the blackest, moonless night. That is, until she saw it. An elegant form and a roaring engine resonating with the beat of her heart. Speed like nothing she ever experienced in her own world, the thrill of outrunning the wind. It was called "a motorcycle," they told her. Once she got on, the city didn't seem so threatening anymore, and she found out just how addictive speed can be.

DarkRizetteSwimsuit02.title: Angel of the Sleepless City
DarkRizetteSwimsuit02.description:
After losing so much, she finally gained something—a new life. She decided to spend it atoning for her sins. Having parted ways with the other Finn, she started surveying the city for any remaining undead, to prevent this world from ending up the way her own had.
He thinks she should stop blaming herself.
He thinks she should enjoy herself more. After all, life shouldn't be lived for the past, but for the present and the future.
Her co-workers in this new world seem to understand that, though, so he thinks she should be all right, in the end.
"Yo, Endless! Let's hit the pool next!"

If she had met the seven dwarfs, if she had eaten the poisoned apple, if she had fallen into eternal sleep, she might have ended up being "her".
Instead, she met an awkward mother and a fantasy prone little sister, she shared warm, hearty meals with them—and yet, a tragedy still struck, although the one who never woke up wasn't her, but someone she held dear. She treated it with a healing spell—the only type of magic she was any good at—and the creature perked up immediately. It turned out to be a familiar of the God of Sleep. She gave Alice her thanks, along with a very special power.

RoundTableKnightBride01.name: Lancelot
RoundTableKnightBride01.title: Swordmaster Bride
RoundTableKnightBride01.description: A pure white dress seems appropriate for this Lancelot—an honest young woman so unlike her ancestor, a man steeped in suspicion and rage. Keen on—that is, accustomed to pain and battle-hardened as she is, she can't help but feel anxious about wearing a wedding outfit.

localization.name: Thunder Guard
localization.description:
Every time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 10% of max HP. Every second time this unit takes damage from an attack, the attacker will be stunned for 100TU (this is not considered a Skin effect).

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from the Burn or normal Poison status effects (stronger poisons such as Super Poison or Mega Poison can still defeat this unit).

This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

localization.name: Ultimate Defiance
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an attack, it has a 20% chance plus 20% per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to instead enter Battle Trance for 150TU. While in Battle Trance, this unit cannot be defeated by attacks. If this unit defeats an enemy with an attack while in Battle Trance, it will lose Battle Trance and recover full HP. Otherwise, once Battle Trance ends, this unit will be defeated.

This unit cannot enter Battle Trance while there are any allies with Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skills on the battlefield.

RoundTableKnightBride02.name: Lancelot
RoundTableKnightBride02.title: Swordmaster Bride
RoundTableKnightBride02.description:
When the Knights of the Round Table were asked to choose one member to model a wedding dress, the king passed the task on to Gawain, and Gawain—to Lancelot. "This kind of thing is not exactly what I'm into..." she protested, but when she tried to find someone else to do it, all the other knights were mysteriously absent.
When Gawain, haunted by her guilty conscience, went to the photoshoot venue later, she found Lancelot entangled in the ribbons decorating the place, with a deep flush on her face.

LokiRegular01.description: She's been around since ancient times, but not a single person has ever truly known her. She comes and goes as she pleases, changes appearances on a whim, and always keeps her cards close to her chest. Some say that even the form everyone knows as "Loki" is actually fake.

localization.name: Dark Hypnosis
localization.description:
Hypnotizes a random enemy (20%+ chance) and Mega Poisons them for 200TU (100% chance). A Hypnotized enemy will use its next turn to grant the turn to and Purify the hypnotizer (the turn will be lost as if it were sleeping), and then the hypnosis will end. The chance of Hypnosis applying increases by 20% for each awakening the user has, up to 100% max when fully awakened.

Hypnosis is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will be canceled if the user is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use and cannot be used if an enemy is already Hypnotized. Hypnosis will fail against Boss units.

(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.description:

Usable only if there is an enemy Guardian on the battlefield.

MechaSisterBride01.title: Radiant Mecha Bride
MechaSisterBride01.description: As her moment in the spotlight approached, Anya was reminded of her lonely past—long days spent on the verge of death in a hospital bed, with only the hope to see her sister again keeping her alive.

If there are no sleeping enemies, 50% damage instead and allies gain an additional 2 Spirit. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and is considered a Dream Hunter type Active Skill.

localization.name: Lights Out
localization.description: Grants 2 enemies the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This will overwrite other status effects on those units. For each targeted enemy that does not fall asleep (e.g. due to a Sleep Ward), allies gain 2 Spirit. Usable only if no enemies are sleeping.

localization.description: Consumes a Power Charge for 600% damage to 2 enemies. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects. Usable only if the user has a Power Charge.
localization.selected: 600% damage to 2 enemies using a Power Charge

localization.name: Aegis Overload
localization.description:
300% damage to all enemies and heals all allies for 800% of the user's Attack. All allies will become Enraged and all enemies hit by this attack will become Weakened, this will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units. This attack ignores Skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

The user will also have their Power Barrier passive skill reactivated and gain a Power Charge. Usable only if the user's Power Barrier passive skill is deactivated and becomes locked for 100TU after use.

- Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.
- Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.
- Power Charges cannot stack and will be removed when the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected:
300% damage, heals allies, reactivates Barrier
Enemies are weakened and allies are enraged

localization.name: Power Barrier
localization.description:
This Barrier will be activated whenever this unit enters battle.

While this unit is on the battlefield and this Barrier is activated:
- Allies gain 35% damage reduction from attacks. This effect can stack with other damage reduction effects such as Armor, but will not stack with itself or other ally Barrier type skills.
- This unit cannot be defeated by non-attack damage.
- If this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 25% of max HP.
-If this unit would be defeated by an attack, this Barrier will be deactivated and this unit will be Purified and healed for 100% of max HP.

If this unit's Barrier is deactivated and it would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

MechaSisterBride02.title: Radiant Mecha Bride

localization.name: Adaptive Circuit
localization.description:
This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

Whenever another non-conjured ally enters the battlefield from reinforcements, 20%+ chance for one of the following effects determined by that unit's Element to trigger.

WATER: Grants 1 random non-sleeping enemy Sleep (Forced) for 200TU.
FIRE: Grants Burn to all enemies.
EARTH: Grants 1 random non-sleeping enemy Cursed Sleep for 200TU (blocked by Burn).
STORM: Stuns 1 random enemy for 150TU.
DARK: Mega Poisons 1 random non-sleeping enemy for 200TU.
LIGHT: Purifies all allies and heals them for 400% of this unit's Attack.

The chance of these effects triggering increases by 20% for each Awakening this unit has, up to 100% when fully awakened. Successfully applied Status Effects will overwrite existing status effects on affected units.

CleopatraRegular01.name: Cleopatra
CleopatraRegular01.title: The Last Pharaoh
CleopatraRegular01.description:
Once, she had it all.
She was born in the Kingdom of Kemet, a land favored by the great river, blessed with rich, black soil—just like she was blessed with an abundance of talents. She didn't let herself rely solely on her gifts, though, but used them to gain as much knowledge as possible. Unmatched in skill, she was more than qualified to take on any number of duties. However, there was only one role she had her eyes on...

Once, she lost all she had.
She was too brilliant for her own good. Those she devoted her life to turned their backs on her, those she thought loyal suddenly sang a different tune—and they crushed her love under their feet. Seeking death, she turned to venom, but what she ended up embracing was deadlier than any toxin—lethal enough, in fact, to leave death behind and receive eternity. And it was with venom that she then purged her beloved, poisoned country.

GilgameshRegular01.name: Gilgamesh
GilgameshRegular01.title: Lion Queen of the Desert
GilgameshRegular01.description:
There once was a girl from the slums. Everything she had had been taken from her—her parents, her home, all her possessions. Until one day, she was finally given something; a gift quite unexpected and unique—the crown.
She could have stopped at being a figurehead. It would have been enough to provide her with everything she'd always lacked, and more. But she chose to become a genuine queen instead.

RizetteBride01.name: Rizette
RizetteBride01.title: Cerulean Bride
RizetteBride01.description:
The sunlight pouring into the chapel makes all the whites even brighter as Rizette looks up at her intended, slightly taller than her even though she's wearing high heels. She can feel everyone gently watching over her—her beloved little brother who walked her down the aisle, her companions who fought by her side on countless battlefields...
She hears the big question, "Do you?" and the answer is so obvious, has been for ages, really. And as the bells start ringing, she thinks to herself that it all feels like a dream.

RizetteBride02.name: Rizette
RizetteBride02.title: Cerulean Bride
RizetteBride02.description: She doesn't notice it really is a dream, not until an unexpected visitor points it out—another Rizette, dressed in black, visibly angry at the one who dreamed up this happy world. "It's not fair that only you get to have this," that Rizette says. But she drives away all the evil things lurking around nevertheless. Perplexed, Rizette in white can't help but ask, "Have you come to destroy my dream, or to protect it?"

GokuDark01.name: Dark Sun Wukong
GokuDark01.title: The Great Menace, Hell's Equal
GokuDark01.description:
Heralded by a roar of laughter, a golden-haired girl appears in the moonlight. She holds Ruyi Bang in her hand and wears Jinguer on her head...but she is not Sun Wukong. She is a different troublemaker, born from within Wukong. Her name is Vajra.
For you see, a girl with a dangerous mix of Yin and Yang personalities was once abandoned on Mount Huaguo...

If Cinderella never met her fairy godmother, if she stayed at the ball past midnight, if she lost her best friend, if, if, if—
She doesn't wait for someone to grant her happiness, she reaches out and takes it for herself. She doesn't bother with promises, she just chooses whichever option looks interesting at the moment.

CerberusRegular02.description:
After springing into existence, she immediately had two fated encounters: first with a dog—a creature destined to become her arch-nemesis—and then with a boy who came to her rescue.
Convinced that what's scary to her must also be scary to others, she dons dog ears in order to give herself a menacing aura. And as for the boy, she keeps the memory of their meeting safe in her heart.

localization.name: Scorching Spirit
localization.description:
Damage to 1 Enemy. The user is then granted the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU. Allies gain Spirit equal to the number of burning units on the battlefield after this attack.

A unit with Healing Burn will heal after each turn at the same rate as Burn would deal damage instead of taking damage from Burn. Healing Burn will overwrite other status effects on the user and can replace the Burn status effect, but cannot be replaced by Burn. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. Healing Burn will not be removed by Purify skills.
localization.selected:
Damages an enemy, burns user, adds Spirit
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Burning Claw
localization.description: 400% damage to 1 enemy and Burns all other Allies. Burn will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Usable if the user has the Burn status effect.
localization.selected: 400% damage, burns all allies

localization.name: Underworld Burn
localization.description:
The user gains the Mega Healing Burn status effect for 100TU. Also heals each other ally that is either Fire element or has a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill for 50% of their max HP. 

This skill is unlocked either:
- Each time the user defeats another unit with an attack.
- When this unit enters battle, if 2 other allies are either Fire element or have a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill. 

A unit with Mega Healing Burn will heal after each turn at 20 times the rate as Healing Burn. This will overwrite other status effects including Healing Burn on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected:
User gains Mega Healing Burn, can heal allies
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Hellhound
localization.description:
300% damage to all enemies, 500% if the user is below 50% of max HP.

Each unit on the battlefield has a 50% chance of being stunned for 100TU. Usable if the user has the Burn status effect.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage to enemies, may Stun other units

localization.name: Hell's Guard Dog
localization.description:
This unit has 65% damage reduction from attacks.
This unit is not affected by stun effects.
Burns all units on the battlefield when this unit is defeated by an enemy, this will overwrite other status effects on those units.

This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

localization.name: 3 Headed Defense
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU and will also Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

If this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will:
- Gain Endure if it didn't have Endure when it was attacked.
- Gain Healing Burn if it does not have Healing Burn, or a Sleep status effect (excluding Cursed or Noxious).
- Heal for 10% of max HP. This healing is increased to 50% of max HP for the first 3 times it triggers while this unit is on the battlefield.

localization.name: Attack Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Sword Resist Lv3
localization.description: 10% less damage from attacks by units equipped with Swords.

localization.name: Mace Mastery
localization.description: Can use weapon skills of Maces in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

LudmillaYukata01.name: Ludmilla
LudmillaYukata01.title: Red Dragon of the East
LudmillaYukata01.description:
In her life, Ludmilla's shared a bond with countless people. A lot of them were other knights—the superiors who taught her ins and outs of being a knight, the subordinates she taught in turn, the comrades she felt at ease with. All these bonds made her stronger, but at the same time...
As a matter of fact, the outfit she's wearing right now was obtained due to a certain bond too.

localization.name: Weakening Drain
localization.description:
100% damage to 2 enemies. 600% damage instead if the user has survived for 200TU on the battlefield. Heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. All enemies hit by this attack will become Weakened, this will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.
localization.selected: 100%+ damage to 2 enemies and Weaken them

localization.name: Friendly Evasion
localization.description: Grants the Stealth status effect with a Stealth Shield to 1 other ally. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on that ally. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying.
localization.selected:
Gives Stealth & Stealth Shield to 1 ally
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Dawn of Spring
localization.description:
Immediately give all other allies that are at max HP the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Then heals all allies other than the user for 100% of their max HP, Purifies them (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison), and grants them Recovery Mist for 200TU. A unit with Recovery Mist will heal for 5% of their max HP and have a 30% chance to be Purified after every turn. Recovery Mist effects do not stack. Usable once per battle.
localization.selected: May reduce TU of allies, heals & Purifies them

localization.name: Flower Shower
localization.description:
Randomly grants each non-burning ally either a Stun Ward, Sleep Ward, or Poison Ward and Purifies them.

If the user's current HP is at 50% or less, exchanges the user's current HP with the amount of HP the user has currently lost.

Weakens all enemies.

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.
localization.selected: Purify and Ward allies, weakens enemies

localization.name: Evasive Guard
localization.description:
This unit has a 20% chance to ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets, plus 20% per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings). Attacks that target All allies will not be ignored. If this unit gains the Stealth status effect, it will not be lost when ignoring attacks in this way.

This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield for 200TU after entering battle.

localization.name: Dark Resist Lv3
localization.description: 10% less damage from attacks by Dark units.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Attack Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.

localization.name: Spear Mastery
localization.description: Can use weapon skills of Spears in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

LudmillaYukata02.name: Ludmilla
LudmillaYukata02.title: Red Dragon of the East
LudmillaYukata02.description:
Some of the bonds she established were severed, despite her best efforts.
She was a knight and so were they. Protectors of their country, they were no strangers to conflict. She trained them to protect each other too, but still, she couldn't stop their blood from being spilled. 
She thinks of them as she looks outside, wishing that at least the extraordinary snowy landscape before her would stay forever unchanged.

localization.name: Unrelenting Defense
localization.description:
The first time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will enter Enduring Stance for 150TU. While in Enduring Stance, this unit cannot be defeated by damage unless it is burning, and cannot be granted Poison, Sleep, or Stuns.
Once Enduring Stance ends, this unit will enter Recovery Stance for 150TU. While in Recovery Stance, this unit has 65% damage reduction from attacks, and heals for 40% of max HP at the end of each turn. Whenever this unit is at max HP after this healing triggers, it will be Purified and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack. These stances can trigger once each time this unit is on the battlefield.

When this unit enters battle all enemies will be granted Rage Wards. Rage Wards will prevent a unit from becoming Enraged once, then be removed. Rage Wards cannot stack.

PercivalRegular01.name: Percival
PercivalRegular01.title: Forsaken Round Table Knight
PercivalRegular01.description:
A black castle tower looms over a remote island in the middle of the open sea, marking the place of exile of the disgraced Knights of the Round Table.
Normally, a prison would be rife with foul words and even fouler deeds, but here, there are none. Because from the very beginning, the one keeping this place in order was Percival, a knight recognized for his sense of justice by King Arthur himself.
The current Percival, the third warden of the prison, is just as dedicated to upholding justice, and just as feared by the inmates.

localization.name: Blastwave
localization.description: 100% damage to all enemies. 250% damage instead and stuns each enemy for 100TU if they are dealt damage every second time this skill is activated while on the battlefield. Heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.
localization.selected: 100+ damage and may Stun enemies, heals user

localization.name: Royal Blightburst
localization.description:
The user becomes Enraged, and is granted either a Stun Ward or Sleep Ward at random. Heals all allies for 400% of the user's Attack and Weakens all enemies. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.

Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.
localization.selected: Enrages user, heals all allies, weakens enemies

localization.name: Royal Void
localization.description: Targets 1 enemy. 500% damage to targets that have defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield, or to any target if the user has defeated 2+ units with attacks while on the battlefield. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, the effects of Skin passive skills and will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.
localization.selected: Up to 500% damage, ignores defeat prevention

localization.name: Elemental Eruption
localization.description:
500% damage to 2 enemies, and heals the user for 100% of max HP if damage is dealt. This attack ignores damage reduction effects.

Enemies damaged by this attack will be granted one of the following effects:
- Sleep for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield if they are a Fire or Light unit.
- Mega Poison for 200TU if they are a Storm or Earth unit.
- Stun for 200TU if they are a Water or Dark unit.

Locked for 200TU after the user has entered the battlefield, and locks again after each use. After the first use, unlocks each time the user damages an enemy with a different attack. Sleep and Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. This is not considered a Combo Burst type active skill.
localization.selected: 500% damage, ignores damage reduction & heals

localization.name: Forsaken Knight
localization.description:
This unit is not affected by stun effects until its first turn since entering the battlefield.
Heals all allies on the battlefield for 800% of this unit's attack when this unit is defeated by an enemy.

When another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, this unit gains 50% damage reduction from attacks for 150TU, is healed to max HP and becomes Enraged. Then all other allies gain the Armor status effect and become Enraged. This will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then Armor is removed. This may not trigger if this unit is defeated or sacrificed at the same time.

PercivalRegular02.name: Percival
PercivalRegular02.title: Forsaken Round Table Knight
PercivalRegular02.description: Dedicated to her mission as she was, after spending years under the constant stream of insults from her prisoners, Percival's composure finally snapped. "I'm a Knight of the Round Table, aren't I? And yet I haven't even seen the Round Table once! All I do is sit here and deal with criminals, day in, day out... I'm doing a good job, right? Right!?" "Can someone please praise me...?"

MordredRegular01.name: Mordred
MordredRegular01.title: Rebel of the Round Table
MordredRegular01.description:
The girl is defiant. Her name is listed among the Knights of the Round Table, but she has no intention of serving any ruler. If she ever meets King Arthur again, she will immediately go for the kill.
The girl is unfilial. The first Mordred was her grandfather, but she couldn't care less about the remorse he felt. She only wishes she could have slain him herself.
The girl is a rebel, and she's determined to take on the entire damned world.

IbarahimeSwimsuit01.name: Sleeping Beauty
IbarahimeSwimsuit01.title: Lakeside Reverie
IbarahimeSwimsuit01.description: The new season brings along sleepy warmth—but the earthy smell of plants and the early summer breeze tickling Talia's skin tell her this is not a dream. She hears a voice calling her name, and when she turns around, she sees Cinderella. KingArthurSwimsuit02.title: Seaside Monarch
KingArthurSwimsuit02.description:
A familiar figure appeared over Kay, blocking out the sun and his view of the clear skies. Judging by the menacing aura he could sense, he concluded that it must be his former king, changed after obtaining the power of Avalon. And then, the figure spoke.
"Don't you think you have slept enough, brother?"
Kay jerked awake, shaken by what he had witnessed in his dream."Stop meddling with people's heads, you blasted incubus..." he mumbled to himself before closing his eyes again.

localization.name: Cinderella's Resolve
localization.description:
This unit cannot be burned.

This unit enters battle with Stealth, a Stealth Shield, and 3 Charges. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 25% of its max HP. If this unit would be defeated while it has any charges, this unit will consume 1 charge to survive with 1HP remaining instead. Whenever a sleeping enemy gets the turn or this unit damages a sleeping enemy with an attack, this unit gains 1 charge.

localization.name: Water Slaughter
localization.description:

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, this unit gains Stealth and a Stealth Shield.

UnicornRegular01.name: Unicorn
UnicornRegular01.title: Pure-Hearted Knight
UnicornRegular01.description: Since time immemorial, members of Unicorn's family have served individuals considered to be the saviors of the world. When Unicorn turned 14, she was sent on a journey to find the current generation's savior—the person destined to be her master—just like her father had when he had been her age. To aid her in her efforts, she was entrusted with her family's heirloom, a diadem adorned with a single horn—Chevalier's Grace.

localization.name: Discharge Strike
localization.description:
Damage to 1 enemy, the user is granted a Sleep Ward. If this hits an enemy with any Discharge Counters, they will be stunned for:

300TU if they have 3 Discharge Counters
200TU if they have 2 Discharge Counters
100TU if they have 1 Discharge Counter

Then, the target has 1 Discharge Counter removed. Sleep Ward prevents Sleep from being applied once, then is removed. Sleep Wards cannot stack.

This skill becomes locked after use until the user deals damage with an Attack. This skill cannot be used if this unit is alone on the battlefield.

Grants all other allies the Armor status effect, and all Enemies 3 Discharge Counters. Armor will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then the effect is removed. A unit can store a maximum of 3 Discharge Counters, and all are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

Chevalier's Grace protected her from physical injuries, poison, and other direct threats, and, more importantly, she wasn't doing it out of obligation, but because becoming a fine knight serving her own master has always been her dream.

CthulhuGirlRegular01.title: Creature of the Void
CthulhuGirlRegular01.description: The girl's name was R'lyeh. She was born into a secret organization—a dark cult worshiping an evil deity, rejected by all other nations on Erden. Her parents treated her indifferently—everything they cared about was the doctrine. And so, starved for their attention, she volunteered to be the sacrifice needed to summon their dreadful god.

CthulhuGirlRegular02.name: Cthulhu
CthulhuGirlRegular02.title: Creature of the Void
CthulhuGirlRegular02.description: When R'lyeh opened her eyes after the ritual, her parents were gone. Everyone was gone. There was only her, physically unharmed, with an incomprehensible voice echoing inside her head. It seemed the deity had refused the call, and decided to hide within her instead of manifesting. From the tone of its voice, R'lyeh got an impression that it was scared of something, though she had no way of knowing what of or why.

localization.name: The Great Old One
localization.description:
Whenever an enemy enters the battlefield from reinforcements, this unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to immediately have its TU reduced to 0, be Purified, and be granted Sleep Immunity until the end of the turn.

The first time this unit is damaged by an attack while this unit has no Charges, it will survive that attack and then enter Warped Reality for 200TU. While in Warped Reality, this unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield, cannot be defeated by damage, has 90% damage reduction from attacks and is a Guardian.

Whenever this unit gets the turn in Warped Reality, it will lose the turn and Mega Poison all non-sleeping enemies for 200TU. Then if there is more than 1 enemy on the battlefield and no enemy is Hypnotized, this unit will hypnotize 1 random enemy on the battlefield. This unit cannot be Hypnotized while in Warped Reality. When Warped Reality ends, this unit will be sacrificed.

While this unit is a Guardian, for any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage. A Hypnotized enemy will use its next turn to grant the turn to and Purify the hypnotizer (the turn will be lost as if it were sleeping), and then the hypnosis will end. Hypnosis is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will be canceled if the hypnotizer is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Hypnosis will fail against Boss units.

NapoleonRegular01.description:
Having scored 32 victories in 32 battles, the first Empress of Lugrasse celebrated her success by commissioning a portrait.
In a word, she's a genius. Undefeated as a military officer, she continued her string of triumphs after ascending the throne—whatever she declared she'd do, she was sure to achieve. And the people of Lugrasse loved her for it.

NapoleonRegular02.description:
The girl Napoleon had been before she became a soldier, and later a monarch, didn't seem all that different from who she is now—and yet, she was not the same at all.
In her own words, she can grasp a thousand facts with a single glance; and with each glance, her mind gets flooded with information. The difference is, in the past it was all she could do not to fall apart when faced with her own uncontrollable intellect and the countless phenomena the world had to offer.

CleopatraDark01.description:
Aeon Lords aren't all created the same; some receive their Eternity simply to spread destruction during the Pandemonium, some for other purposes. Cleopatra was the latter—she was tasked with monitoring heads of state around Erden.
And so, she travels the world, asking the same question wherever she goes—a question that happens to mean a lot to her personally.
"What is a nation—its ruler or its people?"

Cleopatra didn't only gaze into the void; she was marked by it.
Within the void, there was a creature of dread and madness. People who lay their eyes on it couldn't think clearly, and those who were touched by it were driven completely mad.
Aeon Lords can rely on their Eternity to heal physical wounds, but even it cannot easily mend a shattered mind. Caught in an endless cycle of death, rebirth, anxiety and madness, Cleopatra eventually forgot even her own name.

Grants all non-burning allies Stealth, a Stealth Shield, and heals them for 500% of the user's attack. This will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Allies gain 1 Spirit for each Poisoned or Sleeping enemy on the battlefield. Then each non-burning enemy is randomly granted either Mega Poison for 200TU or Cursed Sleep for 200TU.

Unlocked each time a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

600% damage to 1 enemy. Then, if that target is not burning, they are granted Lethal Poison for 999TU. Usable only if the user has Stealth. This skill is locked for 150TU after use.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

localization.name: Plague Queen
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with a Poison Ward, Sleep Ward, Stealth, and Stealth Shield. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

This unit will have their TU costs reduced by 40% while there is a poisoned or sleeping enemy. Quicken effects will not further reduce this unit's TU costs.

Each time an enemy with Cursed Sleep, Mega Poison or Lethal Poison gets the turn:

- this unit heals for 30% of its max HP.
- this unit steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team at the end of the turn.

HijikataRegular01.name: Hijikata
HijikataRegular01.title: Demon Vice-Commander
HijikataRegular01.description:
A warrior whose name alone would terrify even the fiercest oni into submission—the famed vice-commander of the Shinsengumi.
Righteous and relentless, she was as stern with her comrades as she was with herself. She was the one who created the group's strict code of conduct, and, by enforcing it, transformed a band of rogues into a warrior elite.
The truth is, strictness was her way of showing them her affection.

When it came to swordsmanship, she made impossible possible on a daily basis. But the truth is, she had no real interest in the art of the sword.

OkitaRegular02.title: Shinsengumi's Finest
OkitaRegular02.description:
Okita has always distrusted people—after all, in a world terrorized by the oni, her parents were killed by humans. Abandoned by her relatives, she ended up growing up at a sword school. There, her extraordinary talent was discovered, but it didn't take long for the other disciples to start avoiding her, not even trying to match her in a duel. Soon, she was out of her mind with boredom.
And then one day, a certain girl joined the school—one not afraid to face Okita head on.
She would go on to become Shinsengumi's vice-commander, and the object of Okita's feelings.

It's Kaguya's first time seeing the sea, and her first time wearing a swimsuit as well. She has spent most of her life isolating herself from the outside world, but she didn't mind missing out on things—not if it meant she could save Erden.
Now she is standing next to someone very special to her, and her eyes are sparkling with joy. It's hard to believe that making her smile once seemed as impossible as the tasks she gave all her suitors.

Why did Kaguya ask Finn to bring her a moon stone? Because to her, the moon looked just as lonely as she felt. However, the moon wasn't alone at all—it could always count on the sun to lend it its light.
