Targets all enemies and deals 100% damage. For each target with 50+ TU, deals 400% damage to that target instead. For each target with 100+ TU, deals 600% damage to that target instead. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then, all non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemies hit that have 1HP remaining have a 25% chance each to be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the enemy from being defeated. Usable once each time this unit is on the battlefield.
localization.selected: 100%+ damage, ignores armor & skins

localization.name: Call the Storm
localization.description: Pulls the user away from the battlefield to be next in line of your reinforcements. If there are no ally reinforcements, adds enough Super Denmoris to the ally team to still pull the user away to reinforcements (max 4 if the user is alone on the battlefield). Usable if the user has used Divine Lightning while on the battlefield. Usable five times per battle.
localization.selected: Sends user to be next in reinforcements

localization.name: Lightning Rain
localization.description:
Triggered when this unit enters the battlefield from the allied reinforcements:
- Stuns 2 random enemies for 150TU.
- Purifies all allies.
- Grants the ally with the lowest TU the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0.

Once this unit survives until after the end of the turn in which it enters battle, 2 random enemies with less than 150TU will be stunned for 150TU.

KirinGirlRegular02.name: Kirin
KirinGirlRegular02.title: Arbiter of the Heavens
KirinGirlRegular02.description: Kirin—a sacred beast that is an Avatar of the Primordials—found the girl in the forest and raised her. When she reached her sixteenth spring, Kirin returned her to the living world. Time passed, and the now-grown girl once again appeared before Kirin, cloaked in the same loneliness as before.

This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

This unit is a Stun Absorber. Whenever any ally would be affected by stun, this unit takes the stun instead.

localization.name: Ephemeral
localization.description:
This unit is never considered to be defeated by attacks and does not trigger any skills of other units whenever it is defeated or sacrificed by any source while on the battlefield.

This unit will be fully healed after each turn if it takes damage but is not defeated. This unit will be defeated after any ally or enemy turn if this unit has any of the Burn, Super Poison, or Mega Poison status effects.

Damage dealt to this unit is increased to 2.5 times the normal amount.

LudmillaDarkNew01.name: Dark Ludmilla
LudmillaDarkNew01.title: Marshal of Darkness
LudmillaDarkNew01.description: The Greyford soldiers were filled with skepticism. "I heard that an instructor is being sent from Rigland to train us. And a woman at that." "Hah, a woman? Such an insult. Maybe we should show her a little affection."

localization.name: Dark Drain
localization.description:
Grants all allies Stealth, and a Burn Ward. Grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This will overwrite other status effects on those units. Then steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team for each Poisoned enemy on the battlefield. The user will immediately get the next turn, then this additional turn effect cannot trigger again until TU advances.

Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. Burn Wards prevent Burn from being applied once, then are removed. Burn Wards cannot stack.

- 6+ Enemy Spirit: 250%
- 4-5 Enemy Spirit: 400%
- 1-3 Enemy Spirit: 550%
- 0 Enemy Spirit: 700%
This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.
localization.selected: 250%+ damage, ignores skins & counter stances

localization.name: Unleash Chaos
localization.description:
Heals all allies for 1000% of the user's attack. Steals all Spirit from the enemy team. The Hold Ground+ passive skill effect is reset for the user and can be triggered again. Then the user enters Chaos Rage for 100TU. While in Chaos Rage, the user's attack is increased by 1.5x (this does not stack with Enrage effects), and the user cannot fall asleep, or be stunned. The user cannot enter Chaos Rage while there are any allies with Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skills on the battlefield.

This skill is locked until the user's Hold Ground+ passive skill effect is triggered while on the battlefield and is locked again after each use. This skill can be used only three times per battle.
localization.selected: Heals, Steals Spirit, User may enter Chaos Rage

localization.name: Corrupted Guard
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated or stunned until its next turn. This effect can trigger only once each time this unit enters the battlefield, and is considered a Hold Ground+ effect.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield. This unit has 25% damage reduction from attacks, plus 10% per Awakening (up to 65% if this unit has 4 Awakenings). This unit will be healed for 50% of its max HP each time an enemy gets the turn while the enemy team's Spirit is at 2 or less.

This unit will become a Guardian:
- When this unit enters the battlefield, if there is no ally Guardian on the battlefield
- Each time this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack while on the battlefield, and has any other allies left.

While this unit is a Guardian, for any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

This unit stops being a Guardian each time it activates Unleash Chaos.

localization.name: Diabolic Knight
localization.description:
This unit's attacks:
- Ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent their targets from being defeated.
- Heal the user for 100% of total damage dealt.
- Weaken all enemies hit. This will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units.

New enemies entering the battlefield will be Weakened.

If this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 10% of max HP and be granted Stealth. This healing is increased to 75% of max HP for the first 3 times it triggers either after entering the battlefield or after using Unleash Chaos.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on this unit. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

localization.selected: 600% damage & may immediately defeat sleeping target.

localization.name: Monarch's Will
localization.description:
When an ally, including this unit enters the battlefield at the very start of battle or from reinforcements, all allies other than this unit receive a Monarch Token. Monarch Tokens cannot stack. Any attack damage will remove Monarch Tokens.

Each time an ally with a Monarch token is damaged by an enemy attack (even if defeated), this unit will immediately have its TU reduced to 0.

Triggered when this unit enters the battlefield from the allied reinforcements:
- Ally Spirit is doubled. If Ally Spirit is at 0, gain 1 Spirit instead.
- Then remove burn (including Mega Healing Burn) from 1 random non-sleeping enemy and grant them Sleep (Forced) for 200TU. This triggers an additional time for each 2 Spirit allies have (up to 5 additional times with 10 Spirit).
- Then if all enemies are sleeping, all allies have their current TU reduced by 100TU.

Whenever another ally enters the battlefield from reinforcements, the ally team gains 2 Spirit, all allies gain Stealth, and a Stealth Shield.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on those units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.

localization.name: Long Live The Queen
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP. This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

This unit has 75% damage reduction from attacks if allies have 6 or more Spirit.

Whenever this unit damages any number of units with an attack, ally Spirit is doubled at the end of the turn, if ally Spirit is at 0, gain 1 Spirit instead. Then if allies have 10 Spirit, remove burn (including Mega Healing Burn) from 1 random non-sleeping enemy and grant them Sleep (Forced) for 200TU.

Whenever ally Spirit is at 10 at the end of any turn, all allies will be healed for 1000% of this unit's attack and be Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed). This effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

localization.name: Lethal Plague
localization.description:
Grants 1 enemy the Lethal Poison status effect, and Infects them with it.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Lethal Poison to a random non-burning, non-Lethal Poisoned unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

This skill is locked for 100TU after use. Usable 5 times per battle.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.
localization.selected:
Grants & Infects 1 enemy with Lethal Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.description:

Then the target hit has its Poison Wards removed, burn removed (including Mega Healing Burn) and is randomly granted either Super Poison, Mega Poison for 200TU, or Lethal Poison for 999TU. This will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 50TU.

Super Poison deals 4 times the damage of normal poison, and cannot be overwritten by normal poison. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

If this unit would be defeated by an attack while there is a Poisoned enemy on the battlefield, this unit will survive with 1HP remaining instead. Then this unit will remove poison (including Lethal Poison) from a random poisoned enemy at the end of turn.

This unit heals for 50% of max HP whenever it damages a poisoned enemy with an attack (triggers once per poisoned enemy hit).

This unit's Attack is increased by:
- 1.25x if there is exactly 1 Poisoned enemy on the battlefield.
- 1.5x if there are exactly 2 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
- 1.75x if there are exactly 3 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
- 2.0x if there are exactly 4 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
These Attack increases do not stack with Enrage effects.

- Cannot be burned
- Reduces the amount of any stun effects against this unit by 100TU.
- Will ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets (attacks that target all allies will not be ignored).

YandereMaidDark02.name: Dark Clarice
YandereMaidDark02.title: Maid of Darkness
YandereMaidDark02.description: However, her demeanor could hardly be called submissive. She would even defy the young queen. "You thought you could tame me? How utterly presumptuous." Stung by her words and thrown off by her whims, the courtiers soon formed a secret fan club.

localization.name: Lethal Plague
localization.description:
Grants 1 enemy the Lethal Poison status effect, and Infects them with it.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Lethal Poison to a random non-burning, non-Lethal Poisoned unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

This skill is locked for 100TU after use. Usable 5 times per battle.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.
localization.selected:
Grants & Infects 1 enemy with Lethal Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Throw Knives
localization.description:
500% damage to 1 random enemy. Minus 100% damage for each non-poisoned enemy on the battlefield (max of -400% if there are 4 non-poisoned enemies). This attack cannot be redirected by Guardians, and ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then the target hit has its Poison Wards removed, burn removed (including Mega Healing Burn) and is randomly granted either Super Poison, Mega Poison for 200TU, or Lethal Poison for 999TU. This will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 50TU.

Super Poison deals 4 times the damage of normal poison, and cannot be overwritten by normal poison. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.
localization.selected:
100%+ damage, apply poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Massacre
localization.description: 100% damage to all enemies, plus 100% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 400% total damage). This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.
localization.selected: 100%+ damage, ignores armor & skins

localization.name: Death's Kiss
localization.description: Immediately defeats 1 non-boss enemy that has 50% or less of max HP, the user is considered to have defeated the target with an attack if successful. This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, and cannot be redirected by Guardians. Usable if all enemies on the battlefield are poisoned. Usable 3 times per battle.
localization.selected: May immediately defeat the target

localization.name: Toxic Maid
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an attack while there is a Poisoned enemy on the battlefield, this unit will survive with 1HP remaining instead. Then this unit will remove poison (including Lethal Poison) from a random poisoned enemy at the end of turn.

This unit heals for 50% of max HP whenever it damages a poisoned enemy with an attack (triggers once per poisoned enemy hit).

This unit's Attack is increased by:
- 1.25x if there is exactly 1 Poisoned enemy on the battlefield.
- 1.5x if there are exactly 2 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
- 1.75x if there are exactly 3 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
- 2.0x if there are exactly 4 Poisoned enemies on the battlefield.
These Attack increases do not stack with Enrage effects.

localization.name: Relentless Killer
localization.description:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Poison or Burn status effects.

Each time a unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 10% of its max HP.

If no enemy is Poisoned at the start of an enemy turn, then at the end of that turn this unit will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and will have its TU reduced to 0. Then this effect cannot trigger again until 100TU advances (minus 20TU per Awakening).

After entering battle, for 200TU, this unit:
- Cannot be burned
- Reduces the amount of any stun effects against this unit by 100TU.
- Will ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets (attacks that target all allies will not be ignored).

NikeRegular01.name: Nike
NikeRegular01.title: Goddess of Victory
NikeRegular01.description:
Nike's talent stood out even among the temple elite. At the mere age of seventeen, her pure magical power already rivaled that of the priests. Everyone believed she was destined to become an amazing Priestess of Time.
However, that very talent, coupled with her seeming aloofness, made her the target of envy. One would often find her alone on temple grounds.

localization.description: 200% damage to 1 enemy. If the user has a Power Charge, it will be consumed to deal 400% damage instead and the user will immediately get the next turn. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

If at least one of the hit enemies is not defeated by this attack, the user gains a Power Charge. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills. Power Charges cannot stack and will be removed when the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage, may gain Power Charge

localization.name: Wings of Victory
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit will ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets (attacks that target All allies will not be ignored). If this unit gains the Stealth status effect, it will not be lost when ignoring attacks in this way.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

Whenever this unit takes damage from an attack by an enemy unit that has defeated 0 units with attacks while on the battlefield, and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and will get the next turn by having its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

localization.name: Victory Cry
localization.description:
This unit cannot fall asleep.

When this unit enters battle, for 200TU, at the end of each turn an ally gets, the ally:
- will heal for 10% of their max HP, plus 10% per Awakening Nike has (up to 50% if Nike has 4 Awakenings).
- will have Sleep and Poison status effects other than Lethal Poison removed.
- may gain a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward and a Poison Ward (50% chance for each ward).
This effect will end if this unit leaves the battlefield. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

If all allies on the battlefield are at max HP when this unit enters battle, this unit gains a Power Charge and Intense Rage. Otherwise, all allies are healed for 100% of their max HP, Purified, and may gain a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, and a Poison Ward (50% chance for each ward).

Intense Rage increases a units Attack to 1.5x for their next 3 turns, and will overwrite existing Weak or Enrage effects. It cannot be overwritten by other Enrage effects but can be by Weak effects.

Targets 1 enemy and ignores Guardians. If the target has 50TU or more, or if Time Stop is active, deals 600% damage.

If Time Stop is not active, Stuns the target for 300TU, then if the hit target has 200TU or more and is not a Stun Absorber, they can no longer be Stunned by Time Spears skill unless they leave the battlefield.
localization.selected: Up to 600% damage and may Stun

localization.name: Time Stop
localization.description:
Activates Time Stop For 100TU. While Time Stop is active, the user:
- Cannot be defeated by Poison or Burn damage (including Lethal Poison).
- Is immune to Poison, and Burn status effects.
- Has their Active Skill TU Costs reduced by 50%. This does not stack with Quicken effects.
- Disables the Active Skills of all other units on the battlefield (including new units that enter from reinforcements).

When Time Stop expires, all allies will be healed for 100% of max HP and be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and all non-boss enemies on the battlefield that are below 10% of their max HP will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated those enemies with an attack). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the enemy from being defeated. Time Stop expiring may trigger before or after other effects.

Usable once per battle. The effects of Time Stop cannot be Purified and will be cancelled if the user is defeated. When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping.

This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. localization.name: Toxic Reign

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on the affected enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. 400% damage to 2 enemies, plus 100% for each burning unit on the battlefield (max of 800% total damage if 4 or more units on the battlefield are burning). All non-burning enemies hit are then granted the Burn status effect. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills. This is considered a Burn Drive type skill.

Unlocked each time a unit on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source. This skill is locked again after each use unless it defeats an enemy.
localization.selected: 400%+ damage, ignores defeat prevention & skins

localization.name: Dragon Reborn
localization.description:
Heals all allies for 800% of the user's attack. The user is granted 3 Charges, and the Mega Healing Burn status effect for 100TU.

Then the user has their current TU reduced by 10TU for each burning ally on the battlefield. All other non-sleeping allies are granted the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Usable only if the user has 1 or fewer Charges stored. Usable 10 times per battle. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: Heals, Gains Charges & Mega Healing Burn

localization.name: Dragon's Might
localization.description:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Poison or Burn status effects.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

This unit enters battle with the Mega Healing Burn status effect for 100TU, a Burn Shield, and 3 Charges. Burn Shields prevent the next non-burn status effect a unit would gain while Burning from applying.

If this unit would be defeated while it has any charges, this unit will consume 1 charge to survive with 1HP remaining instead.

If this unit is burning, each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will spend a Charge to heal for 100% of max HP and immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect.

localization.name: Radiant Heat
localization.description:
This unit has 35% damage reduction from attacks.

This unit is not affected by stun effects and cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

When this unit enters battle, all allies will be granted Heated Barrier. A unit with Heated Barrier will gain 35% damage reduction from attacks if they are burning. Allies that enter from reinforcements will be granted a Heated Barrier as long as this unit is on the battlefield. Heated Barrier's effect can stack with other damage reduction effects such as this passive skill's damage reduction effect, but will not stack with itself or other ally Barrier type skills. Heated Barrier are removed from units that leave the battlefield.

Whenever a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, all allies are healed for 100% of max HP. Then all allies that are Fire element or have a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill are granted the Burn status effect.

localization.description: Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.

localization.name: HP Up Lv3
localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

localization.name: Earth Resist Lv3
localization.description: 10% less damage from attacks by Earth units.

localization.name: Sword Mastery
localization.description: Can use weapon skills of Swords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

ElmKouhaiRegular01.name: Cera
ElmKouhaiRegular01.title: Red Dragon Knight of Virtue
ElmKouhaiRegular01.description: Cera was raised in an orphanage within a kingdom steeped in corruption and decay. By nature, she was a shy and tidy girl, but her environment was abysmal. Funds were used to line the pockets of the orphanage's administrators while the children endured meager meals and the constant threat of violence from the caretakers.

localization.name: Cutting Edge
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy. 500% damage instead if any enemy on the battlefield is poisoned or sleeping. This attack ignores Guardians and damage reduction effects.

Then immediately give 1 other random ally the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used on turns given by this skill. This skill can be used on such turns, but will not grant the extra turn.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage, ignores Guardians & may give turn

localization.name: Inspiring Virtue
localization.description:
Allies gain 2 Spirit for each ally on the battlefield. All allies on the battlefield heal for 500% of the user's attack, gain the Armor status effect, and Earthen Might. Then, immediately give all other allies that are at max HP the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Usable if the user has defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield, and if no ally has Earthen Might already. Usable once each time this unit is on the battlefield.

Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then the effect is removed. Armor will overwrite other status effects on those units. A unit with Earthen Might has 0.5x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not burning. This does stack on top of Enrage effects, and other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.5x => 2.0x total), but cannot stack with itself. Earthen Might ends for all allies if the unit who granted it leaves the battlefield, and is removed from units that leave the battlefield.
localization.selected:
Gain Spirit, Armor, and Earthen Might
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Pacifying Flare
localization.description:
Targets all enemies. All burning targets are weakened and granted a Rage ward. All non-burning targets are granted the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU. Then all non-sleeping targets are granted the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU, and all non-burning allies are granted Sleep Thorns.

Usable if at least 1 enemy on the battlefield is not burning. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects. Rage Wards will prevent a unit from becoming Enraged once, then be removed. Rage Wards cannot stack. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects.
localization.selected:
May Weaken enemies or grant them Sleep or Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Red Dragon Wrath
localization.description:
300% damage to 2 random enemies. 600% damage instead to targets that are poisoned or sleeping. 800% damage instead to targets that have the Mega Poison status effect or the Cursed Sleep status effect. This attack cannot be redirected by Guardians, and will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, enemy damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills. This attack can hit targets that have the Stealth Status Effect or a passive effect that ignores multiple target attacks.

Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with another attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage to 2 random enemies

localization.name: Virtuous March
localization.description:
This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies, and heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

This unit is immune to Poison status effects. If any ally has Sleep Thorns, this unit is immune to Stun effects.

Whenever this unit enters the battlefield:
- All non-burning allies on the battlefield are granted Sleep Thorns.
- For 200TU, unless burning, this unit cannot be defeated by damage and has 60% damage reduction from attacks.

At the end of each of this unit's turns, all ally Imposters on the battlefield are immediately defeated. This unit is considered to have defeated with attacks as many units as are defeated by this effect. This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the targets from being defeated.

This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

localization.name: Godly Lightning
localization.description:
This unit's attacks ignore Guardians and heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit has Sleep immunity and Stun immunity. These immunity effects are removed from this unit when this unit activates Zeus's Blessing.

When this unit takes damage from an attack, they will immediately get the next turn, this cannot trigger again until TU advances. This is a skin effect. This unit cannot become a Guardian or Stun Absorber.

This unit enters battle with 3 Charges. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.

At the end of this unit's turn, if this unit has exactly:
- 3 Charges, all enemies on the battlefield that have a current TU of 50 or less are stunned for 100TU.
- 2 Charges, all enemies on the battlefield that have a current TU of 100 or less are stunned for 200TU.
- 1 Charge, all enemies on the battlefield that have a current TU of 200 or less are stunned for 300TU.
Then a Charge is consumed by this unit.

localization.name: Omnipotence
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Each time a unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 30% of its max HP.

After entering battle, this unit cannot be burned for 200TU.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 50% of its max HP and be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).

This unit's attack has 0.25x of their original Attack added to their Attack for each enemy on the battlefield that has a current TU of 50 or less (max of 1.0x if 4 enemies have a current TU of 50 or less). This does stack on top of Enrage effects, and other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.25x => 1.75x total).

localization.name: Linked Edge

- have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30%. This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills.
- are granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, Poison Ward and Instant Death Ward.

Usable only if no other ally on the battlefield has Rizette's Link already, and there is a valid target. Usable 3 times per battle.

localization.selected: Give another ally Rizette's Link

localization.name: Elemental Cure

Then if at least 1 enemy on the battlefield is:
- Water, remove sleep (including Deep Sleep) from all allies on the battlefield and grant them Sleep Wards.
- Fire, remove burn (including Mega Healing Burn) from all units on the battlefield and grant them Burn Wards.
- Earth, remove poison (including Lethal Poison) from all allies on the battlefield and grant them Poison Wards.
- Storm, all allies who have a current TU of 100 or more have their current TU reduced by 50TU. This effect repeats once for each additional Storm enemy on the battlefield. Then grant all allies Stun Wards.
- Dark, grant all allies Stealth, and a Stealth Shield.
- Light, all allies will be Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed). Then if there is no Purify Chain among allies a random ally is granted a Purify Chain.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on affected units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. VenusRegular01.title: Goddess of Love
VenusRegular01.description: Venus, the goddess of love. Her beauty and maternal grace earned her the devotion of both gods and humans alike. But she has long been captive in an underground prison governed by the god of death. Her crime—murdering a god.

localization.name: Heartfelt Strike
localization.description:

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. A Charmed unit has their attack greatly reduced (e.g. to 0.5x of their original Attack for a unit with no other Attack modifiers. The effect of Charmed may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects). Charmed overwrites Enrage and Weaken effects, and units that are Charmed cannot be Enraged or Weakened. Charmed units are less likely to target the unit that Charmed them with most active skills. Charmed is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will end if the Charmed unit leaves the battlefield.

This skill cannot be used if an enemy is already Charmed or if the user is alone on the battlefield.

MusashiDark02.name: Musashi
MusashiDark02.title: Asura of Carnage
MusashiDark02.description: Musashi's sanity fiercely resisted the oni transformation. Yet at the same time, a part deep within her was quietly exulting. Pure strength was flooding through her body. Fear and pleasure clashed, her blood burned hot, and before she knew it, her mind focused. She clung only to the sensation of victory, losing what it meant to be human.

localization.name: Oni Claws
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 100% for each time this unit has defeated an enemy with an attack while on the battlefield (max of 700% total damage after defeating 4 enemies). This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

The user is granted Stealth, and a Stealth Shield. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on the user. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.
localization.selected:
300%+ damage, grants Stealth & Shield
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Absolute Slaughter
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy. This attack ignores Guardians, damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies.

When this attack hits a non-boss, non-Ephemeral target and that target has 10% or less of max HP remaining after damage, that target is immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated the target with an attack if successful). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the enemy from being defeated.

Usable 10 times per battle.
localization.selected: 300% damage, may immediately defeat

localization.name: Void Push
localization.description:
Targets 1 enemy.

Steals up to 1 Spirit from the enemy team for each enemy on the battlefield. Enemy Imposters are counted twice.

Then exchanges the target with an Imposter. The exchanged enemy will be sent to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. If there are no enemy reinforcements, add enough Imposters to the enemy team to still send the targeted enemy to reinforcements (max 3). This effect will not trigger if the targeted enemy is Immovable.

Usable only if there are at least 2 non-Imposter enemies on the battlefield and becomes locked for 50TU after use.
localization.selected: May steal Spirit & May exchange 1 enemy

localization.name: Dark Heaven Style
localization.description:
The user will enter Dark Heaven Stance for 150TU. While in Dark Heaven Stance, this unit heals for 50% of max HP at the end of each turn, will ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets (attacks that target All allies will not be ignored), and this unit's Attack is increased to 1.5x. This attack increase does not stack with Enrage effects.

This skill becomes locked for 150TU after use. Usable if this unit has not defeated any units with attacks while on the battlefield.
localization.selected: Enters Dark Heaven Stance

localization.name: Merciless Musashi
localization.description:
This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Until the end of this unit's first turn while on the battlefield, this unit has Stun Immunity and Sleep Immunity. Afterwards, this unit has Stun Immunity and Sleep Immunity for 100TU.

Each time this unit damages an enemy with an attack, this unit will immediately get the next turn if either that enemy had 100% of their max HP at the start of the turn, or if the damage leaves them on or below 25% of max HP (even if they are defeated by the attack).
- This effect cannot trigger again against the same target until TU advances.
- Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

localization.name: Blood of the Oni
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Whenever this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack, an Imposter is added to the next in line of enemy reinforcements.

At the start of each turn, if there are any Imposters (ally or enemy) on the battlefield, this unit cannot be defeated by non-attack damage until the end of that turn.

Whenever an imposter on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, this unit will be healed for 100% max HP and Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).

KenshinRegular01.name: Kenshin
KenshinRegular01.title: Master of Rashomon Gate
KenshinRegular01.description: Kenshin was born into a family that had, for generations, overseen the guards of Rashomon Gate, the sole gate into the Capital. When Kenshin was fifteen, her father stepped down, and she became the head of the Uesugi family. Though free-spirited by nature, she possessed a strong sense of responsibility and was deeply trusted by her subordinates.

localization.name: Unstable Blade
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 random enemy, plus 100% for each time the user has hit a poisoned enemy with an attack while on the battlefield (max of 800% total after hitting 5 poisoned enemies with attacks). This attack ignores Guardians, damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

The user is granted Super Stealth, and a Stealth Shield. Super Stealth will overwrite other Status effects. Super Stealthed units ignore enemy attacks that would damage more than 1 target. Super Stealth will be removed after ignoring 3 enemy attacks since applying, and can be overwritten by other status effects, except normal Stealth. Damage will not remove Super Stealth. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying.
localization.selected:
300%+ damage, grants Super Stealth & Shield
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Poison Waves
localization.description:
Removes all Poison Wards from all enemy units on the battlefield, and steals up to 5 Spirit from the enemy team.

Then 1 random non-burning enemy is granted Lethal Poison for 999TU.
Then 1 random non-poisoned enemy is granted Mega Poison for 200TU.
Then 1 random non-poisoned enemy is granted Super Poison.
Then 1 random non-poisoned enemy is granted Poison.

This skill cannot be used again until 1 enemy turn has passed. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, this skill becomes locked for 50TU.

Mega Poison, Super Poison, and Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Super Poison deals 4 times the damage of normal poison, and cannot be overwritten by normal poison.
localization.selected:
Removes Poison wards, Steals Spirit, may Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Toxic Burst
localization.description:
1000% damage to 2 enemies. Minus 100% damage for each Spirit the enemy team has (max of -500% if the enemy team has 5+ Spirit). This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then the targets hit have burn removed (including Mega Healing Burn). Then grants all hit Mega Poisoned enemies Lethal Poison for 999TU. Then grants Mega Poison for 200TU to all other enemies that were hit.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on the affected enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.
localization.selected:
500%+ damage, Removes Burn, May Grant Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Hypnotic Swordsman
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Each time this unit damages a poisoned enemy with an attack, this unit will be healed for 100% of its max HP.

If this unit damages at least one poisoned enemy with an attack, this unit will get another turn. Damaged targets cannot trigger this effect again until TU advances. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

The first time this unit is damaged by an attack while no enemies on the battlefield are Hypnotized, and no other "Kenshin, Master of Rashomon Gate" is on the battlefield, there is a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) for this unit to Hypnotize all enemies on the battlefield. A Hypnotized enemy will use its next turn to grant the turn to and Purify the hypnotizer (the turn will be lost as if it were sleeping), and then that unit's hypnosis will end. Hypnosis is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will be canceled if the hypnotizer is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Hypnosis will fail against Boss units.

localization.name: Gatekeeper
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with Super Stealth, and a Stealth Shield.

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Poison status effects.

While there is a poisoned enemy on the battlefield, this unit has Stun Immunity and Burn Immunity.

Whenever a unit (ally or enemy) enters the battlefield from reinforcements, this unit will be healed for 100% of max HP and Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).

If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP, then until its next turn:
- this unit cannot be defeated.
- this unit heals for 10% of max HP at the end of every turn.
This is a Hold Ground+ effect, and ends after triggering once each time this unit enters the battlefield.
Whenever this unit defeats an enemy with an attack or Rashomon, this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again.

Today we've got a very special guest!

Right as the Super Idol Mirai finishes her introduction, the Ultra-Super Idol Anya makes her grand appearance. The cheers are deafening. Some fans even faint on the spot just from seeing Anya standing there.

"All right, let's do our usual song!"

In perfect unison, the crowd raises their glow sticks and braces themselves in silence. Anya grips the microphone. One deep breath.

"Boom-boom, tss-tss, chicka-chicka-tss!"

Anya—the idol who rose to the very top of the industry through sheer vocal percussion!
And today's performance? She's in top form!

MechaSisterBand02.name: Anya
MechaSisterBand02.title: Harmonic Maiden
MechaSisterBand02.description:
Ultra-Hyper-Super Idol Anya's solo concert! The Anya & Astrid duo is the most popular act in the entire world!

On the big day, fans flood in from across the globe! Every mode of transportation is jammed to a standstill! Not a single person can make it to the venue!

Anya agonizes. "I want everyone to see the show... isn't there something I can do...?"

But Astrid remains perfectly calm. "You don't need to do anything at all."

Anya, who always thinks of her fans first, murmurs in distress. "How can you say that...!?"

"Because streaming tickets are a thing."
Anya was too busy worrying about her fans that she had completely forgotten about the streaming tickets.

And so, the livestream was a massive success!

ChopinRegular01.name: Chopin
ChopinRegular01.title: Maestro of Reveries
ChopinRegular01.description:
She and Washington had been close collaborators since their student days. Together, they took on countless robotics competitions, sweeping up awards left and right.
Whenever they were called a genius duo, she would tease Washington to hide her own embarrassment—and be promptly scolded by her friend. That was happiness for her. Chopin wished those days could go on forever.
And yet, deep in her heart, she knew her illness was quietly but steadily getting worse. But even as her mind lingers on her approaching mortality, she nevertheless spent her days teasing Washington like usual.

After graduation, the two were conscripted by the RDO and tasked with leading the "Dragon Head Project."
Together, they were able to perfect the theoretical basis for the device, as well as almost completing the construction of the device itself. But one final obstacle stood in their way: the device required a computational core on par with a human brain. This became the single, glaring void in their otherwise perfect blueprint.

In that moment, an answer flickered in Chopin's mind.

—Of course. They could just extract someone's actual brain to use as a substitute.
And with so little time left anyway, she was more than willing to be that someone.

SnowWhiteNew01.title: Snow Maiden of Black & White
SnowWhiteNew01.description: Light and shadow — Snow White and Snow Black. The soul of the shadow had begun to sense her own existence gradually fading away. This was because of emotions that had unexpectedly taken root within her, born from her interactions with the hero and Snow White.

localization.name: Soul Fragment
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy. 700% damage instead if the user has survived 100TU or more on the battlefield. 1000% damage instead if the user has survived 200TU or more on the battlefield. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, enemy damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

The target hit has its sleep and burn removed (including Deep Sleep, and Mega Healing Burn) and is granted Lethal Poison for 999TU. This will overwrite other status effects on that enemy.

Then the user will add a Kuromori to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. This will not trigger if there were no enemy reinforcements at the start of the turn.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on the affected enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Blood Cycle
localization.description:
If there is a Mori at the very end of allied reinforcements, that Mori will be sacrificed, if that Mori's Element was:
- Water, Fire or Light, all non-fire enemies on the battlefield are granted the burn status effect. Then all enemies on the battlefield are granted the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. These effects will overwrite other status effects on those units.
- Storm, Earth or Dark, all allies on the battlefield will have their current TU reduced by 50TU, and gain Super Stealth and a Stealth Shield.

Otherwise, if a Mori was not sacrificed, adds 3 Super Mori's to the very end of allied reinforcements (these will be Super Kuromoris and/or Super Shiromoris at random).

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned. Super Stealth will overwrite other Status effects. Super Stealthed units ignore enemy attacks that would damage more than 1 target. Super Stealth will be removed after ignoring 3 enemy attacks since applying, and can be overwritten by other status effects, except normal Stealth. Damage will not remove Super Stealth. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying.
localization.selected: May add Moris or grant Mori sacrifice effect

localization.name: Fateful Snow
localization.description:
Removes Poison and Sleep (including Deep Sleep, and Lethal Poison) from all allies on the battlefield. All allies on the battlefield heal for 500% of the user's attack.

Then a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on or below 25% of max HP and on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This health threshold is increased by 25% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 100% of max HP after being used 3 times or more). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Unlocked each time the user uses another active skill. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. Usable 10 times per battle.

localization.name: Dark Reckoning
localization.description:
800% damage to 2 random enemies. This attack cannot be redirected by Guardians, and will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, and enemy damage reduction effects. This attack can hit targets that have the Stealth Status Effect or a passive effect that ignores multiple target attacks.

Unlocked after 5 or more units (including ephemeral ally units) on the battlefield are defeated or sacrificed by any source while this unit is on the battlefield.

localization.name: Seeds of Fate
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit cannot be poisoned or be immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy.

Whenever a Mori enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, this unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to immediately have its TU reduced to 0, and be Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).

When this unit enters battle:
- If there are at least 5 non-conjured units in the ally team (including reinforcements), this unit adds 1 Super Kuromori to a random place in allied reinforcements for each non-conjured Storm, Earth and Dark ally on the battlefield, and adds 1 Super Shiromori to a random place in allied reinforcements for each non-conjured Water, Fire and Light ally on the battlefield.
- If there are at least 5 non-conjured units in the enemy team (including reinforcements), this unit adds 1 Kuromori to a random place in enemy reinforcements for each non-conjured enemy on the battlefield.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

At the end of each of this unit's turns, this unit is granted a Burn Ward, Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, and Super Stealth. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Each time this unit gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 25% of its max HP for each ally on the battlefield (max of 100% if 4 allies are on the battlefield).

Then this unit will have its TU reduced to 0. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those units. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

This unit is never considered to be defeated by attacks and does not trigger any skills of other units whenever it is defeated or sacrificed by any source while on the battlefield.

This unit will be fully healed after each turn if it takes damage but is not defeated. This unit will be defeated after any ally or enemy turn if this unit has any of the Burn, Super Poison, or Mega Poison status effects.

Damage dealt to this unit is increased to 2.5 times the normal amount.

BeautyBeastRegular01.name: Beauty & Beast
BeautyBeastRegular01.title: Pair of Morphean Flowers
BeautyBeastRegular01.description:
Belle was born in a small town. She was raised by her parents, but financial ruin tore the family apart—and Belle was left behind.
With nowhere else to go, she found herself among a group of urchins in the backstreets. Thanks to her natural dexterity and street smarts, it wasn't long before she had made a name for herself among the backstreet's shady residents.

- Another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time.
- This unit defeats a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield with an attack.

Aigis's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

This unit cannot fall asleep or be stunned if there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements.

This unit cannot be poisoned, or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

BeautyBeastRegular02.title: Pair of Morphean Flowers
BeautyBeastRegular02.description:
Aigis had no family either. As an infant, she was abandoned in the forest near a town. Though taken in by a local family who found her, she was treated as little more than labor—and in the end, she was cast aside once again.
Because of her distinct appearance and her timid nature, she remained alone for as long as she could remember.

Until she met Belle.

localization.name: Poisonous Axe
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy. If any enemy on the battlefield is poisoned, deals 600% damage instead. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then the target hit is randomly granted either Mega Poison for 200TU, or Lethal Poison for 999TU.

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

localization.name: Budding Gifts
localization.description:
All non-burning allies are healed for 500% of the user's attack, and Enraged. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those units. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

If 2 or more enemies on the battlefield are poisoned, all allies will have the TU costs for all of their skills reduced by 30%, this will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills. Otherwise, if less than 2 enemies on the battlefield are poisoned, all enemies on the battlefield are randomly granted either Mega Poison for 200TU, or Lethal Poison for 999TU.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

May heal, enrage, quicken, or grant poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Belle of the Ball
localization.description:
600% damage to 1 enemy, and then grants that enemy the Lethal Poison status effect for 999TU. Then grants that enemy the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This attack ignores Guardians, and damage reduction effects.

Usable only if there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 25TU.

localization.name: Buzzsaw Axe
localization.description:
600% damage to 1 enemy. 800% damage instead to targets that have the Mega Poison status effect or the Lethal Poison status effect. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, enemy damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

If damage from this attack defeats a non-Ephemeral enemy, another random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Usable if any ally on the battlefield has defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield.
localization.selected: 600%+ damage, may immediately defeat another enemy

localization.name: Dreams Entwined
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. This effect can trigger only once each time this unit enters the battlefield, and is considered a Hold Ground+ effect. Whenever a Dark ally named Aigis enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again.

If there is not already a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements, this unit adds Aigis to next in line of allied reinforcements at the end of the turn whenever:
- Another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time.
- This unit defeats a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield with an attack.

Aigis's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

This unit cannot fall asleep or be stunned if there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements.

This unit has 30% damage reduction from attacks. While there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements, this unit has 60% damage reduction instead.

localization.name: Unshackled Strength
localization.description:
This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

This unit cannot be poisoned, or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 50% of its max HP.

Each time this unit damages a poisoned enemy with an attack, this unit will get another turn. This effect cannot trigger again against the same target until TU advances. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

When this unit enters battle, this unit is granted an Instant Death Ward, Sleep Ward, and Stun Ward. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored. Identical Wards cannot stack.

localization.name: Intimidate
localization.description:
Enrages the user. Weakens, and removes Stealth from all enemies on the battlefield.

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

localization.selected: Enrages user, Weakens enemies, May Change Spirit

localization.name: Golden Will
localization.description:
Heals all allies on the battlefield for 500% of the user's attack, and grants each of them a Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, and Sleep Thorns.

Then the user is granted 3 Charges, cannot be defeated for the next 100TU, and has their Active Skill TU Costs reduced by 50% for 100TU. Quicken effects will not further reduce this unit's TU costs. This alone will not reduce TU Costs to below 1TU.

Unlocked each time the user defeats another unit with an attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield. After entering battle, this unit cannot be defeated for 100TU.

This unit's attacks:
- will not wake sleeping enemies.
- heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.
- grant the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU to non-sleeping units hit after damage is dealt. Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

This unit has 50% damage reduction, plus 10% for each enemy this unit has defeated with attacks while on the battlefield (max of 80% after defeating 3+ enemies with attacks).

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be granted Counter Stance for 150TU, then become Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and heal for 50% of its max HP. Counter Stance will overwrite status effects on this unit. The next time the unit with counter stance takes damage from an enemy attack, it will become their turn.

localization.name: Brute Force
localization.description:
This unit cannot be stunned or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit cannot fall asleep if there are 2 or more enemies on the battlefield.

localization.name: Lead the Dance
localization.description:
Heals all allies on the battlefield for 500% of the user's attack, and Purifies them (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison). Allies gain 1 Spirit for each ally on the battlefield.

Then if ally Spirit is:
- At least 5 but less than 10, a random ally is granted Intense Rage, and given the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0.

localization.name: Dancing Knight
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Each time an ally (including this unit) gets the turn, this unit will heal for 25% of their max HP.

This unit's attacks ignore Guardians, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, enemy damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, the effects of Skin passive skills, and heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

When this unit damages an enemy with an attack, if they are:
- Water, Earth or Dark, Stun them for 100TU, and grant them the Mega Poison status effect for 100TU.
- Fire, Storm or Light, Weaken them, and grant them the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on that unit.

Whenever this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack, all allies are Purified. Then all other allies are given the next turns by reducing their current TU. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turns (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

If this unit has defeated a non-conjured enemy with an attack while on the battlefield, Clarice is added to the very front of allied reinforcements when this unit is defeated by an enemy attack. This is not considered a Revenge passive skill. Clarice's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

Mega Poison and Sleep will overwrite other status effects on those units. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

localization.name: Charged Performance
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit enters battle with a Charge, Stun Ward, Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, and an Instant Death Ward. An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.

Each time this unit damages an enemy with an attack, this unit is granted a Charge.

When attacking, adds 100% to the damage % of this unit's attacks for each Charge stored on this unit (e.g. Deadly Dance: 700% => 1000% damage while 3 Charges are stored on this unit).

This unit has 50% damage reduction, plus 10% for each Charge stored on this unit (max of 80% while 3 Charges are stored on this unit).

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack, and survives until after the end of the turn, if this unit is charged, this unit will spend a Charge to heal for 100% of max HP. Otherwise, if this unit is not charged, this unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to immediately have its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect.

localization.description: Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

YandereMaidBallet01.name: Clarice
YandereMaidBallet01.description:
Clarice watched it all unfold—others derided Ludmilla as someone with no talent for dance.
But even without any talent, she would not stop—stumbling, falling, sweating, and still rising again with a smile.
The sight stole Clarice's heart again and again.
Even if her movements were far from graceful, to Clarice, Ludmilla's dance was more noble—and more beautiful—than anyone else's.

Victoria was born as the eldest daughter of the long-standing Royal House of Wellmund.

localization.name: Downpour
localization.description:
Targets all enemies. Deals either 900%, 600%, or 300% damage, chosen at random for each target. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the targets from being defeated, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

The user will immediately get the next turn if this is the first time this skill has been used while on the battlefield or if the user has used Étoile's Fury since this skill was last used. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

localization.name: Spreading Chill
localization.description:
Allies gain 2 Spirit for each non-sleeping enemy on the battlefield.

Then a random enemy has their Burn removed, and is granted Frostburn and infected with it. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 5 times per battle.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Frostburn to a random non-Frostburned unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

When a unit has Frostburn and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping, then Frostburn is removed and that unit is granted the Burn status effect. Frostburn is not a status effect, but effects that remove negative status effects will also remove Frostburn. Frostburn will end if the affected unit is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Frostburn cannot apply to boss units, and cannot stack. Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects. Whenever this unit gets the turn, if this unit's Active Skills are not disabled, this unit can't have its Active Skills disabled until the end of its turn.

When this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack, all other allies on the battlefield will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

This unit enters battle with an Instant Death Ward, and Mega Healing Burn for 100TU. Then all allies on the battlefield are granted Poison Wards, and Stun Wards.

Each time an ally gets the turn while Burning, they will heal for 20% of their own max HP and then allies will gain 1 Spirit after that turn so long as this unit remains on the battlefield.

While this unit is on the battlefield, whenever a Fire or Water element unit on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time, all allies on the battlefield are Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison), and then burned.

A unit with Mega Healing Burn will heal after each turn at 20 times the rate as Healing Burn. This will overwrite other status effects including Healing Burn on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

CupidRegular01.name: Cupid
CupidRegular01.title: Sorceress of True Love
CupidRegular01.description: Whenever she senses love in the air, Cupid comes flying, forgetting all about time and place. Declarations of love, gushing about a lover, and lovers' quarrels—they all carry the sweetest scent of romance. Even now, whenever she hears someone's heart begin to race, Cupid will appear with the soft flutter of her wings.

localization.name: Hurt Feelings
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy. 800% damage instead if the target has not left the battlefield since damaging an ally with an attack while an ally "Cupid, Sorceress of True Love" was on the battlefield. This attack ignores skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

The user is granted a Sleep Ward, and Poison Ward. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.
localization.selected: 400%+ damage, grants user wards

localization.name: Restore Cupid's Link
localization.description:
Grants Cupid's Link for 50TU to another random non-conjured ally that does not already have a Link.

Then that ally and the user are:
- healed for 100% max HP.
- Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison).
- Fortified, and granted an Instant Death Ward.

Usable only if no other ally on the battlefield has Cupid's Link already, and there is a valid target. Usable 5 times per battle.

An Instant Death Ward prevents a unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.
localization.selected: Give another ally Cupid's Link

localization.name: Matchmaker
localization.description:
Another random ally that has Cupid's Link and a random ally that doesn't have Cupid's Link are given the next turns by having their TU reduced. The ally without Cupid's Link will be first in the turn order. Both units are Purified and become Enraged. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Unlocked each time the user uses Hurt Feelings or Cupid's Shot, and is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.
