localization.selected: Reduces 2 allies TU, Purifies & Enrages

localization.name: Sorceress of True Love
localization.description:
This unit starts with Cupid's Link. When this unit enters battle it grants Cupid's Link for 50TU to another random non-conjured ally that does not have a Link already. Then that ally and this unit are Fortified, and granted an Instant Death Ward.

A unit with Cupid's Link has these effects:

This unit cannot become Charmed.

Each time an ally with Cupid's Link gets the turn, this unit will be healed for 50% of its max HP.

This unit has 0.25x of their original Attack added to their Attack while they are not Enraged. This increase will stack with other Attack increases (e.g. 1.5x + 0.25x => 1.75x total).

When this unit defeats an enemy with an attack, after the end of the turn, all other allies with Cupid's Link will be given the next turns by reducing their current TU, and become Purified. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target). These TU reductions may trigger before or after other effects that adjust the turn order.

This Link is removed if this unit or the unit that granted it leaves the battlefield. This unit cannot gain other Links.

localization.name: Winged Sweetheart
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with a Sleep Ward, and Poison Ward.

This unit cannot be stunned or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit has 25% damage reduction from attacks. While there are 2 Linked allies on the battlefield, this unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks instead.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt, will not wake sleeping enemies, ignore damage reduction effects, and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent targets from being defeated.

The first time this unit is damaged by an enemy attack and survives until after the end of the turn, there is a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) for this unit to Charm all enemies on the battlefield for 50TU. Whenever this unit uses Restore Cupid's Link, this effect is reset so it can trigger again.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be Purified, and heal for 25% of its max HP.

A Charmed unit has their attack greatly reduced (e.g. to 0.5x of their original Attack for a unit with no other Attack modifiers. The effect of Charmed may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects). Charmed overwrites Enrage and Weaken effects, and units that are Charmed cannot be Enraged or Weakened. Charmed units are less likely to target the unit that Charmed them with most active skills. Charmed is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will end if the Charmed unit leaves the battlefield.

localization.description:
250% damage to 1 enemy, plus 150% for each time the user has already used this skill or Hurt Feelings while on the battlefield (max of 1000% total damage after the user has used this skill or Hurt Feelings 5 or more times).

Every second time this skill is activated by the user while on the battlefield, a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Usable 10 times per battle.

At the height of his conquest, the Primordial of Storms chose him as his Avatar and gifted him a hammer worthy of a god. They say Sven never died but sails through the heavens still, battering Erden's enemies with the fury of thunder.

localization.name: Damage Down
localization.description: Reduces damage from enemy attacks by 10% if this unit's current TU is 50 or less.

AntaresGreatSword01.name: Arclight Buster
AntaresGreatSword01.description:
"The warrior knows his sword is no symbol of peace. The weak he encounters will shrink away at the very sight of it; the strong will see that he wields it and challenge him to battle. Why, then, do swords exist? 

Because although a sword will never bring peace, it may yet bring justice." 

-- Writings of Avonia, Vessel of the Goddess's Wisdom, slain in the Third Requiem

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks if 2 or more enemies have 100+ TU.

IdolStaff01.name: Pink Sugar
IdolStaff01.description:
The idol's voice was so sweet, and so unimaginably strong, that the tabloids insisted her signature microphone was enchanted. Surely anyone who held it could sound as marvelous as she did. 

When she heard this, the idol invited her accusers onstage at her next concert and challenged them to sing into her 'magical' mic stand. 

The rumor died that very night.

localization.name: TU Cost Down
localization.description: 10% reduction to TU costs if the equipped unit's HP is at least 99% of max.

LonginusSpear01.name: Longinus
LonginusSpear01.description:
Not every Pandemonium has ended happily.

When a Crimson Crestbearer, drunk on power, marched across the land as its conqueror, his partner Cerulean faced a torturous choice. Would he kill the chosen one and condemn the world to a century of Pandemonium, or allow him to forge his empire of blood in exchange for slaying the Eternal?

In the end, he stabbed his former friend in the back, stopping him from taking Rigland's capital at an unfathomable cost. Their battlefield lies fallow to this day.

localization.name: TU Cost Down
localization.description: 10% reduction to TU costs if this unit has defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield.

The hammer Mistelzweig, legendary weapon of Rigland's northernmost lord, takes care of those first two duties. His feasts ensure the last is never forgotten.

RedBladeKatana01.name: Suzaku no Tachi
RedBladeKatana01.description:
"To the south rose a warlord, a force like a forest fire, devastating all in his path.

He claimed to be the Vermillion Bird made flesh, a god destined to forge the land anew.

But people are not made of steel; they cannot be tempered in flames. When the might of the emperor descended on him at last, he held only a fortress of smoke and ashes."

-- from The Imperial Histories of Eastland, author unknown"

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks against units with active skills that can Stun.

GreenWeaveKatana01.name: Tsukuyomi
GreenWeaveKatana01.description:
"Eastland, home of the bikki, has not suffered an invasion for over a thousand years. An order of samurai, their souls purified by the light of the moon, fight tirelessly to protect their kingdom's shores, pushing back all who would claim it.

No one knows how this order began, or how its members are chosen. Only the samurai know, and they do not speak a word of it to anyone."

localization.description: 7% bonus to attacks against units with Poison Eater or Vengeance Strike type active skills.

OssiaMace01.name: Lilium Sanguis
OssiaMace01.description:
"Codename: ATR-0X1
Classification: Lilium Sanguis

Specimen continues to exceed expectations. Its petals, stamen, and stem have hardened to a durable texture resembling iron, and it appears to emit an odor both toxic and caustic to all who inhale.

I feel it is now ready to graduate from a diet of blood to live prey. Father will be most pleased."

localization.name: Damage Down
localization.description: Reduces damage from enemy attacks by 7% as long as allies have 2 or less Spirit.

IkemenKatana01.name: Murakumo
IkemenKatana01.description:
I still remember the look on my mother's face when she gave me this sword.
"We of the branch family are shadows. The gathering clouds that sweep across the moon that is the royal family."
She apologized that she couldn't raise me in the main family, and looked away.

I wanted to tell her it didn't matter, so long as I could protect Sanga. But the words died on my lips.

Even so, without this blade, I would never have met my Master. Fate, it seems, is a fickle thing.

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks against units with Over Drive type active skills.

HellGreatAxe01.name: Bloodbane
HellGreatAxe01.description:
Every weapon carries the lives of those it has slain. Blades across Erden, rusted and gleaming, hide histories of untold death. Even so, none can match the cruelty of the axe forged in hellfire.

With every swing, it echoes with the cries of the damned. The souls of its victims rest not in the afterlife, but within the axe's cold iron, damned to bathe in blood for all eternity.

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks against units that have been in battle for 200TU or more.

DarkWeaveSpear01.name: Spear of Silence
DarkWeaveSpear01.description:
Many of Erden's smiths enchant their wares with magic. Only a hidden order of mages employs the forbidden art of soulforging, passed down in whispers from times of old. This spear, one of their earliest creations, brought its wielders unmatched glory.

Yet mysteriously, each of them met with a grizzly and untimely demise.

BlackWarHammer01.name: Athanor
BlackWarHammer01.description:
Should you wish to forge this hammer of pure destruction:

First, melt the blade of a fallen soldier and inscribe with its iron a circle. Within it, place an offering of gold equal to all that you own. Shed upon this the blood of your beloved--how you obtain it matters not.

From these three ingredients, the same demanded by war, shall your victory rise.

localization.description: Reduces damage from enemy attacks by 7% as long as there are 4 or more units with the Burn status effect.

AnchorHammer01.name: Seastrider
AnchorHammer01.description:
A pirate's ship is his home, his love, his truest companion. When the captain's sloop sailed her final voyage, too old and weathered to go on, he didn't sell her for scrap. He set fire to her sails and let her loose at sea, her only fitting grave. Still, he couldn't bear to part with her completely.

He had her anchor forged into a hammer, so he could carry her with him to the ends of Erden.

EgyptGreatAxe01.name: Ma'at
EgyptGreatAxe01.description: Having conquered the southern continent, Ga'Khila, greatest of the ancient sziviik Ga's, grew restless once more. He turned his eyes to the raging sea keeping Westland out of reach. His advisers pleaded with him to stay and rule over his young kingdom, but the fire in his veins spurred him on. Few know how he managed to cross those treacherous waters. Legend has it he commanded the desert sun with his axe, cutting a dry path for his army stroke by stroke.

When the hordes came, the holy warrior thought all her hope lost. Her soldiers slain, her weapon shattered, she raised her hand skyward to beg her god for one more chance. One more battle.

A winged spear formed from the sunlight streaming through her fingers, and with this miraculous gift in hand, she cut down every monster in her path.

RolotiaStaff01.name: Horologia
RolotiaStaff01.description:
The great Primordial Chronos gifts few with her power over time. The temptation to misuse it—to erase mistakes or to freeze oneself in a moment of happiness—is too much for many to bear. A weak person, with such magic in their hands, could twist the flow of history into something unrecognizable.

It is fortunate, then, that the wielder of Chronos's most powerful staff is anything but weak.

localization.description: 10% reduction to TU costs if 2 or more enemies have 100+ TU.

But this hammer, bearing within it the voidborn magic of a dragon lord, has proven the ambitious young inventor was never a fool.

His teachers scolded him for his bizarre experiments. His classmates snickered at his rickety inventions, contraptions of gears and glass that exploded more often than they functioned. Even in university, his dream of mana-powered machinery got him laughed out of the lecture hall.

But this hammer, bearing within it the voidborn magic of a dragon lord, has proven the ambitious young inventor was never a fool.

localization.name: Damage Down
localization.description: Reduces damage from enemy attacks by 7% as long as the enemy has 1 or more characters left than allies.

Cerulean as the vault of heaven, this blade has saved Erden once. It will do so again.

CyrusMace01.name: Thieves' Fortune
CyrusMace01.description:
Hymelia's King of Thieves made his name parting nobles from their riches. With their silver and gold, he forged himself a mace and dared any challenger to take it from him.

Cyrus stole it without batting an eye, but turned down the title it brought him. After all, no thief with any dignity would call himself a king.

DarkAstridGreatsword01.name: Dragonfury
DarkAstridGreatsword01.description:
An heirloom of the von Draclow family, the greatsword Dragonfury has been passed down for generations without rusting or going dull. As inexhaustible as Astrid's will to fight, enemies both living and undead have fallen to its deadly edge. The very act of battle seems to keep it keen.

Learning to wield it from her father is the one memory of him Astrid looks upon with fondness.

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks if the enemy has 2 or more poisoned units.

DemonKatana01.name: Muramasa
DemonKatana01.description:
Many hundreds of years ago, a young warlord sought out an oni for aid. He offered it his blade for a home, and the blood of his enemies for sustenance. The oni ate well, but its hunger was greater than the warlord could have ever known.

When he died on his feet in battle, some said his heart gave out. Others whispered that the oni finally consumed his soul.

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks against units with Stealth Strike type active skills.

SeaSerpentHammer01.name: Depthforged
SeaSerpentHammer01.description:
An ancient warhammer passed down for generations by a clan of seafaring raiders. Some say their first chieftain pulled it from the ocean depths. Some say it was forged as an offering to the great dragon Kaidaros, and that is why it possesses its power over the sea.

All know its strikes echo like thunder, and any captain who sees it knows his ship is doomed.

localization.description: Reduces damage from enemy attacks by 7% as long as allies have 7 or more Spirit.

GoldPirateSword01.name: Aquiline Saber
GoldPirateSword01.description:
There once was a hero by the name of Aymr Vanholm, known as the Eagle Knight.
He was blessed by the spirits of the winds themselves, and his swordsmanship was so fast and elegant that those who saw him thought him divine.
He defeated many fearsome beasts and demons, each victory another page in his heroic legend, and he became known as one of the greatest knights in history - the Blades of Erden.
Even after his death, the equipment he used in life retained the powerful blessings of the wind spirits. This sword is one such relic; lighter, faster, and sharper than any ordinary blade, it waits for its own legend to continue.

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks if 2 or more allies have Stealth.

He defeated many fearsome beasts and demons, each victory another page in his heroic legend, and he became known as one of the greatest knights in history - the Blades of Erden.
Even after his death, the equipment he used in life retained the powerful blessings of the wind spirits. This sword is one such relic; lighter, faster, and sharper than any ordinary blade, it waits for its own legend to continue.

localization.name: Attack Up
localization.description: 15% bonus to attacks if 2 or more allies have Stealth.

NorzaSword01.name: Nameless
NorzaSword01.description:
A weapon found by Kisara on the battlefield, given to Norza as his first blade.
By the ornamentation, it was likely a noble's blade; but the owner's identity, and the sword's original name, are lost to time.
When he first received it, Norza was almost shorter than the blade was long; but through his years of hard training, he learned to master it.
This blade serves as a memento of Norza's past life. The moment he let it go was the moment he fell to darkness, and the moment of his final parting with his Master.

localization.name: Offense Up
localization.description: 7% bonus to attacks and 6% reduction to TU costs if 2 or more enemies have 100+ TU.

BabyDarkDragonKatana01.name: Bitten Blade
BabyDarkDragonKatana01.description: According to legend, one day a brave young warrior found a strange beast unlike anything she has seen before. Heavily injured, the beast offered the hero a blade with a peculiar shape in exchange for its life. Able to talk, the beast described how the blade belonged to a great warrior that it had fought in a deadly duel, and the two holes near its handle were from the beast's own teeth. Just as the beast could bite through metal, the edge of this blade could cut through the beast's otherwise impenetrable hide.

But ornamentation weighs a wielder down, and talk of legends breeds dependence, or overconfidence. This is a spear stripped down to its most essential form: a weapon meant for killing, which it does very, very well.

Armor01.name: Sturdy Mail
Armor01.description: Armor wrought from a rare metal found only in the Gamlan Mines

KukuriKnife01.name: Leaf Blade
KukuriKnife01.description: A small elven blade, light but strong.

HawkCoin01.name: Hawk Coin
HawkCoin01.description: The lucky coin of a jester.

Bracelet01.name: Gem Bangle
Bracelet01.description: A remnant of the Old Kingdom.

Gauntlet01.name: Steel Fist
Gauntlet01.description: An enchanted gauntlet, the forgotten heirloom of a disgraced noble house.

AlchemyFlask01.name: Vim Flask
AlchemyFlask01.description: A flask containing an energizing tonic.

GreenRing01.name: Wise Ring
GreenRing01.description: A ring said to enhance the wisdom of the wearer.

Girdle01.name: Stout Belt
Girdle01.description: A well-crafted piece of waist armor, forged by the artisans of Urg Roa.

RedRings01.name: Wild Rings
RedRings01.description: Rings that make the wearer feel more aggressive.

Bracer01.name: Strong Arm
Bracer01.description: A young man had this arm brace forged to keep his true love safe on the battlefield.

Earrings01.name: Lilac Drops
Earrings01.description: Earrings once worn by an elven prince.

Feathers01.name: Fancy Pin
Feathers01.description: A pin favored by Rigland's nobles.

Skirt01.name: Strike Skirt
Skirt01.description: A crimson skirt worn by many of the Red Dragon Knights.

LimePotion01.name: Vigor Vial
LimePotion01.description: A vial containing an energizing tonic.

RedGreenDroplet01.name: Pretty Jewel
RedGreenDroplet01.description: A trinket purchased by a traveler in a distant land, crafted from a mineral not found in Westland.

BronzePickaxe01.name: Bronze Axe
BronzePickaxe01.description: A ceremonial axe that once hung in the quarters of the head miner of Gamlan.

RitualBlade01.name: Ritual Knife
RitualBlade01.description: A small but wicked blade used in the ceremonies of the Ivari, a nature-worshipping community from northern Rigland.

Crown01.name: Ptaki Circlet
Crown01.description: A tiara worn during the coming-of-age ceremony of the Ptaki, an order of female warriors from an island north of Westland.

HookKnife01.name: Hook Knife
HookKnife01.description: An elaborate blade once carried by the brazen captain of a nefarious pirate fleet.

Cape01.name: Ptaki Cape
Cape01.description: A cape worn by the Ptaki, an order of female warriors from an island north of Westland.

WingTiara01.name: Ptaki Diadem
WingTiara01.description: A diadem worn by high-ranking members of the Ptaki, an order of female warriors from an island north of Westland.

EvilLapelPin01.name: Cursed Pin
EvilLapelPin01.description: A malignant-looking brooch stolen from the barrow of a wicked king.

RedKnightHelm01.name: Red Knight Helm
RedKnightHelm01.description: The trademark red helmet worn by the Red Knights. Though uncomfortable, it is made with the finest quality metal and offers great protection.

SziFire01.name: Szi Flame
SziFire01.description: The art of spinning flame into a glass orb is highly regarded by the Szi. These flames are invaluable on cold and dark nights.

DragonRings01.name: Dragon Rings
DragonRings01.description: Rings imbued with the power of two of Erden's great dragons.

AliceRabbitDoll01.name: Tavun Rabbit
AliceRabbitDoll01.description: The illustrious, and insufferable, Lord Tavun Rabbitus XII, twelfth of his line, first among peers and Lady Alice's very best friend. Or possibly, just an ordinary stuffed rabbit. It's hard to be sure.

LunaNote01.name: Luna's Notes
LunaNote01.description: A haphazard, handwritten book of notes on monsters, their habitats and traits, and much more. Despite the messy construction, the information inside is minutely detailed and accurate.

SakuraArmor01.name: Oumon Yoroi
SakuraArmor01.description: A fanciful suit of armor found at the foot of Oumei's tree. It shows no wear or any sign of age, and practically hums with magical power and the waking energy of springtime. The faint, lovely scent of cherry blossoms surrounds it always.

LudmillaGauntlet01.name: Ludmilla's Bracer
LudmillaGauntlet01.description: The right vambrace from Marshal Ludmilla's armor. As strong and sturdy as the woman who wears it, this armor is a symbol of her resolve to protect the weak, shelter the helpless, and strike back against the forces of Darkness.

MyshaPauldron01.name: Inheritor's Bangle
MyshaPauldron01.description: A piece made by Gilgan in his apprenticeship, once worn by the hero Druke. It has been reforged by his hand, and passed on to the hero of the next generation.

SwimRing01.name: Swim Ring
SwimRing01.description: A circular bladder made from a mysterious, unknowable substance. It can be filled with a surprising amount of air. Astrid seems quite taken with it. "Isn't it fascinating? This ring floats on water!"

Pearl01.name: Moondrop Pearl
Pearl01.description: On Laomis, it's commonly said that when the moon is full, oysters rise to the surface of the ocean and open themselves wide. Then, moonlight crystallizes inside them, and becomes a pearl. You may laugh, but if you hold this pearl up alongside the full moon, you'll see that they glow with the same radiance.

BlackBelt01.name: Kuro-Obi
BlackBelt01.description: Tying this belt around your waist fills you with a mysterious sense of power. Certain schools of bikki martial artists use black belts like this one as a proof of high rank.

RizetteBelt01.name: Rizette's Pouch
RizetteBelt01.description: A regular pouch that used to be sold in the village of Westcarte. It is not particuarly fancy or special, but a lot can fit into it without getting cumbersome for the wearer. Also, it is more durable than it looks, providing some protection in addition to transport. Most importantly however, it is full of precious memories of a home that no longer exists.

AstridHairpin01.name: Astrid's Hairpin
AstridHairpin01.description:
A life of extravagance. From her infancy, everything she could have ever desired was already within reach.
This hairpin was the first thing in her life she chose for herself. Her father, who always believed avarice was a mark of nobility, was pleased to purchase it for her.
The deep red roses symbolize a strong heart, and the everburning flame of her will.

RolotiaClock01.name: Mortal Timepiece
RolotiaClock01.description: A magnificent clock crafted by Chronos, the Primordial of Time. No matter what calamities it suffers, no matter how long it ticks away, its hands will never fall behind. Some say it controls the flow of time itself.

ValkyrieMedal01.name: Valkyrie Crest
ValkyrieMedal01.description: The mark of Last Bastion's Valkyries. These elite soldiers have proved their valor against the undead, and can leave the city whenever they choose. Many envy this honor. Few within Last Bastion's walls have the same freedom.

LudmillaJacket01.name: Leather Raiment
LudmillaJacket01.description: When she was promoted to Vice Commander, Ludmilla received this distinctive jacket from Astrid's father. More lightweight than armor, yet sturdy enough to deflect both blades and claws, she deemed it suitable protection from any threat she might face. Few have seen her without it since.

HymeliaCrown01.name: Crown of Hymelia
HymeliaCrown01.description: After Hymelia found riches in their bordering mountains, the Hymelian royal family used their newfound wealth to forge themselves a crown. The people marvel at its magnificence when the king wears it in public, but some whisper that the gold might be better spent feeding his subjects than dazzling them.

DragonShield01.name: Shield of the Six
DragonShield01.description:
Fire. Water. Storm. Earth. Light. Shadow.

Six are counted the elements of Erden.
Six the Dragon Lords who command them.
Six powers birthed to slay the dread Eternal.

One shield holds a shard of their magics combined.

CrystalBeads01.name: Holy Maiden's Lumiary
CrystalBeads01.description:
Many in the kingdom of Belterre have a humble Lumiary -- that is, a string of prayer beads meant to steady concentration and encourage fervent prayer. Only the Lumiary belonging to the Holy Maiden, however, has the privilege to be made of crystal and gold.

It is only fitting that His Radiance's emissary share a measure of his glory, after all.

YukiSunHat01.name: Elegant Sun Hat
YukiSunHat01.description: Woven from fine, lightweight straw, anyone who wears this hat will be spared the glare of the summer sun. Oddly enough, a cool breeze always wafts through its ribbons, no matter how hot or how muggy the weather.

RolotiaSwimsuitClock01.name: Tropical Timekeeper
RolotiaSwimsuitClock01.description:
Time moves differently in summer. Lazy afternoons drift by as slowly as the clouds overhead, yet the season itself passes in the blink of an eye. Why does this happen? Is there an explanation, or does the heat simply drive the world mad?

Perhaps the erratic ticking of Chronos's summer clock is to blame.

DragonfireBottle01.name: Dragonfire Flask
DragonfireBottle01.description:
Last Bastion's citizens know well the scarlet glint of dragonfire. Even the most outspoken don't dare approach a soldier with a flask on their belt. The tar-like substance ignites on impact, instantly burning its targets to ash, whether they be undead soldiers or unruly rebels.

If they knew the secret of its creation, they would fear it even more.

EnchantedRing01.name: Ring of Withering
EnchantedRing01.description:
Alastor Velarius, the venerated Bergarian sorcerer, disappeared after the reigning Emperor accused him of treason. He took refuge in the southern kingdom of Rigland, but never let it be said he went into hiding.

No, he has been biding his time, honing his craft, pushing magic to achieve both the miraculous and the monstrous. His obsidian ring may extend his natural life -- but only at the cost of another offered in sacrifice.

OniSchoolbag01.name: Devilish Schoolbag
OniSchoolbag01.description:
Hibiki never leaves her room without the essentials: her phone, her lip gloss, her kitty cat headphones, her GameGirl, a few boxes of chocky, a magazine or two, half a dozen gel pens, a crumpled pack of tissues from six months ago, just in case...

Wait, textbooks? Why would she need those?

DragonPlushie01.name: Santa Claws
DragonPlushie01.description:
"Dear Santa,

My mom thinks I've been a good boy this year, so she said I should send you this letter. There's not a lot I want for Christmas, though. Elran's gonna ask you for a sword, but I don't think I want one. There's nothing around here I need to fight.

Maybe, if you're a monster trainer, could you catch a Lightling for me? I like them a lot!

Signed,
Finn, age 9"

IdolMic01.name: Trusty Microphone
IdolMic01.description:
Mirai Narukami, number one idol across all global charts, sings with the voice of the Goddess. Does a Goddess need a microphone to be heard? 

Probably not. But she insisted on this adorable prop in her first live performance, and she hasn't gone without it since.

GlassSyringe01.name: Booster Shot
GlassSyringe01.description:
Many people hate going to the doctor. The smell, the scrutiny, and of course, the inevitable shots make the whole affair uncomfortable to be sure. But who could ever be afraid of a needle as cute as this one?

Sit still now. It'll only hurt for a second...or so they say.

Katashiro01.name: Sage's Katashiro
Katashiro01.description: A paper katashiro inscribed with the seal of the Great Sage. It is said to ward off all manner of misfortune and harm.

BlackSnowCrown01.name: Ebony Crown
BlackSnowCrown01.description: The dark crown worn by Snow Black. A manifestation of dark magic, seething with hatred and despair.

MaidHairBand01.name: Maid's Bonnet
MaidHairBand01.description: She will likely continue wearing it forever.

BunnyHairBand01.name: Bunny Headband
BunnyHairBand01.description: A headband worn as part of the uniform in Orka's casino. It took Rizette a while to find the resolve to put this on.

ChampionBelt01.name: Champion's Belt
ChampionBelt01.description: A belt that has adorned the waists of champions, berserkers, blackguards, and kings. Who will be the next to claim it?

CyrusRings01.name: The Devil
CyrusRings01.description: Fifteenth Arcana of the Tarot. Reversed, it signifies duplicity, corruption, and inescapable fate. A child of adultery, the man grew to love the Tarot—not knowing that fate cannot be deceived.

SquidArmor01.name: Found Fathoms
SquidArmor01.description: Armor beloved by the pirate Dargarossa, found decorating the depths of a treasure trove. It's said to have revived a human who died to the sea while wearing it.

JeanneFlag01.name: Maiden's Banner
JeanneFlag01.description: Under the holy maiden's banner, the people were inspired, a hero arose—and the angel smiled.

ThunderlingHelmet01.name: Bolt-Bearer Helm
ThunderlingHelmet01.description: The lightning bolts on this helm are said to help boost the wearer's physical abilities.

EternalRing01.name: Daybreak Band
EternalRing01.description: A priceless ring set with a jewel containing all the world's curses and blessings.

ExeterniaSchematics01.name: Sword Diagram
ExeterniaSchematics01.description: Blueprint for the sealing sword Exeternia. Drawn up by a genius magic scholar, it uses formulas only she can decipher; other scholars have been unable to replicate the sword.

DiabolosArmor01.name: Evershade Armor
DiabolosArmor01.description: The armor wasn't entirely the color of shadows. Just like the dragon it was crafted to resemble wasn't always entirely evil.

OrcanixShield01.name: Orcanix's Aegis
OrcanixShield01.description: I refuse, I refuse! I reject everything. Life, death—I repudiate it all.

MinotaurHelmet01.name: The Select's Helm
MinotaurHelmet01.description: A helmet bestowed only upon the chosen ones who have passed a trial. It grants the wearer the mental strength to go on even when they've lost the will to fight.

TaotieRing01.name: Scenic Snowband
TaotieRing01.description: A legendary ring from the snowy northern lands. Its beautiful gem, rumored to contain a snow spirit, captivates all who behold it.

BikkiFan01.name: Prized Suehiro
BikkiFan01.description: A fine piece, made with a master craftsman's ingenuity. Like a willow swaying in the wind, one touch and enemy attacks are rendered powerless.

ArcaneRing01.name: Everlight Ring
ArcaneRing01.description: A mythical ring said to have existed since the world began. The wearer is said to be granted eternal tranquility.

AirDragonArmor01.name: OWM-Armor
AirDragonArmor01.description: Made of an unknown substance harder than even diamond. Scholars whisper that it's an artifact of a mysterious ancient civilization.

JeanneCrown01.name: Crown of Flowers
JeanneCrown01.description: Let's make these again someday! The casual promise exchanged in her younger days remains etched into her mind even now.

BikkiHelmet01.name: Prized Aquakabuto
BikkiHelmet01.description: Five pieces of armor, said to have been forged by the legendary bikki craftsman Goji long, long ago, are carefully guarded as prized treasures of the bikki race.

OrcanixCloak01.name: Hel's Almuce
OrcanixCloak01.description: Descended from darkness, embracing darkness, returning to darkness. The wearer of this cloak will not fear darkness, but become its kin, with darkness as their mother.

KaijuShield01.name: Gluttonous Shield
KaijuShield01.description: Less a shield than a beast possessed of a rapacious hunger, it absorbs incoming blows as though devouring them.

MagnifoDagger01.name: Heathen Dagger
MagnifoDagger01.description: A taboo dagger that grants tremendous might to wielders who worship a certain god. It's said to be so dangerous that even the god's own cult kept it strictly under wraps.

FornaxosArmor01.name: Inferno Armor
FornaxosArmor01.description: Armor imbued with the flames of Fornaxos, legendary Dragon of Fire. It's said to be impervious even to boiling magma.

KaidarosHelmet01.name: Azure Elegy Helm
KaidarosHelmet01.description: A helmet imbued with the power of Kaidaros, legendary Dragon of the Sea. Constructed to withstand rough currents, it's prized in underwater battles.

BahamutShield01.name: Scute of Finality
BahamutShield01.description: The cursed shades of the underworld given form. Guards the boundary between life and death.

ExeterniaTalisman01.name: Glowing Aegis
ExeterniaTalisman01.description: A crimson aegis stone created to protect its bearer from all of the world's misfortunes. Those who possess this stone will be steered clear of bad luck.

NovaBlastArmor01.name: Blueflash Armor
NovaBlastArmor01.description: Top-quality, tidily forged armor that's extremely lightweight. It takes its name from the appearance of lightning flashing across the sky.

MusashiButterfly01.name: Butterfly Hairpin
MusashiButterfly01.description: One of very few things Lü Bu has obtained in a legitimate way. Considering that she actually bought two, perhaps she intended to give the one she doesn't wear to someone special.

ArcaneShield01.name: Will Unto Eternity
ArcaneShield01.description: A mythical shield said to have existed since the world began. Legend says it cleanses the soul of the one who possesses it, eventually leading them to a higher plane of existence.

NovaBlastHelmet01.name: Boltblast Helmet
NovaBlastHelmet01.description: Blue sky and white lightning meet in this helmet, which boasts both the defensive power to withstand lightning strikes and the flexibility of an ever-changing sky.

NapoleonBadge01.name: Lugrasse's Star
NapoleonBadge01.description: The distinction awarded by the first empress of Lugrasse to a group of knights from the kingdom across the sea. It is a token of her gratitude for saving the world, as well as an apology for involving them in a crisis of her own making.

Hakama01.name: Pale Blue Haori
Hakama01.description: The uniform presented to each member of the Shinsengumi by its commander. Hijikata never wore it, saying it restricted movements. Okita never wore it, saying it was tacky. Deep in their hearts, though, they both just didn't want to get it dirty. On the back, the fabric is emblazoned with the character for "truth."

TristanHarp01.name: Voice of Woe
TristanHarp01.description: Should you ever hear the sweet tune of this harp on the battlefield, abandon all hope. For it is your requiem that it shall play.

KingChessPiece01.name: King of Camelot
KingChessPiece01.description: A symbol of royal majesty and wisdom. Passed down from generation to generation, it marks the true king of Camelot.

MermaidPearl01.name: Mermaid's Teardrop
MermaidPearl01.description:
Every so often, the pearl could hear a mermaid's voice from the safety of its shell. Her song echoing throughout the seas was the reflection of her compassionate heart—and at the same time, the cue for everyone to forget her.
The pearl could not move nor could it speak, but it would remember. It would keep all the kindness and sorrow carried by the mermaid's voice forever.

BikkiScroll01.name: Kisen Scroll
BikkiScroll01.description: One of 200 scrolls researched over many long years, said to contain the medical, military, and metallurgical secrets of the bikki race.

DaVinciNecklace01.name: Lovers' Oath
DaVinciNecklace01.description: A set of two pendants, each adorned with half a gemstone—one that was split by a certain couple as they promised each other undying love. Should life ever separate them, the gems will surely bring them back together.

YamatoTurret01.name: Thundering Turret
YamatoTurret01.description: The barrels of the three cannons unleash thunderous blasts of fire, decimating the whole battlefield.

ZoroMask01.name: Mask of a Thief
ZoroMask01.description: Shrouded in mystery, the mask gleams in the light of this one-night stage.

ElizabethEarring01.name: The Royal Sapphire
ElizabethEarring01.description: A royal jewel entrusted to Elizabeth by her mother. Its brilliances reflects the grand nobility of their hearts.

ChronosClock01.name: World Clock
ChronosClock01.description: A small clock under the protection of Chronos. If its hands stop moving, that is when time itself will cease to flow.

SilverKnightArmor01.name: Silverlight Armor
SilverKnightArmor01.description: Gleaming like moonlight, this armor was forged specially for the proud and noble order. Its weight is such that no ordinary knight can walk, let alone fight in it.

SakamotoCloak01.name: Cloak of Dawn
SakamotoCloak01.description: Shrouded in a dark radiance, this cloak pulses with the unyielding will of one destined to reshape the course of history.

BergarianHelmet01.name: Apocalypse Hat
BergarianHelmet01.description: A hat once worn by the leader of a certain religious cult. It is made from a material unknown to this world.

AnastasiaHat01.name: Frostlite Kubanka
AnastasiaHat01.description: A queen's treasure passed down from her mother in a certain land of ice. The hat contains an eternal warmth, undiminished by any blizzard.

BahamutCollar01.name: The Dragonbinder
BahamutCollar01.description: A sealing collar used by the legendary dragon hunter. Under its curse, any dragon becomes as helpless as an infant.

ZeusGauntlet01.name: Sturmhond
ZeusGauntlet01.description: Heavenly gauntlets of thunder that only knights chosen by the god of lightning are permitted to wear.

KenshinBracelet01.name: Dispelling Beads
KenshinBracelet01.description: Prayer beads said to absorb impurity. While they protect their bearer, the misfortune accumulated within the beads may eventually bring calamity.

ThorBelt01.name: Morphing Belt
ThorBelt01.description: A mysterious belt that unleashes the user's true form in moments of absolute peril.

ChopinBaton01.name: Moonlight Baton
ChopinBaton01.description: A baton for conducting sweet melodies. It is made using the most advanced theories, especially those that grate on the enemy's nerves.

LinkedRings01.name: Entwined Forever
LinkedRings01.description: Two rings that bore witness to an eternal bond. Even after the end of their sweet dream, their love shall never fade.

VictoriaCrown01.name: Swan Crown
VictoriaCrown01.description: A jeweled crown that is the undisputed symbol of royal authority over a nation. But only those truly worthy of kingship are allowed to inherit it.

JeanneDress01.name: Maiden's Dress
JeanneDress01.description: The holy maiden's usual dress. It's full of fun memories made with her elder sister—it's said the maiden gets a warm feeling when she slides her arms through its sleeves even today.

MizuchiDarkMedal01.name: Taiji Bagua Amulet
MizuchiDarkMedal01.description:
A potent charm that contains the flow of yin and yang among the eight mystic directions of the universe.
It cloaks its wearer in an invisible aura of dominance, as well as purifying and dispelling all evil energies and curses brought against them.

NewsBoyCap01.name: Fine Detective Cap
NewsBoyCap01.description:
A hat belonging to a master detective, who was capable of leading any difficult case to its solution.
Rumor has it that just wearing it can make you smarter.

BunnyEarHeadband01.name: Dreamy Headband
BunnyEarHeadband01.description: A voice calls from somewhere, beckoning, "Come this way." Follow the voice you hear in your rabbit ears, and before you know it, you'll be lost in a dream.

GalahadHelmet01.name: Helm of Fealty
GalahadHelmet01.description: Galahad's helm, adorned in silver and gold. It symbolizes the unwavering conviction of a taciturn knight, who remains steadfast in her duty.

localization.selected: Reduce TU of 1 ally to 0

localization.name: B. A. M.
localization.description:
800% damage to 1 enemy, and randomly grants that enemy either Stun for 200TU, Mega Poison for 200TU, or Sleep for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and revenge passive skills. If Ally Spirit is at 0, allies gain 5 Spirit. If Ally Spirit is at 10, allies lose 5 Spirit. Usable if allies have 0 or 10 Spirit.

Sleep and Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.
localization.selected: 800% damage to 1 enemy, ignores armor

localization.name: Kind of Powerful?
localization.description:
This unit has a 33% chance to:

- have its TU reduced to 0 after dealing damage with an Attack (1 chance per hit).
- each turn, survive any damage that would defeat it with 1HP.
- ignore the incoming status effects Poison, and Burn.
- ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets. Attacks that target All allies will not be ignored.
- enrage 1 random ally at the end of each turn.
- weaken 1 random enemy at the end of each turn.

The chance for each effect is determined independently each time they may occur. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

localization.name: The Great One
localization.description:
Whenever an enemy enters the battlefield from reinforcements, this unit has a 100% chance to immediately have its TU reduced to 0, be Purified, and be granted Sleep Immunity until the end of the turn.

The first time this unit is damaged by an attack while this unit has no Charges, and is below 10% of max HP, it will enter Warped Reality for 200TU. While in Warped Reality, this unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield, cannot be defeated by damage, has 90% damage reduction from attacks and is a Guardian.

Whenever this unit gets the turn in Warped Reality, it will lose the turn and Mega Poison all non-sleeping enemies for 200TU. Then if there is more than 1 enemy on the battlefield and no enemy is Hypnotized, this unit will hypnotize 1 random enemy on the battlefield. This unit cannot be Hypnotized while in Warped Reality. When Warped Reality ends, this unit will be sacrificed.

While this unit is a Guardian, for any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage. A Hypnotized enemy will use its next turn to grant the turn to and Purify the hypnotizer (the turn will be lost as if it were sleeping), and then the hypnosis will end. Hypnosis is not a status effect and cannot be removed by Purify skills, but will be canceled if the hypnotizer is defeated or leaves the battlefield.

While this unit is on the battlefield, at the end of this unit or an ally Suimori's turn, all allies will:
- Gain Coral Barrier for 100TU.
- have Burn and Poison status effects (including Lethal Poison) removed.

If this unit is charged, not burning, and there are 2+ non-conjured allies on the battlefield, each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn with less than 50% of max HP, this unit will will spend a Charge to add another Sun Wukong to the next in line of allied reinforcements.

The user is granted a Charge, Sleep Ward, Poison Ward, Burn Shield and the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU. Then the user is Enraged, and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

Unlocked each time the user defeats a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield with an attack. This skill is locked again after each use.

Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards and Endure effects cannot stack. Burn Shields prevent the next non-burn status effect a unit would gain while Burning from applying. An Enraged unit's attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Enrage will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on the user.
localization.selected:
Burns, Endures, Enrages & Grants Wards
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Chilling Geyser
localization.description: 200% damage to 2 enemies, plus 200% for each time this unit has defeated an enemy with an attack while on the battlefield (max of 800% total damage after defeating 3 enemies). This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, skin passive skills, and the Counter Stance status effect.
localization.selected: Up to 800% damage, ignores defeat prevention

localization.name: Snow Under
localization.description:
500% damage to all enemies. 700% damage instead if the user has survived 100TU+ on the battlefield. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. All enemies hit are then granted Frostburn.

Locked for 100TU after the user has entered the battlefield. This lock is ignored while all enemies on the battlefield are sleeping, burning or frostburned. Usable once per battle.

When a unit has Frostburn and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping, then Frostburn is removed and that unit is granted the Burn status effect. Frostburn is not a status effect, but effects that remove negative status effects will also remove Frostburn. Frostburn will end if the affected unit is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Frostburn cannot apply to boss units, and cannot stack. Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.
localization.selected: Up to 700% damage, ignores defeat prevention

localization.name: Dragon's Bane
localization.description:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

Until this unit defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack while on the battlefield, this unit:
- is immune to Sleep status effects.
- is immune to Poison status effects.
- has 50% damage reduction from attacks.

This unit enters battle with the Healing Burn status effect for 300TU and a Burn Shield.

A unit with Healing Burn will heal after each turn at the same rate as Burn would deal damage instead of taking damage from Burn. Healing Burn will overwrite other status effects on the user and can replace the Burn status effect, but cannot be replaced by Burn. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. Healing Burn will not be removed by Purify skills.

localization.name: Returning Hero
localization.description:
This unit enters battle with 1 Charge, 1% HP Regen for 100TU, and will Endure the first damage that would defeat it with 1HP. A unit with 1% HP Regen will heal for 1% of their max HP after every turn. HP Regen effects will overwrite existing HP Regen effects.

This unit cannot be stunned if there is a unit on the battlefield that is Fire element, or has a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill.

This unit's active skills all cost 25% less TU for each charge it has stored, up to 75% less max with 3 charges. Other effects that further reduce TU will have diminishing returns while this is in effect.

At the end of each enemy turn, if no enemies had frostburn at the start of the turn, a random non-sleeping enemy is granted frostburn. This effect cannot trigger if Siegfried has no other allies on the battlefield.

localization.name: Disabling Blow
localization.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy. 600% damage instead if the target has 100TU or more. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

The first time an enemy is damaged by Disabling Blow since entering the battlefield, it has its Active Skills disabled for 50TU. When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping. This effect cannot be purified, and will end if the user is defeated.

This skill becomes locked after use until the user uses Vaporizing Bolt.
localization.selected: 300%+ damage, may disable skills

localization.name: Zeus's Whim
localization.description:

Then all allies on the battlefield have their current TU reduced by 50TU.

Unlocked each time the user defeats a non-conjured enemy with an attack. This skill is locked again after each use.

localization.description:
A random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on or below 25% of max HP and on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This health threshold is increased by 25% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 100% of max HP after being used 3 times or more). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Unlocked each time the user uses another active skill. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. Usable 10 times per battle.
localization.selected: May immediately defeat the target

localization.name: Dark Seeds
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit cannot be poisoned.

Whenever a Mori enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, this unit will immediately have its TU reduced to 0, and be Purified (negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).

When this unit enters battle, if there are at least 5 non-conjured units in the enemy team (including reinforcements), this unit adds 1 Kuromori to a random place in enemy reinforcements for each non-conjured enemy on the battlefield.

localization.name: Soul Fragment
localization.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy. 700% damage instead if the user has survived 100TU or more on the battlefield. 1000% damage instead if the user has survived 200TU or more on the battlefield. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, enemy damage reduction effects, the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

The target hit has its sleep and burn removed (including Deep Sleep, and Mega Healing Burn) and is granted Lethal Poison for 999TU. This will overwrite other status effects on that enemy.

Then the user will add a Kuromori to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. This will not trigger if there were no enemy reinforcements at the start of the turn.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on the affected enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.
localization.selected:
400%+ damage, may spread Poison
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Blood Cycle
localization.description:
If there is a Mori at the very end of allied reinforcements, that Mori will be sacrificed, if that Mori's Element was:
- Water, Fire or Light, all non-fire enemies on the battlefield are granted the burn status effect. Then all enemies on the battlefield are granted the Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. These effects will overwrite other status effects on those units.
- Storm, Earth or Dark, all allies on the battlefield will have their current TU reduced by 50TU, and gain Super Stealth and a Stealth Shield.

Otherwise, if a Mori was not sacrificed, adds 3 Super Mori's to the very end of allied reinforcements (these will be Super Kuromoris and/or Super Shiromoris at random).

This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned. Super Stealth will overwrite other Status effects. Super Stealthed units ignore enemy attacks that would damage more than 1 target. Super Stealth will be removed after ignoring 3 enemy attacks since applying, and can be overwritten by other status effects, except normal Stealth. Damage will not remove Super Stealth. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying.

localization.name: Ephemeral
localization.description:
This unit is never considered to be defeated by attacks and does not trigger any skills of other units whenever it is defeated or sacrificed by any source while on the battlefield.

This unit will be fully healed after each turn if it takes damage but is not defeated. This unit will be defeated after any ally or enemy turn if this unit has any of the Burn, Super Poison, or Mega Poison status effects.

Damage dealt to this unit is increased to 2.5 times the normal amount.

localization.description:

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. localization.name: Dreams Entwined
localization.description:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. This effect can trigger only once each time this unit enters the battlefield, and is considered a Hold Ground+ effect. Whenever a Dark ally named Aigis enters the battlefield from allied reinforcements, this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again.

If there is not already a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements, this unit adds Aigis to next in line of allied reinforcements at the end of the turn whenever:
- Another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, so long as this unit is not defeated or sacrificed at the same time.
- This unit defeats a non-conjured enemy on the battlefield with an attack.

Aigis's Level, Limit Breaks, Awakenings, Boosts, Potential, Mastery, Weapon and Accessory will match this unit.

This unit cannot fall asleep or be stunned if there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements.

This unit has 30% damage reduction from attacks. While there is a Dark ally named Aigis on the battlefield or in allied reinforcements, this unit has 60% damage reduction instead.

Removes all Burn status effects (including Mega Healing Burn) from enemy units on the battlefield. The user is granted a Charge, Super Stealth, and a Stealth Shield.

Then grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This will overwrite other status effects on those units.

Then steals up to 2 Spirit from the enemy team for each Poisoned enemy on the battlefield.

Usable if the user does not have the Stealth status effect. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 50TU.

Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges.
localization.selected:
Remove Burn, Grant Poison, may Steal Spirit
(Will overwrite other status effects)

localization.name: Shattering Shot
localization.description:
500% damage to 1 enemy, and the user is granted a Charge. This attack ignores Guardians, any enemy status effects, damage reduction effects, revenge passive skills, and skin passive skills. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies.

The user removes all Sleep Wards, Stun Wards, and Poison Wards from the hit target. Usable if the user has Stealth or if The Setup is locked.
localization.selected: 500% damage, Removes Wards

localization.name: The Ultimate Heist
localization.description:
600% damage to all enemies. 750% damage instead if the user has survived for 100TU or more on the battlefield. 900% damage instead if the user has survived for 200TU or more on the battlefield. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Then immediately give all other allies the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges. Consumes all Charges on the user.
localization.selected: 600%+ damage to all enemies, give turns

localization.name: Moonlight Thief
localization.description:
This unit cannot be poisoned or burned.

Whenever an enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, this unit will immediately have its TU reduced to 0. Then this effect cannot trigger again until 50TU advances.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will be Purified. This unit has 35% damage reduction from attacks. This unit has 70% damage reduction from attacks instead if this unit has any Ward (e.g. a Sleep Ward)

localization.name: Two Steps Ahead
localization.description:
This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit enters battle with a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward and Super Stealth.

Super Stealthed units ignore enemy attacks that would damage more than 1 target. Super Stealth will be removed after ignoring 3 enemy attacks since applying, and can be overwritten by other status effects, except normal Stealth. Damage will not remove Super Stealth.

localization.description:
The user is granted a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, and will enter Phantom Form.

Usable if at least 1 ally on the battlefield has less than 50% of max HP or if a non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source while this unit is on the battlefield. Usable once per battle.

While in Phantom Form, the user's Attack is increased to 1.5x, and has their Active Skill TU Costs reduced by 50%. This Attack increase does not stack with Enrage effects. Quicken effects will not further reduce this unit's TU costs. This alone will not reduce TU Costs to below 1TU.

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

- Granted a Poison Ward and Burn Ward

localization.description:
Stuns all enemies for 100TU. This Stun cannot be redirected by enemy Stun Absorbers.

Then if 3 or more non-conjured allies are on the battlefield, the user will add another Jeanne to the very end of allied reinforcements.

localization.description:

250% damage to 1 enemy, plus 250% for each time another non-burning ally has gotten the turn since the user entered the battlefield (max of 1000% total damage after 3+ non-burning other ally turns). This attack ignores the Counter Stance status effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

Then immediately give 1 other random ally the next turn by reducing their current TU to 0, and end any enemy effects that are currently disabling their Active Skills. Effects that influence TU order may interrupt the extra turn. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used on turns given by this skill. This skill can be used on such turns, but will not grant the extra turn or end any disabling effects.
localization.selected: 250%+ damage, may grant turn & end disable

localization.name: Rosey Wind
localization.description:
Removes Poison and Sleep (including Deep Sleep, and Lethal Poison) from all allies on the battlefield.

Then all non-burning allies are granted Sleep Thorns, and are Enraged. (This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those units. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.) Usable if there are no Sleep Thorns on allies and the user is not burning.

When a unit with Sleep Thorns is dealt damage by an attack, that unit's Sleep Thorns will be consumed to immediately grant the Cursed Sleep status effect for 200TU to the attacker. Burn or attacks that grant Burn will remove Sleep Thorns and prevent Cursed Sleep from applying. Cursed Sleep will overwrite status effects other than Burn, cannot be overwritten by Poison, can be applied repeatedly to units that have already slept while on the battlefield, and will not end from damage caused by Dream Hunter type active skills.

Locked for 200TU after the user has entered the battlefield. This lock is ignored while all enemies on the battlefield are sleeping, burning or frostburned.

skills.description:
300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 100% for each charge stored by the user (max of 600% total damage). This attack does not consume charges. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. That enemy will also be granted the Burn status effect, and become infected with it.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Burn to a random non-burning unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

Burn will overwrite other status effects. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

Intense Rage increases a unit's Attack to 1.5x for their next 3 turns, and will overwrite existing Weak or Enrage effects. It cannot be overwritten by other Enrage effects but can be overwritten by Weak effects.

This will overwrite other status effects including Healing Burn on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

500% damage to 1 enemy. 750% damage instead if 2 or more enemies on the battlefield are sleeping, burning or frostburned. 1000% damage instead if all enemies on the battlefield are sleeping, burning or frostburned.

Then all allies on the battlefield have their Sleep removed (including Deep Sleep).

skills.name: Drink Me Potion
skills.description:
All allies on the battlefield are Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison), and granted a Poison Ward and Sleep Ward. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

Then the next time the user uses Key Smash, the user will immediately get the next turn. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

Usable if an ally or enemy on the battlefield is burning, sleeping or poisoned. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

skills.name: Magical Prisons
skills.description:
Removes all Sleep wards, Stealth Shields and Burn status effects (including Mega Healing Burn) from all enemy units on the battlefield.

Then grants 2 random enemies the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This will overwrite other status effects on those units.

Then for each enemy that is not asleep on the battlefield, 1 random ally will be given next turn by reducing their current TU. Multiple triggers may target the same ally. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected allies until after they have had the turn, this skill can be used on such turns.

Usable if less than 2 enemies on the battlefield are sleeping. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

skills.name: Star Explosion
skills.description:
1000% damage to 2 enemies. This attack ignores skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

Pulls the user away from the battlefield to be next in line of your reinforcements. If there are no ally reinforcements, adds enough Super Suimori to the ally team to still pull the user away to reinforcements (max 4 if the user is alone on the battlefield).

Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges. Usable 10 times per battle.

skills.name: Quick Tempered
skills.description:
1000% damage to 1 enemy. Minus 200% damage for each enemy on the battlefield that is not sleeping, and is not burning (max of -800% if there are 4 enemies that are not sleeping and not burning).

Then all allies are granted the Burn status effect. Burn will overwrite other status effects on those units. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

skills.name: Seize Them
skills.description:
Each burning enemy on the battlefield has a 20% chance plus 20% per Awakening of the user (up to 100% chance if the user has 4 Awakenings) to have its Active Skills disabled for 30TU.

Then all other burning allies on the battlefield have their current TU reduced by 50TU, and any enemy effects that are currently disabling their Active Skills end.

Usable only if there are at least 4 units with the Burn status effect. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use. Usable 5 times per battle. When a unit's Active Skills are disabled and they get the turn, they will lose the turn as if they were sleeping. This effect cannot affect boss units, cannot be purified, and will end if the user is defeated.

skills.name: A Strong Hand
skills.description:
Allies gain 1 Spirit for each unit on the battlefield that is burning or sleeping.

Removes Poison (including Lethal Poison) from all allies on the battlefield. Then all allies on the battlefield are granted Piercing, a Stun Ward, Poison Ward and an Instant Death Ward.

Unlocked each time the user uses Quick Tempered or Bloody Hearts, and is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

A unit with Piercing will have their Attacks ignore enemy damage reduction effects until the end of their next turn. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. An Instant Death Ward prevents a unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack.

Usable only if the user has the Burn status effect. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 50TU.

skills.name: Hurt Feelings
skills.description:
400% damage to 1 enemy. 800% damage instead if the target has not left the battlefield since damaging an ally with an attack while an ally "Cupid, Sorceress of True Love" was on the battlefield. This attack ignores skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

The user is granted a Sleep Ward, and Poison Ward. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

skills.name: Restore Cupid's Link
skills.description:
Grants Cupid's Link for 50TU to another random non-conjured ally that does not already have a Link.

Then that ally and the user are:
- healed for 100% max HP.
- Purified (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison).
- Fortified, and granted an Instant Death Ward.

Usable only if no other ally on the battlefield has Cupid's Link already, and there is a valid target. Usable 5 times per battle.

An Instant Death Ward prevents a unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. A Fortified unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks. This reduction cannot be ignored by attacks that do not specifically ignore Fortify. Fortify will be removed after reducing damage 3 times since applying, and will be reset if reapplied. This is not a status effect.

skills.name: Matchmaker
skills.description:
Another random ally that has Cupid's Link and a random ally that doesn't have Cupid's Link are given the next turns by having their TU reduced. The ally without Cupid's Link will be first in the turn order. Both units are Purified and become Enraged. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Unlocked each time the user uses Hurt Feelings or Cupid's Shot, and is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on those units. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

skills.name: Cupid's Shot
skills.description:
250% damage to 1 enemy, plus 150% for each time the user has already used this skill or Hurt Feelings while on the battlefield (max of 1000% total damage after the user has used this skill or Hurt Feelings 5 or more times).

Every second time this skill is activated by the user while on the battlefield, a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

Usable 10 times per battle.
